izzyondroid:ch.pete.adbclipboard.name: ADB Clipboard
izzyondroid:ch.pete.adbclipboard.summary: Read/Write the Android clipboard using ADB
izzyondroid:ch.pete.adbclipboard.description:
Secure Clipboard Sync for Developers 
 AdbClipboard enables seamless clipboard synchronisation between your Android device and development PC through ADB - no external servers, no internet required, no data leaving your network.
 Perfect for Restricted Environments 
 Whilst many clipboard sharing solutions rely on external servers, AdbClipboard works entirely through your local ADB connection. Ideal for developers in banks, government agencies, and enterprise environments where external clipboard services are blocked for security reasons.
 Key Features: 
 Automatic PC to Android sync - Copy on PC, paste instantly on Android
 Manual Android to PC sync - Tap floating window to transfer clipboard content
 Zero internet dependency - Works completely offline through ADB
 Ultra lightweight - Minimal app footprint and resource usage
 USB and WiFi support - Connect via cable or wireless ADB
 Security focussed - No internet permission, all data stays local
 How It Works: 
 The app uses a floating window overlay to access Android's clipboard (due to Android security restrictions). When you copy text on your PC, it automatically appears on your Android clipboard. To copy from Android to PC, simply tap the AdbClipboard floating window.
 Requirements: 
 ADB debugging enabled on your device
 Python script running on your PC (included with download)
 "Display over other apps" permission for floating window
 Privacy and Security: 
 No internet permission requested
 No external servers or cloud services
 All clipboard data remains within your local network
 Perfect for security-conscious development environments
 For Developers Only 
 This tool is specifically designed for Android developers who need reliable clipboard sync during development and testing workflows.
 Download the companion Python script from: github.com/PRosenb/AdbClipboard 
 Streamline your development workflow with secure, local clipboard synchronisation.

izzyondroid:com.fibelatti.photowidget.name: Material Photo Widget
izzyondroid:com.fibelatti.photowidget.summary: Photo Widget is a free, no-ads app to display photos on your home screen
izzyondroid:com.fibelatti.photowidget.description:
Material Photo Widget is as simple as it can be: a home screen widget to display your favorite photos. It is a free, no-ads, open source alternative for people who want to customize their home screen.
 Create a slideshow from your favorite photos 
 Create shortcuts to open other apps 
 Put your schedule on your home screen 
 Your membership passes one tap away 
 It's easy and simple to add a new widget with your photos.
 FEATURES 
 Choose photos individually or sync with device folders
 Set an interval or schedule to create a slideshow and switch photos automatically
 Your widgets are shortcuts — customize tap actions for each of your widgets, viewing your photos in full screen, opening an app or URL
 Customizable borders, opacity, saturation, brightness, offset and padding to create your perfect home screen
 6 formats to choose from: Shapes, Square, Tall, Wide, Original and Fill
 28 different shapes
 HOW TO USE 
 Open the app and tap "Create a new widget" directly from the home screen. Add your photos, choose the appearance and behaviors and tap "Add to home screen". That's it!
 You can also long press on your home screen, open the widget menu and search for "Material Photo Widget", then configure your new widget the same way.
 MY WIDGET DOES NOT APPEAR 
 The app consumes very little power and runs on the background when needed (to switch photos, for example). Because it's rarely being actively used, it can be stopped by Android as the system prioritizes the most used apps when trying to optimize the battery duration.
 If you are facing this problem, remove any battery or memory restrictions from the app. You can also search for your device brand on https://dontkillmyapp.com and follow their instructions to improve the behavior of apps that mostly run on the background.
 Some phones can prevent apps from starting themselves after restarting the device, making the widget can appear broken. If that's happening, you must grant permission for the app to "auto start" through your settings or security app.
 PERMISSIONS 
 RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED — This permission is needed to restore widgets after a device restart. Some device manufacturers prevent this from happening, and you must manually allow it through the "auto-start" setting on your phone.
 SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM (optional) — This is an optional permission that is needed if you would like to use shorter intervals to switch photos, ensuring that they follow the selected schedule exactly.
 REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS (optional) — This is an optional permission that is needed to ensure that widgets are updated as expected in Android flavors that tend to kill apps that mostly run in the background.
 WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE — This permission is used by both the app (optionally, via in-app settings toggle) and Work Manager to manage background work. In this case, used to ensure that widgets are synced and are updated as expected.
 The app does not require any storage permissions. Photos and directories are selected using the native pickers and stored within the app to keep data private and secure. There's no tracking or network communication.
 Material Photo Widget is an open-source project, find the code and submit feedback at https://github.com/fibelatti/photo-widget
 Vectors and icons by Dazzle Ui (https://dazzleui.gumroad.com/l/dazzleiconsfree?ref=svgrepo.com) in CC Attribution License via https://www.svgrepo.com/
 Store listing screenshots were generated with https://screenshots.pro

ANPASIDE is an offline Android IDE for the MIDletPascal programming language. Write Pascal on your phone, compile projects into J2ME applications with the bundled mp3cc compiler, run them immediately in the built-in emulator, and export them as standalone Android apps.

 Bundled MIDletPascal compiler and Java ME runtime classes
 Built-in J2ME emulator with configurable screen size and on-screen keypad
 APK export that packs a project into an installable Android app with its own name and icon
 External Java libraries (Lib_*.class) in the project's libs folder
 Built-in libraries for multi-touch, sound, networking and more, ready to use with no files to copy
 File import, sharing, project export, and external JAR launching
 Compiler errors you can tap to open the source file at the failing line
 Projects remain on your device, and the complete edit, build, and run workflow works offline.

izzyondroid:com.github.shadowsocks.plugi.name: Cloak
izzyondroid:com.github.shadowsocks.plugi.summary: A Shadowsocks plugin to enhance censorship circumvention
izzyondroid:com.github.shadowsocks.plugi.description:
A Cloak plugin for Shadowsocks .
 Cloak is a universal pluggable transport that cryptographically obfuscates proxy traffic as legitimate HTTPS traffic, disguises the proxy server as a normal web server, multiplexes traffic through a fixed amount of TCP connections and provides multi-user usage control.
 Cloak works fundamentally by masquerading proxy traffic as normal web browsing traffic. This increases the collateral damage to censorship actions and therefore make it very difficult, if not impossible, for censors to selectively block censorship evasion tools and proxy servers without affecting services that the state may also heavily rely on.
 Details on how Cloak works can be found here .
 Shadowsocks-android is required, as well as a Cloak-compatible proxy server.

izzyondroid:com.vitorpamplona.amethyst.name: Amethyst
izzyondroid:com.vitorpamplona.amethyst.description:
Amethyst brings the best social network to your Android phone. Just insert your Nostr private key and start posting.
 Nostr is an open protocol that is able to create a censorship-resistant global "social" network, transferring notes and other stuff using relays. It doesn't rely on any trusted central server, hence it is resilient; it is based on cryptographic keys and signatures, so it is tamperproof; it does not rely on P2P techniques, therefore it works.
 What you can do with Amethyst 
 Post text, photos, videos, long-form articles, polls and voice notes to the relays you choose.
 Follow people, reply, repost, react and quote.
 Send private, end-to-end encrypted direct messages and join group chats.
 Browse dedicated feeds: articles, pictures, short videos, live streams, podcasts, music, communities, classifieds, calendars and more.
 Send and receive Bitcoin Lightning zaps.
 Track your training and share a workout — see below.
 My Fitness — track your training 
 Amethyst includes a personal training dashboard. Open the left drawer and tap My Fitness , under You . It summarises the workouts you have logged in Amethyst, and — with your permission — the ones your watch or fitness app has already saved to Android Health Connect (Samsung Health, Google Fit, Fitbit, Garmin Connect, Strava and others all write there). It shows you:
 How much you trained this week, and whether that is up or down on last week.
 Your four-week weekly average for time, distance, steps and climb.
 Where your time goes — running, cycling, walking, hiking, swimming, rowing, the gym.
 Your best efforts: longest distance, longest workout, biggest climb, most steps, highest heart rate.
 How many days you trained, and your current streak of consecutive active days.
 All of it is computed on your phone and shown to you. Nothing is uploaded to produce it, and you never have to post anything to use it.
 Sharing a workout (optional) 
 If you want to tell your followers about a particular session, tap Share this workout on any row. Amethyst opens a post pre-filled with that workout's figures; you review it and decide whether to publish. One workout at a time, always with your confirmation, never automatic.
 The Health Connect integration is read-only. Amethyst never writes to Health Connect, never reads in the background, never asks for your exercise route or location, and only ever looks at the last four weeks. You can revoke access in Health Connect at any time. Full details are in the privacy policy at github.com/vitorpamplona/amethyst .
 Amethyst is free and open source (MIT). There is no Amethyst server and no Amethyst account: your posts go straight to the Nostr relays you configure.

izzyondroid:dev.animeshvarma.sigil.name: Sigil
izzyondroid:dev.animeshvarma.sigil.summary: Open-source zero-trust cryptography & privacy suite with multi-layer encryption.
izzyondroid:dev.animeshvarma.sigil.description:
Sigil is an open-source, advanced encryption utility built for defense-in-depth and memory safety. Unlike standard tools that rely on a single algorithm, Sigil employs a multi-layered, configurable architecture to ensure your data remains secure against sophisticated cryptanalysis.
 The application operates entirely offline, performing all cryptographic operations locally on your device with a modern Material 3 interface that balances high-level security with usability.
 Core Security Features 
 Encryption Profiles: Customize your security posture. Switch between "Standard AES-GCM" (Raw mode) for compatibility with external tools, or the "Sigil Chain" for maximum defense.
 Multi-Layer Cascade: The default Sigil Chain wraps your data in a hybrid cascade of XChaCha20-Poly1305 + Serpent-CBC + Twofish-CBC + AES-256-GCM. This defense-in-depth approach ensures that even if one algorithm is compromised, your data remains protected by independent layers.
 Zero-Knowledge Auth: Secure the app with a numeric PIN or a strong alphanumeric Password. Credentials are hashed using Salted Argon2id and never stored in a reversible format.
 Hardware-Backed Vault: When supported by the device, master keys are generated and stored in the Android Keystore (or StrongBox). Saved encryption passwords never touch the disk in plaintext.
 Memory Hygiene: Sensitive data buffers are zeroed where possible after use to reduce exposure to memory dumps.
 Privacy & System Hardening 
 Screen Security: Prevents screenshots and hides app content in the "Recent Apps" overview using FLAG_SECURE , protecting against visual snooping and malicious screen recorders.
 Clipboard Protection: Automatic wipe timers and Android 13+ sensitive content flags prevent clipboard managers from retaining your decrypted data.
 Offline-Only: Sigil does not request the INTERNET permission. It tracks no analytics, collects no telemetry, and stores no data on external servers.
 Advanced User Toolkit 
 Secure Keystore: Save, view, and manage encryption keys using the hardware-backed vault.
 Custom Encryption Control: Full manual control over encryption chains. Build your own cascade from 18 algorithms, reorder layers, and toggle ZLib compression.
 System Console: Real-time logging of the encryption process, providing precise timing metrics and error diagnostics.
 Advanced Theming: Material You Dynamic Colors, Dark/Light modes, and a custom HSV color engine.
 Technical Specifications 
 Key Derivation: Argon2id (Configurable up to 256MB RAM) + SHA-512 pre-hashing.
 Supported Algorithms: AES-256-GCM, AES-256-CBC, ChaCha20-Poly1305, XChaCha20-Poly1305, ARIA-256-GCM, Twofish, Serpent, Camellia, CAST6, RC6, SM4, GOST, SEED, Blowfish, IDEA, CAST5, TEA, and XTEA.
 Open-Source Transparency 
 The complete source code is available for public audit on GitHub: https://github.com/Animesh-Varma/Sigil
 For the complete release roadmap and planned features, please visit: https://github.com/Animesh-Varma/Sigil/releases
 For any queries, please contact: sigil@animeshvarma.dev

fdroid:ch.betzengineering.openvine.summary: Record and stitch 6-second video clips. Offline and private.
fdroid:ch.betzengineering.openvine.description:
OpenVine is a camera app inspired by the mechanics of the classic Vine application. It allows you to create short, looping videos with ease.
 Features: 
 The app records only while you keep the big red button pressed.
 You can release the button to change angles or scenes. Once you have recorded a total of 6 seconds, the app automatically stitches all the clips together into a single video file.
 This is purely a camera utility. There is no external server, no account login, and no cloud tracking.
 Videos are stored locally on your device. You can easily forward them to instant messengers, email, or social networks using the built-in Android share functionality.
 Artistic effects: 
The selfie camera may record upside-down on certain devices. This is definitely not a bug but an artistic choice. If you do not want to record upside down, rotate your phone by 180 degrees before recording selfies.

fdroid:com.averi.worldscribe.name: World Scribe
fdroid:com.averi.worldscribe.summary: Help story writers with fictional world-building
fdroid:com.averi.worldscribe.description:
Ever wanted to create a fictional setting — for your next novel, comic,
screenplay, or what-have-you — but find it difficult to keep everything
organized?
 World Scribe eases the creation process by letting you keep track of every
important element in your world, including the ways in which they're connected.
Whether you're a novelist, hobby writer, or role-player, World Scribe is an
indispensable tool for making your settings more than just fiction. Bring your
world to life today!
 Features: 
* World elements — known as Articles — are organized into five categories for your convenience: People (your colorful cast of characters), groups (people united by blood, race, or a driving motivation), places (the varied locales and vistas your world has to offer), items (gadgets, important artifacts, and various belongings), concepts (definitions for world-specific ideas like magic systems, religions, and superpowers).
* Any Article can possess Connections to other Articles, complete with relationship descriptions. Each Connection also acts as a link to that Article's page. Need to find a characters siblings, or the ancient artifacts on their person? You can navigate to each of them straight from that character's page.
* Any Article can also possess Snippets, which are custom text entries unique to that Article. Want to write down an important letter or speech from one of your characters? How about a song or poem warning of a dangerous location in the world? The possibilities are endless!
* Everything you write is stored in simple text files, so feel free to export your worlds at any time and use them in other writing projects. You can find them in the "WorldScribe" folder on your phone's external storage.
* Have a Dropbox account? You can backup each of your worlds to your Dropbox account for easy exporting and added safety (in case the Dark Lord seizes your device). To backup, just select the "Backup to Dropbox" option from the overflow menu at any time.

fdroid:com.dijia1124.plusplusbattery.name: Plus Plus Battery
fdroid:com.dijia1124.plusplusbattery.summary: Real-time battery stats & health estimator for OnePlus/Oppo/Realme phones
fdroid:com.dijia1124.plusplusbattery.description:
PlusPlus Battery gives you everything you ever wanted to know about your phone’s
battery — from simple level and power readings to deep-dive metrics.
It is designed and tested on modern OnePlus/Oppo/Realme devices,
but also works on most recent AOSP-based ROMs.
───────────────────
■ KEY FEATURES
───────────────────
• Real-time dashboard
 – Level, voltage, current, charge / discharge power
 – Works with and without root
• Battery-health estimation
 – Without root access: Calculates Full-Charge-Capacity when the
 battery is exactly 100 % and reaches 0 mA current
• Cycle-count history
 – Saves today’s cycle count to a local Room database each time you open the
 app, and shows the trend in a timeline view
• Persistent monitor notification
 – Ongoing notification-area battery monitor with customizable metrics
• Optional root mode
 – Reads additional sysfs nodes under /sys/class/oplus_chg/battery and some other directories, including
 • Current remaining capacity (battery_rm)
 • FCC (battery_fcc) and SOH (battery_soh)
 • Raw, uncompensated FCC/SOH values (especially for silicon batteries)
 • Under-voltage shut-down threshold (vbat_uv)
 • Battery serial number, manufacture date, Qmax, and more
 - Reads generic linux power supply files under /sys/class/power_supply/battery for universal devices
 • Customizable paths/titles/units for anything you want to read with root access
• Experimental
 - Gets battery data from logcat (root required)
 • Currently only some OPlus, Moto & Xiaomi devices are supported (depends on models and systems)
───────────────────
■ INSTALLATION
───────────────────
1. Make sure your handset runs a recent OxygenOS / ColorOS build or another
 up-to-date Android ROM.
2. Install the APK (or via F-Droid once this package is published).
3. Launch and grant the requested permissions.
4. (Optional) Grant root to unlock advanced metrics.
5. (Optional) To make the monitor service work as intended, disable battery optimisation for
 PlusPlusBattery and, on ColorOS 15, enable “Auto-launch”.
6. (Optional) For non-Oppo/OnePlus/Realme devices, you may want to disable the option 'Show OPlus exclusive entries' to hide those useless data under root mode.
───────────────────
■ PRIVACY & OPEN SOURCE
───────────────────
There are **no ads, no trackers, no internet permissions**.
• Application source code ─ MIT Licence
• Material Icons (Google Fonts) ─ Apache Licence 2.0
See the LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES files in the repository for full texts.
Special thanks to github user @shminer for the original FCC/SOH compensation research and
algorithm contributions.
GitHub ➜ https://github.com/dijia1124/plusplusbattery
Issues ➜ https://github.com/dijia1124/plusplusbattery/issues

Displays the availability status of meeting rooms along with the free/busy-time.
Requires a Google-Account for schedules.
Reservator is an open source meeting room display system for tablets. Mount your
tablet next to your meeting rooms door, install Reservator and you're good to
go! Reservator uses your Google calendar's resources for booking so you can use
it, for example, for conference rooms, classrooms or for lending a video
projector. While using Reservator, you can still book rooms normally through
Google Calendar. You can also use the application for reserving other meeting
rooms within your company.
 Features:

fdroid:com.jacquesb.planetario_a.name: Planetario
fdroid:com.jacquesb.planetario_a.description:
Planetario contains a 3D model of our solar system. It will show the horizon and the planets in their path along the sky. The word planet comes from the Greek planetai, meaning "wanderers". Because of the rotation of the earth, the stars seem to move in perfect circles, but the path of planets seem to wander against the background of stars. 
Although there are many other apps and websites that show our solar system much more acurate, Planetario has a combination of features you which make it unique:
* Speed up time to see and understand the path of the planets through the sky
* Zoom in on planets using a virtual telescope
* See the horizon from all places on earth: checkout the different path of the Sun seen from the Northern and Southern hemisphere
* Travel the Moon or another planet to see the horizon from there. Visit the Apollo 16 and Mars Opportunity landing sites. 
* See the earth from the Moon as seen by the astronauts John Young and Charles Duke
* Check whether the Earth and the Moon can be seen from Mars as separate 'stars'
* Visit some far away virtual spacestations to look down on our solar system or see it from the side.
Planetario may help you to:

apple-macos:6446479064.name: Whisper - talk without voice
apple-macos:6446479064.developer: Software in the Public Interest, Inc.
apple-macos:6446479064.summary: Download Whisper - talk without voice by Software in the Public Interest, Inc. on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps…
apple-macos:6446479064.description:
Whisper is a communication aid for the non-verbal community. It allows someone who doesn't speak to participate in a conversation with others who do. The non-verbal participant (called the Whisperer) uses their device to type their part of the conversation: the letters they type appear instantly on the devices used by the verbal participants (called Listeners). Listeners speak their responses to the Whisperer and to each other.
Conversations assisted by Whisper are real-time, spoken conversations where all the participants can hear each other. In the same way that verbal participants are careful not to speak when someone else has begun speaking, they are careful not to speak when the Whisperer has started typing. This allows normal turn-taking in the conversation, even when the Whisperer types slowly, because the first letter the Whisperer types appears immediately on Listener screens.
Whisper works well both for in-person conversations and for remote conversations over an audio/video call. For conversations where the Whisperer and the Listeners are in person, no cellular data or wifi connection is required. For remote conversations, a cellular data or wifi connection is required. Listeners without Apple devices or who don't have the app can use a web browser to listen via cellular data or wifi.
Each Whisper-assisted conversation has an associated URL that the Whisperer can send to Listeners to invite them to join. Whisperers can create different conversations for different situations; for example, they may use a separate conversation for each recurring conference call they participate in. Listener devices remember prior conversations, so sending a URL is only needed the first time a Listener wants to join a particular conversation. After that the Listener can rejoin simply by selecting the conversation on their device.
Whisper facilitates spoken conversations between users who know each other, and who have other means of communication (messaging, email, etc.) by which a Whisperer can send a conversation URL to a Listener. As with other spoken conversations, a Listener who joins a Whisper-assisted conversation has no access to what the Whisperer may have typed before they joined. Whispered content cannot be copied by Listeners, and when the Whisperer leaves a conversation everything they "said" is immediately erased from all Listener devices.
Whisper takes the privacy of its users very seriously. The app keeps no personally identifiable information about any user, and the memory of which conversations a Whisperer has created or a Listener has participated in is kept in app-secure storage on their device. (For users with more than one device, Whisper allows this "conversational profile" to be securely shared among their devices.)
Whisper is a free, open-source app, provided as a service to the non-verbal community. It is being made available everywhere because there are non-verbal people everywhere. Whisper is currently localized only in US English. If it proves popular in non-English geographies, the hope is to localize it via user community efforts.
More information may be found at https://whisper-project.github.io/client.swift . The source code is at https://github.com/whisper-project/client.swift .

Not someday. ThisDay.
Most planners hand you a backlog. ThisDay hands you a day.
Every task, note, voice memo, event and habit lands on a real

the app and there is one thing in front of you: today, in the
order it happens.
ONE DAY, EVERY KIND OF THING
Tasks, events, notes, voice memos, photos and habits share one
list, because they share one day. A habit at 10:00 sits between
the 9:00 task and the 11:00 meeting, where it belongs. Same row,
same swipe, same checkbox, whatever kind of thing it is.
Your own calendars appear inline too, at the hour they happen,
so a morning with a meeting in it never looks free.
EVERYTHING CAN REMIND YOU
Record a voice memo and put a reminder on it. Write a note and
have it find you at 6pm. Your phone can already take a voice
memo, it just can't tell you about it later. ThisDay can.
HABITS THAT TICK THEMSELVES
Point a habit at Apple Health and stop reporting on yourself.
Steps, exercise minutes, active energy, sleep, the Watch's three
rings, and workouts from running to yoga. Set the number you're
aiming at; ThisDay watches for it and fills the ring as your day
fills it.
ThisDay only reads Health, never writes to it, and only the
measurement each habit names. Nothing leaves your device.
And a habit is never marked done because a sensor said so and
you disagreed. No reading is ever "done"; if your watch was on
the charger, the tick is still yours to make. Your tick always
wins.
APPLE REMINDERS, BOTH WAYS
The Reminders lists you choose show up in your day, next to
everything else, read-only: ThisDay never edits somebody else's
row. And when you ask for it, the other direction. Tasks you
make here are written back out as reminders, so they reach Siri,
a Mac that doesn't run ThisDay, and anyone you share a list
with. Switching it off takes the copies back out.
NOTHING GETS BURIED
Unfinished work follows you to today instead of quietly aging on
a date you've already passed. Completed things can leave the
list or stay in a folded section, your call.
ONE RULER, FROM A DAY TO THE YEAR
Slide the ruler at the top of your day out to a few days, the week, the month or the whole year, and tap any day to come back into it. The + is always one thumb away.
ALSO IN HERE
• Quick capture for every kind of item
• Reminders, repeats and rollover
• Categories, priorities and links
• SiriAI: ask about your plans, answered on your device (Apple Intelligence)
• A Library for notes, voice notes, pictures, places and countdowns
• An inbox for anything without a day yet
• Monthly recaps and medals you can share
• Widgets, Live Activities and an Apple Watch app
• Shortcuts and Siri
• Twelve languages, every screen in each one
• Light and dark, and an accent you choose
• Your day on iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo and Mac
BUILT BY ONE PERSON
There is no account and no sign-up, because there is no server
to sign up to. No analytics, no tracking, and nothing sold to
anyone; your day never leaves your device.
Something broken or missing? Write to hello@akilastudio.com and
you'll get a reply from the person who made it.
FREE FOR TASKS, ONE PRICE FOR THE REST
ThisDay is free for 21 days with everything included; no card up front and nothing to cancel. After that, tasks and repeats stay free for good. ThisDay Pro opens everything else with one payment. No subscription, no renewal.
ThisDay is on the Mac too, in this same App Store listing, with its own one-time unlock. If you bought ThisDay on iPhone, the Mac costs less.

flathub:ch.dragondreams.deigde.name: Dragengine IGDE
flathub:ch.dragondreams.deigde.description:
Supports creating and modifying Drag[en]gine game projects.
 Does not require compiler toolchains to be installed.
 Using a code IDE is though recommended for syntax
 highlighting and code completion.
 DEIGDE creates *.delga files as game distributable
 which can be run using the Drag[en]gine Delauncher
 (ch.dragondreams.delauncher). For publishing on stores
 like Steam see https://github.com/LordOfDragons/dedistribute/releases
 for the necessairy files.
 Recommended additional software to use with IGDE:
 Blender 3D (org.blender.Blender): Create 3D models.
 GIMP (org.gimp.GIMP), Krita (org.kde.krita),
 InkScape (org.inkscape.Inkscape):
 Create textures, decals and images.
 Audacity (org.audacityteam.Audacity): Create sound files.
 Visual Studio Code (com.visualstudio.code): Edit game scripts
 More information on the Wiki: https://developer.dragondreams.ch/wiki/doku.php/gamedev:deigde

flathub:com.github.dahenson.agenda.name: Agenda
flathub:com.github.dahenson.agenda.description:
A task manager to help you keep track of the tasks that matter most.
 Sometimes, you just need a task list to keep you motivated. Agenda provides a way to write down your tasks and tick them off as you complete them. The list is saved automatically, so you can close the list to get it out of the way without losing your place.
 Key Features:
 Saves your task list automatically
 See your completed tasks until you choose to delete them
 Autocompletion for previously added tasks
 Undo/Redo with Ctrl-Z and Ctrl-Y
 Print tasklist to paper
 Quit with the Esc key

flathub:com.github.iortcw.iortcw.name: IO Return to Castle Wolfenstein
flathub:com.github.iortcw.iortcw.summary: Game engine for Return to Castle Wolfenstein
flathub:com.github.iortcw.iortcw.description:
World War II rages and nations fall. SS head Himmler has Hitler's full backing
 to twist science and the occult into an army capable of annihilating the Allies
 once and for all. Battling alone, you're on an intense mission to pierce the black
 heart of the Third Reich and stop Himmler -- or die trying.
 The intent of this project is to provide a baseline RTCW which may be used for
 further development and fun. The map editor and associated compiling tools are not
 included. We suggest you use a modern copy of GtkRadiant. Some of the major
 features currently implemented are:
 SDL backend
 OpenAL sound API support (multiple speaker support and better sound quality)
 Full x86_64 support
 AVI video capture of demos
 Much improved console autocompletion & Persistent console history
 Colorized terminal output
 Much improved QVM tools
 Many, many bug fixes
 Commercial data files are required to run the supported games. These can be aquired though
 a multitude of sources. See the manual for more info on this.

flathub:com.protonvpn.www.name: Proton VPN
flathub:com.protonvpn.www.summary: Secures your internet and protects your online privacy
flathub:com.protonvpn.www.description:
**NOTE: This app is built from Proton VPN's official open-source code, but it is not an official
 Proton app. It is not affiliated with or supported by Proton AG.**
 Browse privately and take back control of your personal information with Proton VPN. Connect
 to one of our high-speed servers to hide your IP address, bypass digital borders, and stream from
 popular websites and platforms.
 Used by millions worldwide, our secure no-logs VPN does not record your browsing history, display
 ads, sell your data to third parties, or limit downloads.
 Proton VPN is brought to you by the CERN scientists behind Proton Mail — the world's largest
 encrypted email service.
 Free VPN features
 Strict no-logs policy
 Zero-access, end-to-end encryption
 Full-disk encrypted servers
 No bandwidth restrictions
 Strong, secure protocols: WireGuard and OpenVPN
 IPv6 support
 Perfect forward secrecy: Encrypted traffic cannot be captured and decrypted later
 DNS leak protection: Ensures DNS queries are never accidentally sent to third-party resolvers
 Kill switch: Protects you against IP leaks caused by accidental disconnections
 Premium VPN features
 Connect to 8500+ high speed servers across 110+ countries
 Lightning-fast VPN speeds (up to 10 Gbps)
 Connect up to 10 devices at the same time
 Stream films, sports events, and videos on any streaming service (Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime
 Video, Disney+, BBC iplayer, and more)
 P2P (peer-to-peer) servers: Fast torrenting, gaming, and file sharing
 Secure Core servers: Enhance your protection with double hop VPN
 Tor servers: Connect to onion sites with your regular browser
 NetShield Ad-blocker: Protect yourself from ads, trackers, and malware on websites and apps
 VPN Accelerator: Unique technology increases VPN speeds by up to 400%
 Why Proton VPN?
 No personal data required to sign up
 Easy-to-use VPN apps for iOS, Android, MacOS, Windows, iPad, Linux, Apple TV, and Android
 TV
 Our high-strength encryption provides a more secure connection than an internet proxy
 Independently audited by third-party security experts
 Trusted open-source code that anyone can review
 Data protection using AES-256 and 4096 RSA encryption
 Join the privacy revolution
 Your support helps us bring online freedom to people around the globe. Join Proton today to
 protect yourself online and help create a secure, private, and free internet for everyone.
 Experts' opinion
 PCMag: “[Proton VPN's] is a slick VPN with an excellent collection of advanced features, and
 it has the best free subscription plan we've seen. Few competitors can match its mix of affordability,
 features, and design. For all that, it gets a rare five-star rating and earns our Editors' Choice
 award”
 Mozilla: “There are many VPN vendors out there, but not all of them are created equal. Proton
 VPN offers a secure, reliable, and easy-to-use VPN service and is operated by the makers of ProtonMail,
 a respected, privacy-oriented email service... As a company they have a track record of fighting
 for online privacy and they share our dedication to internet safety and security.”
 Required dependencies
 NetworkManager-openvpn
 KWallet or GNOME Keyring
 systemd

flathub:com.tic80.TIC_80.name: TIC-80
flathub:com.tic80.TIC_80.summary: Fantasy computer for making, playing and sharing tiny games
flathub:com.tic80.TIC_80.description:
TIC-80 is a free and open source fantasy computer for making, playing and sharing tiny games.
 With TIC-80 you get built-in tools for development: code, sprites, maps, sound editors and the
 command line, which is enough to create a mini retro game.
 Games are packaged into a cartridge file, which can be easily distributed. TIC-80 works on all
 popular platforms. This means your cartridge can be played in any device.
 To make a retro styled game, the whole process of creation and execution takes place under some
 technical limitations: 240x136 pixel display, 16 color palette, 256 8x8 color sprites, 4 channel
 sound, etc.
 Note: Access to all devices permission required (--device=all) so that gamepads can be used
 with this Flatpak.

flathub:com.vscodium.codium-insiders.name: VSCodium - Insiders
flathub:com.vscodium.codium-insiders.description:
VSCodium Insiders combines the simplicity of a code editor with what developers need for the
 core edit-build-debug cycle.
 This is the telemetry-less version of Visual Studio Code, packaged into a Flatpak. This repackaging
 is not supported by Microsoft.

flathub:edu.berkeley.BOINC.name: BOINC Manager
flathub:edu.berkeley.BOINC.summary: Contribute computing power to projects doing research in many scientific areas
flathub:edu.berkeley.BOINC.description:
BOINC lets you help cutting-edge science research using your computer. The
 BOINC app, running on your computer, downloads scientific computing jobs and
 runs them invisibly in the background. It's easy and safe.
 About 30 science projects use BOINC. They investigate diseases, study climate
 change, discover pulsars, and do many other types of scientific research.
 The BOINC and Science United projects are located at the University of
 California, Berkeley and are supported by the National Science Foundation.

flathub:io.github.hkdb.Aerion.name: Aerion
flathub:io.github.hkdb.Aerion.summary: Lightweight open-source email client for Linux
flathub:io.github.hkdb.Aerion.description:
Aerion is a modern, lightweight email client inspired by Geary, focused on resource efficiency
 and a clean user experience.
 Features:
 Multiple email accounts with unified inbox
 Support for Gmail, Outlook, and generic IMAP/SMTP
 Conversation threading
 Rich text WYSIWYG composer with TipTap editor
 Contact sync (CardDAV, Google, Microsoft) for auto-completion
 Dark mode and multiple color themes
 Keyboard-friendly navigation with vim-style shortcuts
 Detachable composer window
 Basic tracking element removal from emails
 PGP and S/MIME support
 Contacts extension (ALPHA)
 Calendar extension (ALPHA)
 Custom OAuth support for generic IMAP, SMTP, CardDAV, and CalDAV

flathub:net.sonobus.SonoBus.name: SonoBus
flathub:net.sonobus.SonoBus.summary: Free and open source network audio streaming
flathub:net.sonobus.SonoBus.description:
SonoBus is an application for streaming high-quality, low-latency peer-to-peer
 audio between devices over the internet or a local network.
 Features:
 Connects multiple users together to send and receive audio among all in a group,
 with fine-grained control over latency, quality and overall mix. Includes optional
 input compression, noise gate, and EQ effects, along with a master reverb.
 All settings are dynamic, network statistics are clearly visible.
 Works as a standalone application on macOS, Windows, iOS, and GNU/Linux, and as
 an audio plugin (AU, VST, and AAX) on macOS and Windows. Use it on your desktop
 or in your DAW, or on your mobile device.
 Easy to setup and use, yet still provides all the details that audio nerds want to see.
 Audio quality can be instantly adjusted from full uncompressed PCM (16, 24, or 32 bit)
 or with various compressed bitrates (16-256 kbps per channel) using
 the low-latency Opus codec.

flathub:org.gna.Warmux.name: Warmux

flathub:org.gna.Warmux.summary: A 2D game where funny characters launch funny weapons
flathub:org.gna.Warmux.description:
WarMUX is a free and open-source turn-based game and can be played online
 in public or private mode.
 Players can play together each one in the commande of a team in a senario

flathub:org.gnome.Reversi.name: Reversi
flathub:org.gnome.Reversi.summary: Dominate the board in a classic reversi game, or play the reversed variant
flathub:org.gnome.Reversi.description:
Reversi is a two-player strategy game, played on an 8 by 8 board.
 Players use tiles that are dark on one side and light on the other.
 The object of reversi is to flip your opponent’s tiles to your color,
 while your opponent is trying to flip your tiles to his own color.
 Opponent’s tiles are flipped when trapped between an already placed tile
 of your color and the tile you add. Who finishes with more tiles wins!
 Reversi allows you to play both a classic reversi game, and the
 reversed variant, where the goal is to finish with less tiles than your
 opponent.

flathub:org.gpxsee.GPXSee.name: GPXSee
flathub:org.gpxsee.GPXSee.summary: GPS log file viewer and analyzer
flathub:org.gpxsee.GPXSee.description:
GPXSee is a GPS log file viewer and analyzer that supports all common
 GPS log file formats.
 Features:
 Opens GPX, TCX, FIT, KML, IGC, NMEA, SIGMA SLF, Suunto SML, LOC,
 OziExplorer (PLT, WPT, RTE), GeoJSON, SeeYou CUP,
 Garmin GPI & CSV, TomTom OV2 & ITN, ONmove OMD/GHP,
 TwoNav (TRK, RTE, WPT), GPSDump WPT, Velocitek VTK,
 Vakaros VKX, GoPro GPMF videos, DJI videos, Sony RTMD videos,
 Google CAMM videos, Novatek/VIOFO/Blackvue/Vantrue/70mai
 dashcam videos and geotagged JPEG/MP4 files.
 Opens geo URIs (RFC 5870).
 User-definable online maps (OpenStreetMap/Google tiles, WMTS,
 WMS, TMS, QuadTiles).
 Offline maps (MBTiles, OziExplorer maps, TrekBuddy maps/atlases,
 TwoNav RMaps, Garmin IMG & JNX maps, GeoTIFF images,
 BSB nautical charts, KMZ maps, AlpineQuest maps,
 Locus/OsmAnd/RMaps SQLite maps, Osmdroid SQLite maps,
 Mapsforge maps, QCT maps, GEMF maps, Orux maps, COROS maps,
 ESRI world files, ENC charts).
 Elevation, speed, heart rate, cadence, power, temperature and
 gear ratio graphs.
 Support for multiple tracks in one view.
 Support for POI files.
 Support for DEM files (SRTM HGT).
 Print/export to PDF & PNG.
 Full-screen mode.
 HiDPI/Retina displays & maps support.
 Real-time GPS position.

flathub:org.wxhexeditor.wxHexEditor.name: wxHexEditor
flathub:org.wxhexeditor.wxHexEditor.description:
Directly edit and analyze large files.
 Advanced Features include:
 Editing very large files (bigger than RAM)

flathub:org.xiphos.Xiphos.name: Xiphos
flathub:org.xiphos.Xiphos.description:
Xiphos is a program for high-grade Bible study using the modules and
 underlying engine support of The Sword Project. Sword modules provide the
 widest language coverage of any Bible software anywhere: 400+ Bibles in 150+
 languages, with major support for original languages (a dozen each in Hebrew
 and Greek) plus major support in e.g. English, Russian, German, Portuguese,
 and French.
 Fully integrated, tabbed interface with Bible+commentary+dictionary
 User content support: hierarchical bookmarks, personal verse annotations,
 journals, prayer lists
 Interface translated into 26 languages
 Power search capability; footnotes and xrefs; detached windows;
 text-to-speech support
 Strong's and morphology support, including pseudo-interlinear display
 BibleSync shared multicast navigation in personal or speaker/audience
 modes
 Supports Linux and Windows including active support in IRC and mailing
 lists

Each family supports one Indic script plus Latin, Latin Extended, and Vietnamese. – Baloo 2 for Devanagari – Baloo Bhai 2 for Gujarati – Baloo Bhaina 2 for Odia – Baloo Chettan 2 for Malayalam – Baloo Da 2 for Bengali – Baloo Paaji 2 for Gurmukhi – Baloo Tamma 2 for Kannada – Baloo Tammudu 2 for Telugu – Baloo Thambi 2 for Tamil It took a team of committed type designers to rear Baloo and raise it to be the typeface we love. The Gurmukhi is designed by Shuchita Grover; Bangla by Noopur Datye and Sulekha Rajkumar; Odia by Yesha Goshar, Manish Minz, and Shuchita Grover; Gujarati by Noopur Datye and Supriya Tembe; Kannada by Divya Kowshik and Shuchita Grover; Telugu by Maithili Shingre and Omkar Shende; Malayalam by Maithili Shingre and Unnati Kotecha; and Tamil by Aadarsh Rajan. bluejetty:00157208:ios.description:
Help make your city, improvement district or transportation system safer by reporting safety and security concerns.  When you see a problem, the See Say app provides a quick and discreet way to inform people who can do something about it, the safety and security dispatchers who respond to incidents in your community.
The See Say app can send photos, video, a description of the problem, and the incident location. A dispatcher may reply to your report by chatting with you through the app in real-time.
From the app home screen, users have two easy options for submitting information:
* The Report a Problem button allows users to send incident reports directly. To ensure discretion, the camera flash is automatically disabled when photos are taken through the app.  App users may also send reports anonymously if they choose.
* The Call Police button will connect app users directly to an organization’s security or Police, by phone.
Additional Features
BOLO (Be On the Look Out) Alerts. BOLO Alerts on the See Say app may display alerts from security or Police about specific persons of interest. For example, See Say may display information about a missing person or criminal suspect, such as where they were last seen.
Maintenance Issues. Along with reporting security concerns, See Say can also be configured to report maintenance issues to increase awareness and expedite the repair.
Help make your community or transportation system safer for all, with See Say.

bluejetty:00153682:ios.description:
Transform Your iPhone Into a Powerful E-Signing Tool
Signature is your go-to app for all things related to digital signatures and document handling. Whether you're at home, in the office, or on the move, this app makes it fast and effortless to sign, fill out, and manage important documents-right from your device.
With an intuitive interface and robust functionality, Signature empowers you to create legally valid electronic signatures using just your finger or stylus. Simply draw your signature directly on the screen, place it exactly where it needs to go, and send off your signed documents in seconds. Perfect for contracts, agreements, forms, or any paperwork that requires a signature.
Key Features:
-Seamlessly fill out and edit documents without printing or scanning
- Easily create and save electronic signatures and initials
- Apply your signature directly to PDFs and other document formats
- Import documents from your email, cloud storage, or device files
- Save time, reduce paper usage, and keep your documents organized digitally
Whether you're a freelancer, business owner, or just someone who wants a quicker way to handle paperwork, Signature is the ultimate solution for digital signing. Download now and experience a smarter, paper-free workflow!

Everything You Need at Your Fingertips
With the in-app search feature, quickly access the products, services and information you need in seconds and simplify your banking experience.

• Enjoy personalized discounts and benefits

bluejetty:00186785:ios.description:
Perfect for babies, infants and toddlers! Parents, therapists, and doctors also find Color Dots helpful for children with autism, ADHD, or sensory processing needs. Color Dots is a calming, cause-and-effect play experience designed to delight and develop.
High-contrast colors, instant visual feedback, and zero text or instructions make it accessible for nonverbal children and neurodivergent learners. No timers. No pressure. Just joyful tapping.
5 MINI GAMES TO EXPLORE
Paint Party: Swipe and splash color across the screen
Emoji Party: Tap to fill the world with animated emoji
Confetti: Every touch erupts into a burst of color
Collector: Drag and gather dots to a basket
Counting: Practice numbers at your own pace
DESIGNED FOR SPECIAL NEEDS
• High-contrast visuals for sensory and visual learners
• Simple cause-and-effect play, ideal for nonverbal and early learners
• Full Guided Access support, lock into any single game for focus
• Adjustable dot speed and size to match your child's abilities
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No data collected. Ever.
BUILDS REAL SKILLS
• Fine motor control and hand-eye coordination
• Color and pattern recognition
• Early counting and letter recognition
• Cause-and-effect understanding
Trusted by parents of children with autism, ADHD, sensory processing disorder, and developmental delays. Used in homes, classrooms, and therapy sessions.

bluejetty:00089133:ios.description:
Discover Inner Peace and Holistic Well-Being with Innergy 
Embark on a transformative journey towards inner peace and personal growth with Innergy, your all-in-one meditation and wellness app. Designed to enhance both mental and physical health, Innergy provides tools to reduce stress, improve sleep, and support holistic well-being. 
Unlock Your Inner Potential 
Dive into the strength and tranquility within through expertly curated guided meditations. Whether you're a beginner or experienced meditator, Innergy helps you navigate emotions, calm your mind, and foster self-awareness, bringing balance to your everyday life. 
A Holistic Wellness Experience 
From reducing anxiety to enhancing sleep quality, Innergy offers a range of expert-designed features that promote mindfulness, clarity, and overall well-being. 
New Features to Explore 
1. Live Webinars: Join interactive sessions led by experts to inspire and educate. 
2. Gamification: Stay motivated with challenges, achievements, and fun rewards. 
3. Group Meditation: Meditate with others in real-time, synced to your timezone for a collective experience. 
4. 1:1 Expert Sessions: Get personalized guidance to address your unique wellness needs. 
5. Group Chat: Connect and share experiences with a supportive community. 
6. Health Tracking: Monitor your wellness journey with easy-to-use tools. 
7. Treasure Hunts: Discover engaging challenges to make mindfulness exciting. 
8. Leaderboards: Track your progress and celebrate milestones with friendly competition. 
Features for Everyday Well-Being 
1. Anxiety & Stress Relief: Guided sessions to help you find calm and regain control during stressful moments. 
2. Better Sleep: Unwind with sleep meditations and soundscapes for deep, restful sleep. 
3. Stress Reduction Techniques: Relax with guided breathing and mindfulness exercises. 
4. Mindfulness Practices: Build focus, clarity, and mindfulness in your daily routine. 
5. Exercise & Workouts: Complement your meditation practice with physical activities for balance. 
6. Nutrition Tips & Recipes: Fuel your body with nutritious meal plans and recipes. 
Community and Support 
Join a thriving community of like-minded individuals on their wellness journey. Connect, learn, and grow together in a supportive environment. 
Redemption of Innergy Points - Coming Soon! 
Stay tuned for an exciting new feature that will allow you to redeem your earned Innergy Points for exclusive rewards! 
Support: support@innergyapp.com 
Terms of Service: https://innergyapp.com/termsOfService 
Privacy Policy: https://innergyapp.com/privacyPolicy

Because Seoudi is your favorite place to shop, we are keen on offering you the best online shopping experience for a higher satisfaction level and all day round service. We take your orders 24/7.

bluejetty:00031402:ios.description:
"MTNTOUGH Is the Last Fitness App You Need" - Men's Journal
Get functional fitness workouts and training programs designed to optimize athleticism and increase mental toughness, all from your phone, in the gym, at your home or on the go! This is the #1 home workout and fitness training program for mountain athletes and backcountry hunters, and it’s the most trusted resource for military workout training. Built by dedicated mountain athletes and elite military operators, all workouts are effective and scientifically proven.
MTNTOUGH is more than an exercise workout program; it is a worldwide online community of tens of thousands like-minded individuals dedicated to physical and mental strength. MTNTOUGH also believes mental toughness is just as important as physical strength and that the strongest muscle in the human body is the one between your ears.
MTNTOUGH offers an innovative workout of the day (WOD) program through Daily Minimal Gear workouts, new every weekday, and consisting of exercises utilizing a kettle bell, dumbbells, a pull-up bar, a stepup box, body weight workout training,and varying styles of amrap, emom, and HIIT (high-intensity interval training). Designed to be the best workouts for men, and unlike Crossfit, our training programs and WODs are safe, designed to keep you healthy and ready for life or for mountain expedition adventures focusing on muscular endurance exercises with diverse ROM movements.
Get unlimited access to all MTNTOUGH functional fitness exercise programs, daily workouts, mental toughness training, and bonus content with the MTNTOUGH+ subscription. Complete with hundreds of physically and mentally demanding, effective fitness workout routines, you can choose from a variety of extended and daily workout programs to fit your schedule that can be done at home, on the road, or in the gym, including bodyweight workouts, kettle bell workouts, interval training, and mobility training. New releases are constantly added so you never get bored of doing the same old exercise routine.
With a fitness coaching staff of former Navy SEALs, Army Rangers, and renowned physical trainers, the workouts aren’t easy. The goal is to prepare clients for both the unthinkable and the everyday — to have the mental capacity and physical stamina to self-rescue in an emergency or grind through a 12-hour workday and still play with the kids after dinner.
FEATURES
> You can start your functional fitness training immediately after subscribing with your login into "MTNTOUGH+". Workouts & bonus content are accessible on any device.
> Dive into your prescribed workout of the day based on your fitness level.
> Exercise guidance for beginner, intermediate or elite levels.
> MTNTOUGH+ allows you to perform training programs with expert coaching: our veteran team of expert coaches & trainers will lead, push & challenge you.
> All workout & fitness programs are delivered in instructional videos and text descriptions. Form videos are searchable for your convenience.
MTNTOUGH offers monthly or yearly subscriptions purchased in-app, with pricing shown before checkout. Subscriptions auto-renew through your iTunes account unless disabled at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Your account is charged within 24 hours of renewal, and any remaining free-trial time is forfeited once payment starts. Manage or cancel in Account Settings.
MTNTOUGH+ also integrates with Apple Watch so you can track workouts, view heart rate and calories during training, sync data to Apple Health and the Fitness app for daily goals, close Activity Rings, and use the watch as a remote to play, pause, or rewind workout videos. Install through the iPhone Watch app.
Terms: https://lab.mtntough.com/tos
Privacy: https://lab.mtntough.com/privacy

bluejetty:00163010:ios.description:
ARKitchen – Virtual Kitchen Planner & 3D Design Visualizer
Design, build, and renovate your dream kitchen in minutes with ARKitchen – the ultimate virtual kitchen planner powered by 3D, AR, and Lidar scan technology. Whether you're going for a full makeover or just refreshing your cabinet style and counter surfaces, ARKitchen helps you bring your kitchen design ideas to life like never before.
Real-Time Kitchen Makeover with Augmented Reality
Give your kitchen a brand new look without lifting a hammer! With our advanced AR visualizer, you can overlay new layouts, cabinets, and counters directly onto your existing kitchen using your smartphone camera. Walk around your room and see your design from every angle, all in real time.
Supported on ARKit devices (iPhone 6s and newer, iPad mini 5th gen, iPad Air 3rd gen and later).
Precision Lidar Scan for Accurate Floor and Room Plans
Use Lidar scan technology (available on iOS Pro devices) to scan your floor and record accurate room dimensions. Instantly generate a detailed floor plan with perfect measurements – the first step in any smart renovation project. Say goodbye to tape measures and guesswork!
Endless Customization – Cabinet Colours, Counters & More
Explore stunning kitchen design possibilities by customizing your cabinet styles, changing counter textures, and experimenting with different layout options. This intuitive interior design app helps you visualize the full transformation before committing to a makeover.
AI-Powered Interior Planner with Smart Suggestions
Let our AI-powered planner do the heavy lifting. Based on your floor plan, ARKitchen automatically recommends smart layout and design solutions. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned designer, our AI tools help you unlock stunning new ideas with just a few taps.
Choose the Right Mode for Your Project
Classic AR Mode: Use your phone’s camera to virtually add and move kitchen elements with real-time feedback.
Lidar Scan Mode: Scan any room with Lidar to instantly generate a detailed 3D floor plan.
3D Design Mode: Play with cabinet shapes and configurations in a fully interactive 3D environment.
2D Planner Mode: Drag and drop cabinets, counters, and walls to map out your dream layout from scratch.
Designed for DIYers, Homeowners & Interior Designers
Whether you’re planning to renovate a small kitchen or do a full home makeover, ARKitchen is built for homeowners, contractors, and interior design pros alike. Save money and time by planning smarter. Avoid renovation mistakes by previewing your ideas in full 3D before you build.
Download ARKitchen Today – Try It FREE!
Ready to start your dream kitchen makeover? Download ARKitchen now and become your own virtual planner, designer, and builder. Experience powerful 3D and AR design tools all in one beautifully designed app.
Build. Visualize. Renovate. Your dream kitchen starts here.

bluejetty:00153529:ios.description:
Built for Carnivores. Powered by AI.
Most diet apps are made for counting calories and tracking carbs. This app is different. Carnivore Diet App Tracker Max is built from the ground up for people who thrive on meat, fat, and strength.
Whether you're following a strict carnivore diet, a high-fat zero-carb protocol, or just cutting the nonsense out of your meals—this app is designed to help you stay consistent, focused, and on track.
No fluff. No distractions. Just meat, movement, and measurable progress.
AI Food Scan
Take a photo of your plate—our AI recognizes meat-based meals and instantly logs your food. No typing. No searching. Get accurate macros with one tap.
Workout Tracking
Track your workouts in seconds. Log strength training, cardio, or custom routines. Stay accountable and see your progress over time.
Fasting Timer
Stay in control of your fasting windows. Whether you follow intermittent fasting, OMAD, or extended fasts, the app tracks it all and keeps you on schedule.
Macro and Weight Tracking
See exactly how your protein and fat intake evolve over time. Track your weight alongside your meals and workouts to stay aligned with your goals.
Clean, Fast Interface
No bloated features. No ads. Just a fast, distraction-free experience focused on what matters: results.
Daily Streaks and Progress
Keep the momentum going. Track your habits and build streaks that motivate you to stay consistent day after day.
Why This App?
Other diet trackers force you to sort through carbs, grains, and processed foods. This app is purpose-built for carnivore eaters. No carb-heavy recommendations. No unnecessary noise. Just the features you need to stay true to your diet and optimize your lifestyle.
It’s not about perfection. It’s about consistency. And this app helps you get there with less effort and more confidence.
Who It’s For:
Carnivore diet followers
Zero-carb and high-fat eaters
Intermittent fasting and OMAD practitioners
Lifters, athletes, and anyone tracking strength and performance
Busy people who want fast, intelligent tracking without friction
You focus on eating clean and living strong.
We’ll handle the tracking.
Download Carnivore Diet App Tracker Max and take full control of your nutrition, fasting, and fitness—all in one place.

bluejetty:00118767:ios.description:
We at AutoScout24 offer you countless offers for the purchase and sale of your new or used car in Switzerland. From the affordable small car for the city to the spacious SUV for the family to the exclusive sports car, your every wish will be fulfilled. With more than 20 years of expertise, we make buying and selling cars and used cars fast and easy for you! You want to learn more? Then find the most important features of our app in detail here. 
Detailed filtering function
With our filter functions searching is easy 
Customize your search results with the most frequently selected criteria, for example, year of manufacture, price or engine power. 
Or use our individual filters for even more specific results.
Convenient radius search
You want to buy your car in your area? Use our radius search to define the radius in which interesting vehicles should be displayed.
Find your local dealer
Automated car search
Set search criteria for the desired passenger car once and we will automatically save them for you.
Don't miss any new and relevant ads with our push notifications.
Variety of offers
Explore our listings for new and used cars of all brands.
Discover German brands, such as Audi, BMW, Opel, Volkswagen or Mercedes, as well as US cars, such as Ford, Chevrolet or Dodge and Asian cars, such as Nissan, Hyundai or Subaru.
Find luxury sports cars, such as Porsche and Ferrari, or commercial vehicles, trucks and trailers, motor homes as well as caravans and, of course, electric vehicles.
Extensive detail views
Get all vehicle data and images at a glance.
Contact the seller quickly and easily.
Cross-device favorites list
Save interesting vehicles to your watchlist and sync them across all your devices.
Useful additional info
For each car we offer you helpful additional data, e.g. on insurance, financing or leasing.
Professional customer service
Contact our customer service via e-mail or phone 
We are at your disposal at helpdesk@autoscout24.ch or 
by phone +41 (0) 31 744 17 37
You can find out more about AutoScout24 Switzerland and our app at:

bluejetty:00157195:ios.name: Genomapp: Raw DNA Analysis
bluejetty:00157195:ios.summary: Make sense of your DNA test data and discover what your genes can tell you. Genomapp is a specialized genetic reference tool that cross-references your information with public databases of scientific studies to present findings in a visual,
bluejetty:00157195:ios.description:
Make sense of your DNA test data and discover what your genes can tell you. Genomapp is a specialized genetic reference tool that cross-references your information with public databases of scientific studies to present findings in a visual, intuitive way.
Have you taken a DNA test? Did you know your genome has a lot to say? Want to learn more about your DNA? It is easier than you think.
*** Compatible with Ancestry & 23andMe
If you already have a raw DNA data file from services like 23andMe, AncestryDNA, FTDNA, or MyHeritage, you can safely use it. Genomapp provides a personalized genetic exploration of your AncestryDNA or 23andMe results. Our tool quickly identifies thousands of genetic markers (SNPs) and shows health associations found in scientific evidence.
*** Privacy & Security (100% On-Device)
Protecting your privacy is our primary concern.
• Your data remains on your device.
• Genetic files are not stored on or uploaded to our servers.
• We do NOT share genetic data with third parties.
*** Ready to start?
Genomapp has a Demo mode. If you want to try the app or learn how it works, you can access a fully functional version for free.
*** What does Genomapp offer?
We offer 3 free reports and 3 premium reports:
• Complex Diseases: Literature on markers associated with multifactorial conditions (genetic and environmental factors).
• Inherited Conditions: Scientific records on markers related to diseases that are caused by mutations in a single gene.
• Pharmacological Compounds: Drug-marker associations found in peer-reviewed scientific studies.
• Genetic Traits: Characteristics or attributes expressed by your genes.
• Observable Signs: Understand markers related to physical signs.
• Blood Groups: Literature-relevant markers for transfusions or pregnancy.
*** Specialized genetic insights
• Methylation & MTHFR: Focused on metabolic health research, folate, and the MTHFR gene.
• Aging & Longevity: Explore the genetic markers mentioned in studies about aging mechanisms.
*** Certification
The app has been reviewed by the mHealth.cat Office (TIC Salut Social Foundation). This means that the quality of the content and the usefulness of the functions have been evaluated, meeting reliability requirements for health-related educational content.
*** Not diagnostic
Please note that Genomapp is a medical reference and educational tool. It is NOT for diagnostic use and does not provide medical advice or clinical decision support. Always consult your healthcare professional for any medical concerns.
*** Our database
Search our database of more than 9,500 conditions, 12,400 genes, and 180,000 genetic markers. Our tool facilitates access to research on a comprehensive list of conditions from scientific sources, including breast cancer, Alzheimer's, and Parkinson's. It also indexes literature for tumor suppressor genes such as BRCA, PTEN, and P53.
*** Easy to Understand
Genomapp displays your DNA markers in a friendly way. Export your personalized genetic reports to PDF for your personal research and records to take them anywhere.
*** Supported DNA Providers
We are constantly adding support for new providers. Currently, you can use files from 23andMe, AncestryDNA, FTDNA, MyHeritage, Genes for Good, LivingDNA, Geno 2.0, and other DTC genetic testing companies. Genomapp also supports VCF format files and specific schemes. (Note: VCF files from WES/WGS are currently not compatible).
Try Genomapp now and unlock your DNA analysis!

No more manual organization of media files. Forward automatically categorizes and manages your media content through AI, intelligently recognizing information such as movies, series, seasons, and episodes, and fetching metadata, covers, and trailers from trusted sources like TMDB, keeping your media library neat and visually appealing.

Load resources from cloud storage, Emby, Jellyfin, modules, and Stremio all at once, entering an enjoyable viewing experience at the fastest speed.

A fully customizable homepage, both in content and style, that is pleasing to the eye. It is the perfect choice before watching.

A carefully designed interaction and user interface focused on usability and aesthetics. bluejetty:00182959:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00182959:ios.description:
The phenomenally popular DRAGON QUEST VIII has sold 4.9 million units worldwide, and now it's coming to the iPhone and iPad for the first time!
This was the first title in the series to be presented in full 3D, and its exquisitely detailed world has to be seen to be believed!
Set off on an unforgettable adventure with Yangus, the bandit with a heart of gold, Jessica, the high-born magical minx, and Angelo, knight and lothario, by your side!
Everything you need is here in a single package!
Once the app is downloaded, there's no more to pay, as every last shred of content is yours to enjoy.
So get ready to play the epic that is DRAGON QUEST VIII from beginning to end—and far beyond!
Prologue
Legends tell of an ancient sceptre, within which is sealed a fearsome power...
When the relic's long-dormant magics are awoken by the treachery of a malign magician, an entire kingdom falls into a cursed slumber, prompting a young soldier to embark on an unforgettable journey...
Game Features
– Simple, Accessible Controls
The control system has been streamlined to work perfectly with modern touch interfaces.
The position of the directional pad can be adjusted freely, enabling players to switch between one-handed and two-handed play with a tap of the screen.
The combat system has also been reworked, allowing for one-tap battles as well as more complex play.
– The Tension System
During battle, you can select 'Psyche Up' to give your next attack some extra oomph!
The more you psyche a character up, the higher their tension will rise, until they finally reach an insane state known as super-high tension!
– Skill Points
Skill points are earned when your characters level up, and can be assigned to various skills in order to learn new spells and abilities.
This system allows you to perfectly tailor your team to your liking.
– Monster Teams
Certain monsters found in the field can be scouted for your monster team – if you're tough enough to beat them, that is!
Once assembled, your crack squad can take part in the fiercely contested tournaments held at the monster arena, and can even come to your aid in battle!
– The Alchemy Pot
Combine existing items to create entirely new ones!
Even the most unassuming objects could be ingredients for the greatest items of all!
Seek out the recipes hidden all over the world, and see if you can cook up something truly special!
– The Casino
Fans of the series will be pleased to learn that the casino is back, and fully-equipped for fun!
This time around, there are three exciting activities to enjoy: bingo, slot machines and roulette!
Just don't get so caught up in the action that you forget your adventure entirely!
[Supported Operating Systems]
iOS15.0 and Above
[Supported Devices]
iPhone 6s or Higher/iPad (5th Generation or Better)

bluejetty:00084924:ios.name: Camy — Live Video Monitoring
bluejetty:00084924:ios.summary: Camy turns your phones and tablets into a live stream video surveillance system. You can connect to another phone from anywhere if you have Internet access. Camy makes it possible to monitor your home or office without purchasing special eq
bluejetty:00084924:ios.description:
Camy turns your phones and tablets into a live stream video surveillance system. You can connect to another phone from anywhere if you have Internet access. Camy makes it possible to monitor your home or office without purchasing special equipment. Camy will help you monitor your child, help you watch your cat or dog, or simply show who is currently at home. The motion detector will ensure the safety of your home from intruders, instantly notifying you about it.
Camy is an app that will make a camera from the phone for remote video surveillance. You can set your phone as a camera or viewing device. Alternatively, you can enter the web address into your browser and watch the live video stream on your PC (soon).
Functional:
- Stream high-quality video
- Ability to connect multiple cameras (phones) [Available in Premium version]
- Ability to simultaneously connect with multiple viewers
- Video recording
- Motion detector and notification of this + the ability to automatically record video to the cloud [Available in Premium version]
- Information about the stream, frame rate, bit rate, and image size
- Switch between front and rear cameras
- Ability to answer the camera on the speakerphone "View and talk."
- Ability to rotate the image
- Remote flashlight on
- Ability to take screenshots
- Ability to zoom in
- Night mode
- Web version
- Apple TV
In the process:
- Ability to connect an IP-camera / webcam
- Any ideas what else to add? Email to my@camy.cam
Camy offers Premium service as a recurring subscription.
Subscription information:
- There are two types of subscription to Camy Premium. The duration of the subscription can be a month or a year. In a premium subscription, you can add an unlimited number of zones and family members. Also in the Premium subscription is available a history for the month.
- Payments will be credited to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews if automatic renewal is not turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and determine the cost of renewal
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and automatic updating can be disabled by going to the user account settings after purchasing
- Any unused part of the free trial period, if offered, will be confiscated when the user purchases a subscription to this publication, if applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/camyios/privacy
Terms: https://zipoapps.com/camyios/terms

bluejetty:00187578:ios.name: HSBC UK Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00187578:ios.summary:
The HSBC UK Mobile Banking app has been created to help our UK customers with their everyday banking on the go. Download it today and you can:
• Log on quickly and securely with Face ID or Touch ID
• Make payments and check your balances on
bluejetty:00187578:ios.description:
The HSBC UK Mobile Banking app has been created to help our UK customers with their everyday banking on the go. Download it today and you can:
• Log on quickly and securely with Face ID or Touch ID
• Make payments and check your balances on the go
• Pay in one or more cheques up to a limit of £2,000 per day
• View or cancel standing orders and Direct Debits
• Freeze, report lost and order a replacement card
• View your debit or credit card PIN
• Stay in control with our Spending insights
• View and manage bills easily with Balance Forecast.
How to log on to Mobile Banking
• If you’re registered for HSBC Online Banking, you can use your existing details
• If you’re not yet registered, simply download the app, then select ‘Register now’.
Access all your essential banking services on the go. Download the HSBC UK Mobile Banking app today.
Want to know more?
Log on quickly and securely
Face ID and Touch ID mean you can use your face or fingerprint to quickly log on to the HSBC UK Mobile Banking app, without having to enter a password.
Once you’re logged on, your Mobile Banking PIN adds another layer of protection against fraud. To authorise new transactions, use your Mobile Banking PIN or biometrics on supported devices.
Send money
The HSBC UK Mobile Banking app lets you send money to family or friends using their account details. Pay bills with pre-populated bank details for hundreds of major businesses. And instantly transfer money between your personal accounts.
Mobile statements
With the HSBC UK Mobile Banking app, you can securely access your current account, savings and credit card statements.
Mobile cheque deposits
The HSBC UK Mobile Banking app lets you pay in cheques without going to a branch by selecting the account, entering the value then scanning the front and back of the cheque. Please keep any cheques until they show in your account. You can pay in one or more cheques up to a limit of £2,000 per day. Cheques deposited before 10pm on a working day will be available by 11:59pm the next working day.
Freeze your card
Ever lost your card, only for it to turn up the moment you cancelled it? With the HSBC UK Mobile Banking app, you can place a temporary block on your card with just a few taps. It will stay blocked until you unblock it, or it can be reported as lost or stolen.
Balance After Bills
Balance After Bills helps you plan your finances from one payday to the next. It shows you how much you could have left for the month ahead, once scheduled bills like standing orders, Direct Debits, credit cards, loans and mortgages are taken into account.
Chat with us
Need help or assistance? Select the ‘Start chat’ window on the home screen or tap 'Chat with us' in the ‘Library’. If you have push notifications enabled for the HSBC Mobile Banking app, we’ll send you an alert when we reply. 
Gambling restriction
You can choose to restrict transactions made to gambling businesses, such as casinos and online betting companies, and recurring transactions such as The Postcode Lottery. The block only applies to individual cards held in your name.
This App is designed for use in the United Kingdom. The products and services described in this App are intended for UK customers. This App is provided by HSBC UK Bank Plc ('HSBC UK') for the use of existing customers of HSBC UK. Please do not download this App if you are not an existing customer of HSBC UK. HSBC UK is authorised and regulated in the United Kingdom by the Financial Conduct Authority. If you are outside the UK, we may not be authorised to offer or provide you with the products and services available through this App in the country or region where you are located or resident in. This App is not intended for distribution, download or use by any person in any jurisdiction, country or region where the distribution, download or use of this material is restricted and would not be permitted by law or regulation.

● Translations in 14+ languages — see translations in your native language
● Export, copy & print — share conjugation tables via email, clipboard, or print

● iPad optimised — full support for iPad including landscape split-screen view
● Regular & irregular verb indicators — quickly see whether a verb follows standard patterns

bluejetty:00025760:ios.description:
Introducing AI Story Generator Writer: Your Ultimate Storytelling Companion!
Unleash your creativity and embark on a journey of storytelling like never before with AI Story Writer. This innovative app harnesses the power of artificial intelligence to assist you in crafting captivating stories effortlessly. Whether you're an aspiring author, a seasoned writer, or simply someone who loves to spin tales, this app is your key to unlocking unlimited storytelling potential.
Key Benefits:
1. AI-Powered Story Generator: Let the app's advanced AI algorithms generate unique and engaging story ideas for you. With just a few taps, you'll have a well-crafted storyline to ignite your imagination.
2. Intelligent Character Development: Develop compelling characters that come to life on the page. AI Story Writer suggests detailed character traits, backstories, and motivations, ensuring your characters are rich and relatable.
3. Dynamic Plot Suggestions/ Plot Twist Generator: Break free from writer's block! The app provides dynamic plot suggestions to keep your story moving forward. Explore various genres and plot twists to create enthralling narratives.
4. Grammar and Style Enhancement: Never worry about typos or grammar mistakes again. AI Story Writer's built-in grammar checker and style enhancer offer real-time suggestions to refine your writing and elevate it to professional standards.
5. Story Writing Structure Guidance: Craft well-structured stories with ease. The app offers guidance on story arcs, pacing, and plot development, helping you create narratives that captivate your readers from start to finish.
6. Versatile Story Writing Tools: Whether you prefer typing or dictating, AI Story Writer adapts to your preferred writing style. Take notes, outline ideas, or draft entire stories seamlessly within the app.
7. Stories Reader - Create and read unique stories of any genre on the go with just one tap
Key Features:
- AI-generated story ideas and prompts
- Detailed character development suggestions
- Dynamic plot twists and suggestions
- Grammar and style checker for error-free writing
- Story structure guidance and pacing assistance
- Note-taking and outlining tools
- Customizable story templates for quick inspiration
- Seamless integration with popular writing apps and platforms
Discover a whole new world of storytelling possibilities with AI Story Writer. Fuel your creativity, overcome writer's block, and create unforgettable tales with the help of artificial intelligence. 
Free trials and subscriptions
• Try out all paid features free for 3 days 
• You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase.

• Pro Weekly - 1 week ($5.99), Pro Yearly - 1 Year ($29.99) durations, Premium Lifetime - 49.99 for lifetime duration. Advance - Pro - Weekly $8.99 , Advance Pro Yearly -$79.99
