bluejetty:00026338:ios.name: Controller for HomeKit
bluejetty:00026338:ios.summary: Get more out of your smart home. Your HomeKit and Matter devices can do more than on and off: Controller for HomeKit gives you dashboards you build yourself, workflows that run over several steps, months of history, and a floor plan you con
bluejetty:00026338:ios.description:
Get more out of your smart home. Your HomeKit and Matter devices can do more than on and off: Controller for HomeKit gives you dashboards you build yourself, workflows that run over several steps, months of history, and a floor plan you control directly.
YOUR OWN DASHBOARD
Your devices sit where you need them, instead of in a list.
- Views you compose yourself from tiles: per home, per person, and if you want, per device. One for the iPad on the wall, one for the iPhone in your pocket.
- More than 25 tile variants: devices, scenes, workflows, time, weather, calendar, charts, battery warnings.
- Five standard sizes, or drag your own size on the grid.
- Visibility conditions: a tile or a whole section appears only when you need it.
- Plus widgets for your Home Screen and a view of your own on Apple Watch.
CONTROLLER AI
Describe what you need in plain language: a dashboard, a scene, an automation or a workflow. Controller builds it, and you adjust it however you like afterwards.
MORE THAN A SCHEDULE
Two devices become a sequence that thinks along.
- Workflows: multiple steps, conditions and branches for sequences a single automation cannot express.
- Automations with advanced triggers and conditions.
- States: virtual switches that capture how your home currently stands and drive your workflows accordingly.
- Custom notifications for anything you want to know about.
- NFC tags: one tap and the workflow runs.
YOUR SENSORS ARE ALREADY MEASURING
Controller remembers the values and makes them readable.
- Charts: see how temperature, humidity or battery level develop over weeks and months, across every device and brand.
- Maintenance: which battery is empty, which device is unreachable, which automation is broken.
- Logs: every activity and every change, traceable.
- Smart folders: devices and automations grouped by filters you define.
- Floor Plan: scan your home with the LiDAR sensor of your iPhone or iPad and control your devices right on the plan.
- Controller Hub: a dedicated iPhone, iPad, Apple TV or Mac runs your workflows automatically. Charts and States require Controller Hub.
SHARE THE WORK, NOT JUST THE SWITCHES
- Home Sharing: pass your entire setup to the people you live with. For each person you choose between the whole app or only the dashboards you share with them.
- Setup codes: your HomeKit and Matter codes stay safe in the app and never get lost.
- Backups: save your setup and restore it whenever you need to.
Controller for HomeKit runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Apple TV.
You already own the devices. Controller for HomeKit brings out what is in them.
More on our website: https://www.controllerforhomekit.com
Privacy Policy:
https://controllerforhomekit.com/privacy/
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00079515:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00079515:ios.description:
Can't agree on a baby name? Baby Name Together turns it into a game for two.
You and your partner each swipe through 30,000+ boy, girl and unisex names from 40+ countries, privately, on your own phones. When you both swipe right on the same name, it's a match. No arguments, no vetoes: just the baby names you both love.
Now with the AI List, which learns from your swipes, and an AI name assistant. Over 2 million downloads worldwide.
SWIPE RIGHT ON NAMES YOU LOVE
Swipe right if you like a baby name, or left if you don't. Each parent swipes on their own, so nobody feels pressured.
BOY, GIRL & UNISEX NAMES
Blue for boy names, pink for girl names, and purple for gender-neutral and unisex names.
MATCH WITH YOUR PARTNER
Link your accounts in seconds with a QR code, an invitation code or a link. Every name you both like appears in your Matches.
CHOOSE THE ONE TOGETHER
See the names you both love and choose THE one from your shortlist.
AI LIST (NEW)
The AI List picks every card for you and your partner and gets better with each swipe, so the names you're both most likely to love come first. It learned from 380 million real choices made by parents, and your data is never sent to ChatGPT. Set the style from classic to rare. Included in Pro.
AI NAME ASSISTANT
Chat with our AI name assistant for personalized suggestions, sibling name ideas and names by meaning or theme. Tap the sparkle icon on any match to see why you both love it. Try it for free, and go Pro for unlimited AI.
TOP 50 BABY NAMES
Check the top 50 baby names in many countries.
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY OF PARENTS
- Join a forum for parents and talk about names, pregnancy and parenthood
- Discover and add names shared by moms, dads and parents-to-be
- Create a poll and let friends, family or other parents vote on your favorite names
30,000+ BABY NAMES
30,000 baby names and counting, with new ones added regularly. Find original, cool, unusual and unique girl and boy names.
SMART FILTERS
Filter by gender (boy, girl, unisex), first or last letter, length, origin or theme to see only the names YOU love.
BABY ANNOUNCEMENT CARDS
Ready, set, glow! Announce your baby's arrival with customizable cards for gender reveal parties, baby showers and the birth.
NAME MEANING, ORIGIN & STATS
Find each name's meaning, statistics per country, popularity, average age and famous people who share it.
HEAR NAME PRONUNCIATION
Listen to the pronunciation of each name in different languages.
BABY NAME NEWS
Stay up to date on baby name news: celebrity baby names, trending names, gender-neutral names and more.
COLLABORATE WITH FAMILY (PRO)
Want your kids or grandparents to weigh in? Link up to 3 more people besides your partner. Try names with a middle name or your last name, and unlock 29+ themed lists. All of that and more comes with Pro.
SYNC ACROSS ALL DEVICES (PRO)
Use your lists on all your devices: phone, tablet and web.
CLOUD BACKUP (PRO)
Your name list is saved online and can be retrieved for your next baby.
---
Baby Name Together Pro is available as a one-time purchase with lifetime access or as a monthly auto-renewing subscription. Prices in your local currency are shown in the app before you buy.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.babynametogether.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.babynametogether.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00035272:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00035272:ios.description:
Blind Bag Lucky is a unique and interesting entertainment game where players must rely on judgment and luck to win. This game often appears in fairs, festivals or crowded gatherings.
Game description:
Number of players: From 2 to many people.
Equipment: Small bags (usually made of cloth or paper) are tied tightly and hung on a string or placed in a large box. Inside each bag are random items, which can be small gifts, toys, coins, or even worthless items (to create drama and surprise).
How to play:
1. Choose your wish and the number of blind bags you want.
2. Open the blind bags
3. If the blind bag opens a gift that matches your wish, you get 1 more blind bag. If you open any pair of gifts, you get 1 more blind bag.
4. Continue opening until all the blind bags are gone.
The game "Blind Bag Tearing" does not require high skills, but is mainly based on luck, bringing light and interesting entertainment for all ages.
If you like this game, please rate it and leave a comment. I am an indie game developer and your support means a lot to me! Thank you for your help! 
If you don't like something in the game, please email us or on support the fanpage and tell us why. I want to hear your feedback and comments so I can continue to make this game better.
Enjoy it ^^

bluejetty:00035249:ios.description:
Welcome to Woodoku Blast: The Mesmerizing Colorful Block Puzzle Game!
Prepare yourself for an addictive puzzle adventure like no other! Woodoku Blast is here to captivate your senses and challenge your puzzle-solving skills. Dive into a world of vibrant colors, creative challenges, and endless block puzzle fun – all in the palm of your hand.
Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master:
Woodoku Blast's simple and intuitive gameplay makes becoming a block master accessible to players of all ages. Place colorful blocks on the block puzzle grid, clear lines, and score points to progress through the levels. But don't be fooled by its ease; as you advance, the block games become more intricate, requiring strategic thinking and clever moves to conquer. Can you rise to the challenge and become the block master?
Boundless Levels of Colorful Fun:
With a vast array of levels, Woodoku Blast ensures you'll never run out of exciting block games to solve. Explore diverse landscapes and themes, from tranquil gardens to futuristic cities, each offering a unique and immersive puzzle-solving experience.
Relax and Recharge:
Need a break? Woodoku Blast offers a soothing and meditative puzzle experience. Unwind, clear your mind, and recharge your mental energy while surrounded by delightful visuals and calming sounds.
Stay Tuned for Exciting Events:
The fun never stops in Woodoku Blast! Keep an eye out for thrilling events, limited-time challenges, and exclusive rewards. Participate to put your skills to the test and earn unique prizes that set you apart as a Woodoku Blast block master!

Keep your business moving with these available features and capabilities on supported devices:
• Check account balances
• View recent account activity
• Search transactions by date, amount, or check number
• View deposit history

bluejetty:00088739:ios.description:
CONNECT WITH COFOUNDERS, EARLY HIRES & BUILDERS
CoffeeSpace is the leading mobile platform for early startup team formation, helping founders connect with cofounders, first hires, and entrepreneurial talent who share their vision.
Whether you’re exploring an idea or actively scaling, CoffeeSpace makes it easy to find mission-aligned teammates through AI-powered recommendations, thoughtful prompts, and high-signal filters.
Trusted by 20,000+ builders, CoffeeSpace connects innovators, engineers, designers, operators, and recruiters across the globe.
From Silicon Valley to London, Bangalore to Singapore – join the world’s fastest-growing network for startup founders and early talent.
HOW COFFEESPACE HELPS YOU BUILD (OR JOIN) A STARTUP TEAM
Whether you’re building a company from scratch or looking to join one at the earliest stage, CoffeeSpace is your gateway to mission-aligned collaborators in the startup, tech, and entrepreneurship ecosystem.
* Dual-Sided Matching: We connect people who are actively looking for each other, not just who meet your filters. Whether you’re a founder searching for a cofounder or first hire, or a builder looking to join a team, every match is designed for mutual fit.
* AI-Powered Daily Recommendations: Receive curated matches every day based on your goals, experience, and stage. Our semantic matching engine looks beyond job titles and keywords to surface people who align on vision, mindset, and momentum.
* Thoughtful Prompts: Go deeper than resumes. Learn how people think, work, and build through guided prompts that uncover values, communication styles, and startup chemistr; the things that actually matter in early-stage teams.
* Granular Filters: Search by skills, location, commitment level, industry, and role – whether you’re looking for a cofounder, founding engineer, designer, operator, or simply someone to explore ideas with.
* Transparent Invites & Reply Reminders: See exactly who’s reaching out and why. No anonymous invites. No guessing games. Plus, smart reply nudges keep your conversations moving forward, not lost in the void.
JOIN THE NEXT GENERATION OF BUILDERS
CoffeeSpace is the only platform purpose-built for early-stage team formation. Whether you’re assembling your dream team or looking to join one, this is where high-signal startup journeys begin.

bluejetty:00071634:ios.name: Yango: taxi, food, delivery
bluejetty:00071634:ios.summary:
Yango is an easy-to-use app for getting around the city
Fill your life with movement. Get the whole city in your hands, ride wherever you want, and enjoy comfort at an affordable price. With Yango, everything is possible!
Choose the right
bluejetty:00071634:ios.description:
Yango is an easy-to-use app for getting around the city
Fill your life with movement. Get the whole city in your hands, ride wherever you want, and enjoy comfort at an affordable price. With Yango, everything is possible!
Choose the right service class for you
Reach your destination at the right level of comfort and price for you. Choose from several service classes. Economy is awesome for when you need a ride fast. Comfort lets you sit back and just enjoy the ride. And The Fastest is the best in case when the service class doesn’t matter and you just need the closest ride available!
Ride safely
Safety is our top priority. You’ll see who’s coming to pick you up and in which car right in the app. You’ll see info about the driver, such as their name and rating, and will be able to share your route with whomever you like so they know where you are.
Smart destinations
Yango will suggest destinations for your rides based on your ride history, like first offering ‘home’ as a destination because it’s your most common request on weekday evenings. Ride the smart way!
Multiple destinations, one route
Yango makes everyday life super easy. Like picking the kids up from school, dropping a friend off at a market, and doing some quick shopping on the way. Just add a new stop in the app, and Yango will recalculate a new route for the driver. 
Request rides for close ones
Show you care by requesting rides for friends and relatives. Get your mother to a doctor’s appointment, book a ride to pick up your special someone, or get each of your friends a ride home after a night out. You can request up to 3 cars at once.
Refer friends and get discounts
Invite friends to try Yango and save together. Share your personal promo code, get a discount on your next ride and grant your friend with an extra discount on their first ride. It’s as easy as that.
Meet Delivery - it's like a taxi service, but for your packages
We've also built in a fast delivery service into Yango - use Delivery to quickly send personal packages or even business orders by courier anywhere in the city. Delivery is suitable for any item that can be transported by scooter or car. 
An international service
Yango is a ride-hailing, mobility, and delivery aggregator service that operates in more than 20 countries around the world, including Ghana, Cote d'Ivoire, Cameroon, Senegal and Zambia.
Yango is an informational service and not a transportation or taxi services provider. Transportation services are provided by third parties.
The size and duration of the discount for the first rides requested via the Yango app vary depending on the country and city. Open the app for specific details.
Privacy Policy:
https://yango.com/legal/yango_privacy_notice
Yango Plus subscription conditions:
https://deli.yango.com/en-IL/about/docs/legal/yango_plus_conditions

bluejetty:00054595:ios.description:
Are you a passionate ultimate team fan? Do you want to craft your custom cards with extensive customization options and assemble your dream squad while keeping an eye on the latest player prices?
Introducing FC 25 by FUTNET, the ultimate companion app for football enthusiasts, complete with a robust squad builder and card creator. Harness the power of our user-friendly squad builder, driven by real-time player prices, to forge your dream team. Alternatively, dive into our card creator to design and share unique player cards, teams, and packs, all while engaging with fellow football fans worldwide.  
◉ ALL-IN-ONE APP EXPERIENCE 
Fine-tune your searches with filters to discover cards that perfectly fit your squad or squad-building challenges (SBC). Explore card attributes and pricing details. Join discussions with the football community and share your discoveries with friends.
Craft multiple squads effortlessly using our intuitive squad builder, then share and compare them with your friends. Personalize your profile, showcasing your weekend league achievements, rewards, top pack openings, best drafts and media content. Stay updated with your friends' activities.
  -------------------------------------------- FUTNET 25 FEATURES --------------------------------------------
 ►AI CARD CREATOR & CONTENT EDITOR 
Unleash your creativity using our comprehensive content editor and card creator. You have full control to edit every aspect of player cards, squads, and more. Modify player names, incorporate personal images, and craft entirely unique cards using our intuitive card builder. Whether you're refining draft cards to your satisfaction or creating memorable moments with friends, Futnet 25 empowers you with complete pack customization capabilities. Utilize filters to streamline your card searches and discover the perfect players for your dream team.
► FUT QUIZ
Do you think you know everything about football players and their FC cards? Then try the FUT quiz mode and prove it! Compete with other users in the weekly, monthly, and all-time standings. How many players can you guess?
►INSTANT CARD UPDATES 
Stay ahead with instant updates as new cards are released. Keep your teams up to date using the squad creator. As dedicated football and esports fans, we guarantee regular updates. 
►COMPANION APP 
Discover our versatile companion app, loaded with a wide array of features. Explore the social aspects and much more, unlocking premium features to enhance your experience. Join our enthusiastic community and enjoy the full potential of our app.  
►FANTASY SQUAD
Unlock Packs for Your Dream Team
In Fantasy Squad mode, your squad's growth brings rewards in the form of packs filled with valuable player cards. Additionally, expect weekly packs opening to consistently enhance your squad.
►REAL-TIME PLAYER PRICES
 Regular price updates enhance your trading experience on the market. Immerse yourself in the real-world management of teams, players, and cards.  
►FUTNET SQUAD BUILDER
 Build your ultimate team using any available cards and formations. Create a squad comprising your favorite team's players or assemble a superstar team with all-time greats. Our squad builder offers ultimate freedom of choice. 
►FUTNET FEED 
Explore friends' and recommended content. Gain insights into the art of squad building by discovering how soccer fans worldwide construct teams and utilize cards. Express your admiration by liking and commenting on ultimate team content. Join engaging football discussions within the thriving Futnet community. Excited about your latest pack openings and amazing cards? Share your enthusiasm with the Futnet world.
Before your next disappointment with a companion and card creator app, ensure you have one of the best social, card, and squad builder apps.
►► Get Futnet 25 now for FREE ◄◄

bluejetty:00030925:ios.description:
Access your computers from anywhere.
Screens lets you remotely access your Mac, Windows PC, Linux PC, or Raspberry Pi from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Vision Pro. Whether you’re connecting to a remote workstation, a headless Mac mini, or helping friends and family, Screens delivers fast, secure, and reliable remote desktop access wherever you are.
REMOTE ACCESS FROM ANYWHERE
Remote access is built right into Screens on Mac. For older Macs and Windows PCs, install Screens Connect to easily set up remote access over the internet. Need to connect to Linux or Raspberry Pi? Screens also integrates with Tailscale for secure, hassle-free connections.
FAST, SECURE REMOTE DESKTOP ACCESS
Screens is optimized for responsive remote control with support for:
• Curtain Mode for private remote sessions on Mac
• SSH connections and SSH keys
• Secure password storage and quick logins
• Observe or control remote computers
• Adaptive and Full display quality
BUILT FOR MODERN REMOTE WORKFLOWS
Use Screens to:
• Access remote Macs, PCs, Linux systems, and Raspberry Pi devices
• Connect to headless Mac mini setups and remote workstations
• Monitor long-running tasks from anywhere
• Help friends, family, or coworkers remotely
• Access your computers while traveling or away from home
DO MORE WITH SCREENS
Take advantage of powerful system features across iPhone and iPad:
• Connect using Siri, Shortcuts, and Spotlight
• Quickly connect to saved computers from widgets
• Use external keyboards, mice, and trackpads
• Use Apple Pencil on iPad
• Display your remote computer on an external display with AirPlay
POWERFUL FEATURES
• Multi-display support
• Clipboard sharing
• File transfer between iPhone, iPad, or Vision Pro and Mac
• Customizable connection settings for individual computers
• Dictation support for remote text input
• Session selection on Mac
• iCloud synchronization
• Full URL Schemes support
• Touch ID, Face ID, Apple Watch, and password protection
COMPATIBILITY
• Connect from iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro
• Connect to Mac, Windows PC, Linux PC, and Raspberry Pi
• Screens Connect is built into Screens for Mac on macOS 14.6 or later
• Standalone Screens Connect is available for Macs running macOS 10.13 or later and PCs running Windows 10 or later
• Clipboard sharing on Windows and Linux supports text only
• Sound transmission is not supported due to VNC protocol limitations
• Screens does not support connections to iPhone, iPad, or Vision Pro devices
Screens gives you secure, reliable access to your computers anytime, anywhere.
Privacy Policy: https://screens.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://screens.app/terms

bluejetty:00153204:ios.description:
Keeping your phone fast, organized, and clutter-free has never been easier. Phone Cleaner & File Manager helps you quickly free up storage, remove unnecessary junk, and take full control of your gallery. Clean up now with the DrClean Kit - your smart companion for a lighter phone’s gallery.
Daily Cleaning Plan
Stay on top of your storage with a personalized daily routine. The Daily Cleaning Plan guides you through small but effective steps to maintain a clean phone every day. No more overwhelming clutter - just follow the simple checklist and enjoy a consistently optimized gallery without extra effort.
Similar Photo Cleanup
Your gallery fills up faster than you think. The app scans your entire photo library to detect visually similar images - bursts, repeated shots, series of almost-identical pictures - and helps you remove the ones you no longer need. Keep only your best moments while freeing up valuable space.
Duplicate Photo Removal
Duplicate images often hide deep inside your albums, consuming storage silently. DrClean Kit identifies every exact copy and lets you delete them in one tap. You’ll be surprised how much memory you can reclaim just by clearing duplicates.
Photos with Text Filter
Screenshots, saved conversations, notes, and images with overlaid text take up a huge portion of your storage. The cleaner detects photos with text and groups them separately so you can delete outdated or unnecessary ones effortlessly.
Blurred Photos Cleanup
Never waste space on photos that didn’t turn out well. The cleaner automatically recognizes blurry, shaky, or low-quality shots and suggests removing them. Free your gallery from unusable images and keep only the content that matters.
Screenshot Detection & Cleanup
Screenshots are helpful… until they pile up. DrClean Kit finds all screenshots across your device, organizes them into a convenient list, and helps you clear the ones you no longer need. Perfect for removing old notes, receipts, and quick captures.
Similar Video Cleanup
Videos consume the most storage - especially repeated takes and similar clips. The cleaner analyzes your video library to identify near-duplicate footage and recommends which clips to remove. Reclaim gigabytes of memory with just a few taps.
More Than Just a Cleaner
Alongside powerful cleaning tools, the app includes a full suite of utilities to help you manage your device with ease. Enjoy a built-in File Manager for browsing and organizing documents, an archiver for zipping and unzipping data, converters for media formats, and much more tools. Everything you need to stay organized is right here in one place.

- Subscription auto-renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iTunes account settings. The current subscription will remain active until the end of the paid term.

Your gallery fills up faster than you think. The app scans your entire photo library to detect visually similar images - bursts, repeated shots, series of almost-identical pictures - and helps you remove the ones you no longer need. Keep only your best moments while freeing up valuable space.

Duplicate Photo Removal
Duplicate images often hide deep inside your albums, consuming storage silently. DrClean Kit identifies every exact copy and lets you delete them in one tap. You’ll be surprised how much memory you can reclaim just by clearing duplicates.

Photos with Text Filter
Screenshots, saved conversations, notes, and images with overlaid text take up a huge portion of your storage. The cleaner detects photos with text and groups them separately so you can delete outdated or unnecessary ones effortlessly.

Blurred Photos Cleanup
Never waste space on photos that didn’t turn out well. The cleaner automatically recognizes blurry, shaky, or low-quality shots and suggests removing them. Free your gallery from unusable images and keep only the content that matters.

Screenshots are helpful… until they pile up. DrClean Kit finds all screenshots across your device, organizes them into a convenient list, and helps you clear the ones you no longer need. Perfect for removing old notes, receipts, and quick captures.

Similar Video Cleanup
Videos consume the most storage - especially repeated takes and similar clips. The cleaner analyzes your video library to identify near-duplicate footage and recommends which clips to remove. Reclaim gigabytes of memory with just a few taps.

More Than Just a Cleaner
Alongside powerful cleaning tools, the app includes a full suite of utilities to help you manage your device with ease. Enjoy a built-in File Manager for browsing and organizing documents, an archiver for zipping and unzipping data, converters for media formats, and much more tools. bluejetty:00038910:ios.name: BabyTime (Record & Analysis)
bluejetty:00038910:ios.summary: BabyTime, App Store Best of 2016, is a baby activity tracker app to record all aspects of your baby’s care with a stylish, easy-to-use interface. Track and chart your baby’s developmental milestones, habits, special moments, growth, symptom
bluejetty:00038910:ios.description:
BabyTime, App Store Best of 2016, is a baby activity tracker app to record all aspects of your baby’s care with a stylish, easy-to-use interface. Track and chart your baby’s developmental milestones, habits, special moments, growth, symptoms, nursing, feedings, sleep, diaper change, and doctor visits.
KEY FEATURES:
-Track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, sleep, diaper changes, tummy time, pumping, and more.
-Record your baby’s height, weight, and head circumference and see them all in our growth chart. 
-Customize Charts to see daily, weekly, and monthly summaries of your baby’s happenings.
-Take or upload pictures, write about special milestones and share to friends and to our Public Diaries.
-Stopwatch (timer), time your baby’s feeding, breast milk pumping, and sleep!
-Apple Watch app is supported!
-Siri Shortcuts is supported! (iOS 14.1+)
-Use MusicBox to put your baby to sleep!
-Sync and backup automatically. All you need to do is sign-in and all your data will be restored.
-Multiple Caregivers for your Baby: Sync with your spouse, nanny, or childcare provider and receive instant updates to give you a peace of mind even while you are at work.
-Support multiple children at once
-Reminders and Widget of your baby’s hunger, time since the last feeding, sleep, and diaper change, and the total amount your baby has eaten. 
OTHER FEATURES:
-Dark Mode is supported on iOS 13+ devices
-Quick Memo, tired of typing out the same words over and over again? Add a Quick Memo have your words typed in just one tap
-iMessage, need to send your baby’s routine to the nanny on a fly? Have it done in a second by adding BabyTime to iMessage. 
-Fun stickers available on iMessage
BabyTime is a must-have app that provides all the essential needs for new parents and is free to download and use.
Now, how can you get started on becoming a more confident parent and ensuring health for you baby? 
Tip 1: Turn on the widget. Then set the time you want to receive reminders for breastfeeding. 
Tip 2: Try using stopwatch. Long-press record button to start with stopwatch.
GET TO KNOW US:
Web: https://www.babytime.care/
Support: support@simfler.com

Join ProductReportCard and get MORE high-paying surveys and FREE product tests than anywhere else.
Join now and enjoy over 400 surveys— all with payouts of $0.50 – $500.00— PLUS an average of 32 free product tests every month.
Companies selling these products, and many more, want to pay for your opinion:
3 simple steps to earn your first $5 RIGHT NOW:
1. Get Your FREE Account
Answer some easy questions — for example, “Do you have pets?” — and enter your email address. Done. This usually takes less than a minute.
2. Take a SHORT 5-Minute Survey
This survey helps us match you with survey and product test opportunities. The more info you provide, the more we can match you with.
3. Earn Your REWARD
Your first $5 reward is waiting for you after completing your welcome survey.

Got questions? Here are some of the most common questions that people have before joining.
What is Product Report Card?
We make it easy for you to tell companies how you really feel about their products and services. We offer you the opportunity to participate in online surveys, in-home product testing, focus groups, in-depth interviews, and more!
Why should I become a member?
Your opinions matter. It’s insights from people like you that influence the decisions big brands make when coming out with new – or improving upon existing – products and services. Additionally, you are paid for every opinion you share.
How soon can I start earning rewards?
Today! You start getting paid from the very first survey you take. When you complete or attempt a survey, your reward amount will automatically and immediately appear in your account.
How do I qualify for surveys?
The information in your ProductReportCard profile is used to see if you’re suitable for a particular survey. – so you’ll be offered more surveys, the more complete your profile is. However, some surveys need to know more and use ‘screener’ questions at the start to confirm you qualify. Don’t worry, even if you don’t qualify, you’ll still earn a $0.10 reward. And remember, you will qualify for many more.
Will I get to try out products?
You’re quite likely to be asked to take surveys which include product testing.
The most common products members are asked to test include VR games, wearable technology, hygienic-products, FOOD, drinks and pet supplies. You can be paid to do a taste test right at home!

bluejetty:00147411:ios.description:
Experience a stock market game where you can make various investments in a real-time virtual market!
Work - You start at the age of 20. By touching the screen, you receive a salary and incentives, and can additionally invest in falling stock prices or try investing and depositing.
*If you want a harder challenge, try setting your own rule of conquering everything with just your salary.
Stocks - Invest considering economic indicators, corporate market shares, and sales. Rumors and news will either provide opportunities or adversities.
Whether you invest short-term or long-term, the choice is yours.
And if you accumulate a lot of money, become the largest shareholder of a company and directly invest in its technology and marketing to increase its market share (activates largest shareholder mode when holding over 50% of the company's shares).
Futures Market - There are five sectors and each sector has five listed companies. Try investing by looking at the indices and comprehensive index of each sector (correlation with the stock prices of listed companies is 50%).
Economic Indicators - Phases from depression to boom exist. If the indicators are good, the market is likely to grow, and if they're bad, the market is likely to shrink.
Cryptocurrency Market - In this place without indicators, earn big money with quick judgment. Of course, the risk is also high.
Real Estate - Invest in 800 plots of land, build buildings, and create stable income and your own world.
Auction - Land auctions are held from the 2nd to the 15th of each month. Buy at a low price, build a building or sell it to earn profit.

bluejetty:00171188:ios.summary:
Someone always gets exposed. Someone always loses. The only question is who will be holding the phone when the bomb goes off.
Boomit Party combines pass-the-phone gameplay, Most Likely questions, party challenges, and a ticking bomb mechan
bluejetty:00171188:ios.description:
Someone always gets exposed. Someone always loses. The only question is who will be holding the phone when the bomb goes off.
Boomit Party combines pass-the-phone gameplay, Most Likely questions, party challenges, and a ticking bomb mechanic to create a different experience every round —for any group, anywhere, any night. No cards. No setup. One phone. Let's go.
GAME MODES
Pass It On: The phone moves around the group. Read the prompt, answer fast, and keep passing. Whoever holds it when the bomb explodes loses the round. Simple. Tense. Impossible to put down.
Be Exposed: Everyone votes anonymously on a question. The person with the most votes gets revealed. Find out what your friends really think — whether you're ready for it or not.
Team Rush: Split into teams and race through challenges, categories, and rapid-fire rounds. The bomb is still ticking. Work fast or lose together.
MOST LIKELY QUESTIONS
Who is most likely to ghost someone and pretend nothing happened? Cry at a commercial? Start a rumor by accident?
Most Likely is one of Boomit's most-played formats. The group votes, the result gets revealed, and someone always has something to say about it.
WHAT MAKES EVERY ROUND DIFFERENT
4,000+ prompts and challenges — lighthearted, funny, bold, unexpected, and everything in between.
Themes for every vibe — icebreakers, casual hangouts, chaotic party nights, travel sessions, and more.
Fully customizable — set the timer, player count, and theme so the game fits your group, not the other way around.
Built for 6+ players — house parties, college nights, road trips, birthday parties, game nights, and any moment someone asks "what should we do?"
THE BOMB CHANGES EVERYTHING
Most party games let you think. Boomit doesn't. The ticking bomb keeps every round moving — no long debates, no slow turns, no dead moments. Just pressure, laughs, and someone holding the phone at the wrong time.
Whether you're breaking the ice with new people or playing with your closest friends, the bomb makes sure everyone stays in the game from the first round to the last.
PERFECT FOR
A party game for friends at a house party
A no-card game for game night
A Most Likely questions app for groups
An icebreaker game for new people
A travel-friendly group game for road trips and vacations
A fun party game for college students, roommates, and friend groups
A quick party game for 6 or more players
HOW TO PLAY
Choose a game mode. Set your timer and player count. Read the prompt out loud. Answer, vote, guess, or pass the phone. Whoever holds it when the bomb goes off loses the round.
Every round plays differently. Every night becomes a story.
Download Boomit Party and find out who gets exposed first.
Privacy Policy: https://www.boomitparty.com/legal/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.boomitparty.com/legal/terms

bluejetty:00186735:ios.name: DMV Driving Test Driver Start
bluejetty:00186735:ios.summary: By downloading this awesome Driver Start app, you get the perfect tool for learning and training as a way to pass your car, motorcycle, or CDL permit test on the first try. It is based on the official 2026 Manual specific for your state – j
bluejetty:00186735:ios.description:
By downloading this awesome Driver Start app, you get the perfect tool for learning and training as a way to pass your car, motorcycle, or CDL permit test on the first try. It is based on the official 2026 Manual specific for your state – just download the app, choose the state, and start practicing questions you will face on your real DMV exam. Driver Start app is perfectly compatible with iPhone and iPad, and it doesn’t require an Internet connection to run. With a swipe of your hand, you can learn and practice wherever and whenever you want, thus saving time and significantly increasing your chances of passing the test easily and getting your desired DL. 
FEATURES
1. Individual approach to learning
Designed by the developers of Driver-Start.com educational desktop software, this app offers flashcards that help you to focus on particular questions, with one question asked and explained at a time. Also, you are provided with a handy topic manager that allows you to choose questions only from certain categories you want to put a greater emphasis on. When going through flashcards, just use this handy filtering tool, selecting topics like Signs, Situations, Laws, Driving, or Rules. 
The list of all questions are based on your state’s official 2026 Manual – the manuals for each state are regularly updated. To improve your learning experience, you can use the state’s official 2026 Manual for each license class and state – this is great supplemental material that can be found with the app. The PDF versions for desktops are also available on Driver-Start.com to help you learn on multiple devices. 
2. Effective self-checking
Driver Start app provides two helpful methods for checking traffic rules knowledge and practicing car, motorcycle, and CDL permit test questions.
• You can take a DMV, OMV, MVD, DHSMV, DOS, BMV, RMV, MVA, OMVC, DOL, DDS, DOT style test, which includes exactly the number of questions that are specific for your state. You need to answer the random questions and score the required number of correct answers to pass the test. This is a great tool designed not only to help you check your knowledge but also to give you the experience of the real exam.
• Alternatively, you can undergo a Marathon Test that includes a list of all questions available for your state and covers all topics from the local manual. The number of questions may differ depending on the license class you are going to apply for. An experienced reviewer may suggest you start practicing with the Marathon Test to check your general knowledge while shifting to the above test afterward for the real-life experience. 
Both tests are provided with graphic features, showing the general number of questions and the number of questions passed, as well as the number of correct and incorrect answers scored. When undergoing your practice DMV exam, you can break off the process and then come back to it again, starting right from the point when you stopped. 
3. Great usability
The app is easy to use and fast to download. It features a user-friendly interface and balanced functionality, with the added convenience of getting helpful tips on driving from Driver-Start.com blog.

bluejetty:00015864:ios.summary: One world map. Many games. Where is that? is a whole platform of geography games: tap countries on the world map, race your friends to capitals, hop across borders and find the link between countries. With over 11 million downloads in 15 ye
bluejetty:00015864:ios.description:
One world map. Many games. Where is that? is a whole platform of geography games: tap countries on the world map, race your friends to capitals, hop across borders and find the link between countries. With over 11 million downloads in 15 years, it's one of the most popular and trusted geography quiz games.
› A collection of geography games
• Map quiz: find countries, capitals, US states, cities and landmarks on the world map
• Multiple choice: four answers, one is right
• Match Point: tap every country that matches the clue — wrong taps cost a life
• The Link: a handful of countries lights up and you figure out what they have in common
• Border Hop: travel the world country by country across shared borders
• Daily Challenge: one fresh geography question every day
› Multiplayer geography battles
Challenge your friends or compete with players from around the world: find countries, US states and capitals faster than your opponents in real-time games, or play round-based quizzes in the geography leagues.
› 90+ quiz categories
Countries, capitals, flags and landmarks from every continent. States and cities of the USA, Germany, France, Japan and many more. Mountains, oceans, buildings — from the Eiffel Tower to the Grand Canyon.
› Learning built in
Playing is learning: progress tracking, smart repetition and detailed statistics help you master every country, capital, flag and US state — great for school, travel or your next trivia night. And with the Wikipedia integration you can read up on every place you discover.
› Made for all ages
A kid-friendly interface, adjustable difficulty and customizable maps. Choose the regions and topics you want to explore and make the world map your own. And by the way: single-player games work offline, too.
› Privacy first
I build this app as an independent developer and adhere to strict German privacy guidelines. Your data — and your kids' — stays safe while you play.
› All categories
Countries and Capitals of the World, America, Europe, Asia, Africa and Oceania
US States and US State capitals
States (or Regions, Districts, Prefectures, Departments, Counties) of Australia, Austria, Brazil, Canada, China, England, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, Portugal, Russia, Spain, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, Ukraine, USA, Vietnam
Cities in Austria, Brazil, Canada, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Portugal, Russia, Spain, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, USA, Vietnam
Mountains, Oceans, Landmarks, Buildings, Corporate Headquarters, …

– About VooV Meeting –
Backed by the global network deployment, VooV Meeting provides smooth, secure, and reliable cloud-based HD conferencing services that enable you to start or join meetings with ease anytime, anywhere. It features online document collaboration, join via WeChat Mini Programs, meeting management and control, screen sharing and many more. With VooV Meeting, mobile working and cross-company meetings are no longer a problem! 
Cloud-based Smart Conferencing 
– Key Features –
[Easy to Use]
- Easily join, start, schedule a meeting
- Online document collaboration to facilitate discussions
- Real-time screen sharing for remote demonstration
- Meeting controls for the host to keep meetings in good order
[Smooth and Crystal Clear]
- HD image, beauty filter, background blur
- Intelligently eliminate ambient noise and keyboard click sound and perfectly restore human voices
[Stable and Reliable]
- High meeting concurrency supported thanks to the global network deployment
- Amazing audio and video quality 
[Secure]
- World-leading security protection. 
—Contact Us—
Email: info@voovmeeting.com
Please feel free to rate us, leave your comments in the comment section, or email us if you have any questions so we can move ahead. 
Thank you for your support!

The price of the VooV Meeting Pro Auto Monthly Subscription is 14.99 USD/month.

If you need to unsubscribe, please open iOS Settings, tap AppleID, and then tap View Apple ID to enter the Account Settings page. Then tap Subscribe and select VooV Meeting Pro Auto Monthly Subscription to unsubscribe. If you have not unsubscribed at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, this subscription will be auto-renewed.

bluejetty:00076537:ios.name: bergfex: Hiking & Tracking
bluejetty:00076537:ios.summary:
The bergfex: Hiking & Tracking app is a must-have for every hike, ski tour or other outdoor activity.
Find the most beautiful hiking trails in your area or create personal tours with our route planner and track all your outdoor activities.
bluejetty:00076537:ios.description:
The bergfex: Hiking & Tracking app is a must-have for every hike, ski tour or other outdoor activity.
Find the most beautiful hiking trails in your area or create personal tours with our route planner and track all your outdoor activities. Precise GPS navigation, detailed hiking maps for the entire Alpine region and other useful features bring you safely to your destination.
Get to know the bergfex hiking app for free!
FIND HIKES OR SKI TOURS THAT SUIT YOU
The bergfex tours app contains over 500,000 hiking trails, ski tours, running routes and mountain bike trails throughout Europe. Detailed tour descriptions, topographic hiking maps for the entire Alpine region and filter options make it easy to find the ideal tour.
TOUR PLANNER AND HIKING NAVIGATION
You haven't found the perfect hiking or ski tour yet? Then use the bergfex tour planner. In just a few steps you can create your personal hike and let it navigate you to the summit. The precise GPS hiking navigator won't let you down even in the mountains.
DETAILED MAPS
Our maps for the entire European Alpine region come from OpenStreetMap (OSM). This means that when planning your route and while hiking, you can be sure that you will find the right route thanks to regularly updated maps.
TRACKING HIKING ROUTES AND TRAILS
Track the distance covered while hiking, ski touring, running or mountain biking and get comprehensive statistics such as duration, altitude metres, elevation profile, distance and speed. A heat map shows you all the activities you have recorded so far.
ROUTE AND FITNESS TRACKING COMBINED
Keep track of your fitness level and activities! Optionally, you can wear a Bluetooth heart rate monitor while hiking, ski touring or other sports to get even more detailed information about your fitness level.
APPLE HEALTH, GARMIN CONNECT, POLAR FLOW, WEBSYNC AND GPX-IMPORT
Your hikes and planned tours are automatically synchronised with your bergfex account. Tracked activities are also displayed in the Apple Health app, Garmin Connect and Polar Flow. Self-created routes can be exported and imported via GPX file.
_____________________
TEST ALL PRO FUNCTIONS FOR 7 DAYS FREE OF CHARGE & WITHOUT ANY COMMITMENT
Register in the hiking app and test the helpful functions of our PRO subscription on your next hike:
• offline map material for navigation even without an active internet connection
• name surrounding peaks with our "Peak Names" feature
• more detailed map material thanks to higher zoom level
• official hiking maps such as ÖK50, SwissMap, etc.
• animated display of rain fronts in your area
• overlay to visualise slope steepness >30°, 35°, 40°, 45°
• 3D maps show the terrain, the surroundings and the route in detail
• warning signal when leaving the route
• official avalanche warnings from local warning services
• satellite map with additional information and points of interest
• share your live location with friends
• intermediate destinations for route planning
• analyse ski runs (distance, altitude, speed)
• zones for heart rate measurement
• hiking, ski touring and more without advertising
_____________________
ANY QUESTIONS?
If you have any questions or comments about our app, please send us an email at: app@bergfex.at
Note: Continuous GPS usage can result in a severe reduction in battery life.
Terms of use: bergfex.com/c/agb/
Privacy Policy: bergfex.com/c/datenschutz/

bluejetty:00088701:ios.summary:

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffe
bluejetty:00088701:ios.description:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.
Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.
Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.
Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.
Penance Never Ends.
MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.
ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.
THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE
- Includes every feature and content update from the original PC and console versions. Switch between precise touch controls or full controller support (gamepad compatible) for a seamless experience.
- No ads, no microtransactions.
MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

bluejetty:00038133:ios.description:
There’s no place like home, especially when it’s a smart home. Say hello to Hilo, and discover how to control your entire home with a single app. 
Manage your devices wherever you are 
Hilo allows you to configure, manage and control all your connected home devices with ease. Activate them when you want, wherever you are. 
Create scenes to make your life easier 
A scene allows you to control in one go several devices and to create the mood for a room by dimming a light or changing the colour of bulbs, for example. 
Start by creating 4 basic scenes, then take the time to define key moments to help you make the most of your Hilo home. 
Get creative! Movie night, Sunday brunch, reading corner… Create the scenes you want and manage several devices with a single command, so that your home takes care of you 24/7. 
Program your devices to save time and energy

bluejetty:00096333:ios.description:
GutSense is the AI agent that turns every bite, sip, and note into a personal roadmap for better energy, sharper focus, steadier mood, and lifelong wellness. Most people know their gut matters but have no idea how to act on it. GutSense bridges that gap in seconds, translating photos and text into practical, bite-size guidance you can use right away.
SNAP & LEARN
Take a quick photo of any meal or type a short description. Our computer-vision model detects ingredients, cooking methods, and portions, then calculates more than ten gut-specific metrics—including fibre balance, probiotic density, inflammation impact and more. Results appear in under five seconds.
DAILY AI TIPS
Every log triggers instant suggestions for the next 24 hours: smarter swaps, portion tweaks, hydration reminders, and stress-aware nudges. Nothing generic—each tip is shaped by your own data.
WEEKLY OVERVIEW
Once a day, GutSense compiles your entries into a 360° report. You’ll see trends, wins, blind spots, and a short action list with goals, challenges, and gut-friendly recipes.
ULTRA-PERSONAL CHALLENGES
The built-in AI agent creates micro-missions you can actually finish—drink two extra glasses of water, add one fermented food, extend your eating window. Complete them to earn medals, keep streaks alive, and rack up points that prove your progress.
COOKBOOK 2.0
A brand-new recipe drops every day, tailored to your style—vegan, low-FODMAP, keto, Mediterranean, or custom.. One tap saves it to your personal cookbook, ready when you need inspiration.
STUDY HUB
Jargon-free lessons break down each metric so you understand what really drives gut health and why it affects energy, immunity, focus, weight balance, and longevity.
FLEXIBLE LOGGING
Forgot to track lunch yesterday? Back-date an entry. Want to include how you felt after a run? Add a quick note. GutSense keeps pace with real life—no rigid routines.
DESIGNED FOR EVERY GOAL
• All-day energy without extra caffeine
• Laser focus and balanced mood through the gut–brain axis
• Everyday resilience by lowering dietary stressors
• Sustainable weight balance via fibre, polyphenols, and smart portions
• Habits that support long-term vitality, built one micro-win at a time
HOW IT WORKS
Snap or write a log.
Read your AI results in seconds.
Act on today’s personalised tip.
Review your weekly game plan.
Watch GutSense learn and refine every time you log.
*LANGUAGE AVAILABILITY*
GutSense is currently available in English. However all AI insights and suggestions can be delivered in multiple languages. We’re actively working to bring full app localization—including interface and navigation—to more languages soon.GutSense is an educational wellness application. It does not diagnose, treat, or cure medical conditions. For medical advice, always consult a healthcare professional. Full Privacy Policy and Terms of Service are available in-app.
**SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED** 
GutSense is available exclusively through a paid subscription. The app **does not offer a free trial**, and access to all features—AI food reports, personalised tips, summaries, and recipes—requires a subscription. Pricing details are clearly shown in-app before confirming the purchase.
Subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID at confirmation and automatically renew monthly or yearly unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID Account Settings. If canceled, access remains available until the end of the current period. **Unused subscription time is non-refundable.**
By completing your purchase, you affirm your understanding of the following:
Terms of Use: https://gutsensedocs.buzzbridge.cloud/gutsense-terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://gutsensedocs.buzzbridge.cloud/privacy-policy
GutSense – AI gut-health coaching for total wellness. Join the growing community that is optimising life from the inside out—one insight at a time.

bluejetty:00182805:ios.description:
Join Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Marvin The Martian, and all the classic toons to build the greatest Toon Team in Looney Tunes™ World of Mayhem!
Assemble a team with Tweety Bird, Taz, Road Runner, Wile E Coyote and more to wage insane battles in a vibrant Looney Tunes™ world. Collect all of the classic Looney Tunes™ cartoon characters in this epic action RPG.
Strategize based on classic rivalries! Get bonuses when you face an iconic foe like Wile E Coyote vs. Roadrunner or Bugs Bunny vs. Elmer Fudd! 
Steal crates in PVP to get rewards and power-ups! 
Build a town of your favorite cartoon characters and famous Looney Tunes™ landmarks. From the Warner Bros tower to Bugs Bunny’s rabbit hole, you shape your personal Looney Tunes™ world!
Build your own Looney Tunes™ World, collect your favorite characters, and discover their unique and hilarious fighting abilities.
Download Looney Tunes™ World of Mayhem today!
FEATURES
THE Looney Tunes™ YOU LOVE
- Collect your favorite Looney Tunes™ characters
- Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Elmer Fudd, Wile E. Coyote, Granny, Porky Pig and more!
- Build a team, power them up and battle with cartoon skills and weapons
- Level up your team of toons to unlock ridiculous special attacks inspired by famous cartoon gags
- Recreate famous feuds like Wile E Coyote vs Roadrunner!
ACTION RPG 
- Fight teams of toons in iconic locations
- Travel everywhere from the forest where Elmer hunted Bugs to space with Duck Dodgers
- Play through iconic cartoon conflicts
STRATEGY GAME
- Use your wits in turn based combat
- Choose your team to strategically counter your enemy’s toons
- Find synergy between characters for friendships and combinations
WORLD BUILDER
- Build your Looney Tunes™ town
- Earn resources by assigning your toons tasks to complete
- Collect iconic cartoon landmarks
PVP ARENA
- “Of course, you realize, this means war.”
- Competitive events where you can steal crates and materials from other players
- Defend against other players or go on the offense and earn stars
- Form alliances to complete events
Become the maestro of mayhem in Looney Tunes™ World of Mayhem! Download now!
Privacy Policy: https://scopely.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00021244:ios.description:
Tally is a super convenient digital counting app, designed to help you track and record everything in your life, big or small.
Whether you're forming daily habits, logging important events, or managing item quantities, this app can handle it all with ease.
With features like notifications, repeat cycles, charts, and memos, you can track nearly every number in your daily life effortlessly.
# Use Cases
Whether you want to log the number of cigarettes you smoke, track how much coffee you drink each week, or monitor your daily water intake, Tally makes it easy. It’s also perfect for inventory management, foot traffic counting, or even managing classroom tasks and point systems, giving you an effortless way to keep track of all your data.
# Rich Data Insights
Track your events over various timeframes—daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. You can easily view the frequency of events, the number of days since they last occurred, and the intervals in your history. With a wealth of charts, calendar views, and heat maps, your data is clear and easy to understand.
# Key Features
## Quick Recording, Convenient Tracking
With interactive widgets, Shortcut App, URL Scheme, Action Notifications, and Picture-in-Picture counting, tracking is a breeze. Plus, Tally supports Apple Watch, so you can log directly from your watch.
## Custom Cycles, Track Your Key Totals
Support for daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly cycles, along with custom cycles. You can also set the number of completions needed for each cycle, making it easy to track your goals.
## Up to 15 Different Widgets, Tailored to Your Needs
## Group Management
Manage your own or others' tasks, track various life events, form habits, and even manage counters for classrooms or inventory. Tally is versatile and not limited to habit tracking. It supports grouped statistics and various visual charts, making it easy to view data across different groups.
## Comprehensive Visual Reports

bluejetty:00030669:ios.description:
Do you want to color with My Coloring Book Trends? 
So come and color amazing coloring pages with your friends, parents, or soulmate. Color the same coloring pages and compare your results. It's cool! Learn coloring skills by indulging in a world full of colors. Lots of amazing activities, such as coloring, will give you unlimited fun with coloring books. 
This is an amazing painting for drawing book games because this color book will help you to learn about different colors. By playing with our coloring book, your hand-eye coordination will improve, and your fine motor skills will be sharpened. This coloring book for adults and younger people will also help them learn about different characters, places, animals, cars, and many other things as they use color.
This exciting painting book, with its unicorn section, has a bundle of fun. You can enjoy coloring by selecting the character from 8 interesting themes. Through these coloring activities, you can show your creativity by choosing the character of your interest from lots of theme categories like Cars, Ice Cream, City, Bears, Nature, Santa, Summer, Unicorn, and others.
Are our coloring book collections not enough? No problem - you can add your own coloring pages from the gallery (by clicking on the + at the top of the screen) in unlimited quantities! Our app will instantly process your image, and you can enjoy your own coloring pages.
Get enjoyment from coloring with different tools, gradients, and patterns. Beautiful graphics and the coloring book's ease of use make it very suitable for people of all ages. 
These amazing coloring pages are perfect for learning for those who want to develop their creativity. A versatile coloring app with lots of images across 19 themes will give our users hours of fun. It will also entertain them with a magic painting style. Create beautiful pictures with one touch. 
New coloring pages and sections are added every week.
Two coloring techniques: brushes and tap filling.
Adding your own personal coloring pages.
An unlimited number of colors are available using the color chart and our innovative opacity control slider. Get coloring quickly with our professional color palettes.
Create your works of art in a couple of clicks.
Share your works by printing pages, through email, text, and social networks.
So hurry up, a huge bundle of entertainment, a coloring book, is waiting for you to make you a true artist. Let’s color. Enjoy!

bluejetty:00072458:ios.description:
The perfect app for busy parents. Identify why your baby is crying with our advanced cry analyzer, and get optimal nap time predictions from SleepGenie. Easily track feeding, sleep, and diapers, and log your baby’s milestones. Plus, create a lifelike baby avatar with the Cartoon Look-Alike generator!
SEE WHY OVER HALF A MILLION PARENTS LOVE THE NANNI APP!
- Find out why your baby is crying with cry translation and personalized soothing tips, on your phone or Apple Watch
- Optimize nap and sleep times with SleepGenie and a smart Sleep Planner
- Track baby’s sleep, bottle or breastfeeding schedule, and diaper changes. Available with voice commands too!
- Learn and track critical developmental milestones
- Created by world-class Medical Professionals & AI Experts
- Advanced AI technology tailored for your parenting journey
Want to share your feedback and suggest new features? Find us on social media:
IG/Tiktok - @nanni.app
Facebook - www.facebook.com/groups/nanniaiparenthub
reddit - www.reddit.com/r/NanniAI
SLEEP & NAP TIME PREDICTIONS
Accurately predict nap times, create customizable sleep schedules, and track sleep patterns effortlessly with our intelligent SleepGenie feature. Trusted by parents, our tools are designed to improve sleep quality and promote healthy development. Maximize restful nights and enhance your baby's growth with expert-backed sleep solutions.
FREE BABY TRACKER
Powerful parental monitoring tool providing a timeline and summary view of baby’s core routines. Go to your next doctors’ appointment with strong facts and data!
- Track baby sleep and naps schedule
- Track baby feeds, both bottle and breastfeed
- Track diaper activity, pee, poo or mixed
- Stay organized with custom Notes per entry
- Track diaper activity, pee, poo or mixed
- Supports both manual & Voice entry
NEWBORN CRY TRANSLATOR
Record a few seconds of your little one’s cries, and Nanni will provide you with the most likely reason for the cry and how to soothe the baby, right onto your iPhone and Apple Watch screens!
That’s now possible thanks to years of clinical studies on baby cries in partnership with pediatric hospitals, combined with advancements in AI. You can now understand your baby’s unique cries.
Colic or not, Nanni will help!
MILESTONES LOG
Easily track your newborn’s developmental milestones and significant achievements with Nanni and never miss a moment of their growth! 
All our milestones are based on official CDC guidelines.
MAKE A DIFFERENCE
When you choose Nanni AI, you become a part of a broader mission. Your interaction with our app drives Ubenwa's leading research forward, improving the lives of infants across the globe. 
Together, we can extend our impact and together, build a healthier future for all babies.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://ubenwa.ai/eula-bci.html

Иногда планы могут измениться в последний момент. Тогда воспользуйтесь специальными условиями возврата и верните полную стоимость билета за 1 час и более до начала поездки. АВТОЗАПОЛНЕНИЕ ДАННЫХ ПАССАЖИРОВ И ПЛАТЕЖНЫХ ДАННЫХ
Достаточно один раз ввести на сайте или в приложении данные пассажира и реквизиты банковской карты. ПОКУПАЙТЕ ЖД БИЛЕТЫ ПЕРВЫМИ

Introducing Real Car Driving School. Where you get to learn how to drive, Manual and au
bluejetty:00164044:ios.description:
Too lazy to go and find a driving school, But you still want to learn driving. Maybe from your couch. Okay we are not here to judge. We have a solution.
Introducing Real Car Driving School. Where you get to learn how to drive, Manual and automatic transmission. Traffic rules and their meanings and much more.
Not in a boring book way. In an interesting game which you can play for hours.
Career Mode :
21 Interactive levels. Designed to make you understand how you should follow every traffic sign on the road. Play with ambient traffic and follow all the signs to complete the level
and progress in the game.
Parking Mode : 
30 Fun bite sized levels which test your precision in parking cars. Have fun but make sure you don't hit anyone else's car.
Infinite Mode :
Infinitely generating terrain with traffic, a high speed fun mode to play. With 4 different weather and environment settings, Winter, Forest, Desert and City. Be careful, crashes will make you lose the level.
Make the highest score and cover the most distance.
Free Roam :
No Rules, Just Drive
Multiplayer : 
Play against your friends (or enemies) all over the world.
Learn the signs :
A special mode for leaning what traffic signs mean. You can also take a test to see how well you do.
Vehicles : 
A total of 14 Awesome vehicles to choose from, Ranging to classics, to muscle cars and new Sports cars. You will find your dream car here, we have tuned each car to perfection
and unique physics with each vehicles. The sounds, effects and damage are all unique to every vehicle
All cars with functional interiors. So you will have the best experience playing this game
Tuning : 
Don't like the stance of the car, want the suspension dropped, well we got you covered. You can choose what ever you want to do with you car. Drop the front wheels and lift the back
wheels, sure, how about a little camber, yup, offset the wheels to one side, YES, all that and more
Customize :
Now to change the look of the cars.
Car Decals
Car Paint, Rim Paints, Window Tint, Camber Tint
Rims
Spoiler
Number Plate
You can change all these at will. Your car, choose how you want it to look.
Disclaimer :
This is a game made for entertainment purposes. It is not a replacement to a driving school. To learn driving you will need to look for the rules in your local district.

bluejetty:00131810:ios.description:
Stop getting overwhelmed with long to-do lists. Used by 50,000+ productivity enthusiasts.
Bento is not a to-do list app. It's a focus companion. 
We believe in doing less, and finishing more. Using the calming Japanese themes, stay focused and get things done by packing your focus box. Your focus box is limited to up to 3 tasks. The goal is getting the right things done, not everything. 
Popular with ADHD, everyday users struggling with to-do list apps and overwhelmed individuals who need better focus. 
Start your first focus timer today!
Bento Features 
- Aesthetic Timer: Our Japanese focus scenes are designed for calm and minimalism. 
- Focused Productivity: Limit your focus to up to 3 tasks to help reduce overload and burnout.
- Deep Focus Mode: Block distractions, enter deep work states and stay focused with intention.
- Custom Routines: Start a daily custom routine from your morning routine to deep focus start.
- Focus Booster: Build momentum with your focus & stay engaged as you work.
ADHD is one of our most popular use cases. Helping you to beat task paralysis, support better focus & deep work.
Use Cases
- Study Timer: Perfect for revision and exam preparation. The ultimate timer for study.
- Work Timer: Enter flow states at work by embracing the focus box, focus score & scenes.
- Reducing Burnout: Stop overwhelm by using a calm, low stimulation timer like Bento Focus.
- Neurodiverse Focus: This focus timer is ADHD friendly and popular with the neurodivergent community.
- Pomodoro Lovers: Bento focuses works as a pomodoro timer for entering cycles of focus.
Plus focus badges, app icons, new themes released monthly, focus achievements and unique Japanese focus scenes. 
Bento is for everyone who wants to stay focused and reduce distractions.
FREE TRIAL & PRICING
Start a free trial for Premium for full features.
Free version includes: 1 theme, timer mode.
Auto-renewal can be canceled anytime via Apple settings.

Snap or upload a photo of your living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom or dining room, pick a style, and watch AI reimagine your space. No design skills, measuring or 3D modelling needed.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Interior Redesign – Remodel and re-decorate any room in 13 popular styles, from Modern and Scandinavian to Bohemian, Coastal and Art Deco. Add a custom prompt for a look that is truly yours.
• Fill Empty Spaces – Turn an empty room into a fully furnished, virtually staged space.
• AI Replace – Paint over a sofa, lamp, rug or any object and describe what should go there instead.
• Find Furniture – Scan a room photo and get shoppable matches for the pieces you love.
• Exterior Redesign – Give your façade, garden and curb appeal a makeover in 8 exterior styles.
• Explore – Browse fresh inspiration by room type and tap Use Style to try a look on your own space.
• Save & Share – Keep your designs in your profile, save them to Photos and share before-and-after results.
YOU CHOOSE HOW BOLD THE CHANGE IS
Keep most of the room, go for a confident refresh, or let the AI surprise you.
PERFECT FOR
Homeowners planning a renovation, renters decorating a new place, hosts and real estate agents staging listings, and anyone who loves home decor.
START FREE, GO PRO
Try Room AI with complimentary credits. Room AI Pro unlocks AI Replace, Find Furniture and Exterior Redesign, plus unlimited generations.
Subscription details: Room AI Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed weekly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://airoomdecor.app/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://airoomdecor.app/privacy-policy
Questions or feedback? support@virtualminds.tech

Soccer Mini Stars invites you to dive into the thrill of the pitch. Play, score a super goal, and experience casual soccer gameplay like never before!
It's time to turn your soccer dream into reality in career mode, leading your mini players to become the ultimate champions of the season.

Don't miss the chance to step into the shoes of a soccer manager, leading your dream team to glory in prestigious league tournaments. Show off your talents on the pitch, score a super goal, and become a legendary star in the competitive soccer world.

bluejetty:00087013:ios.name: Learn Chinese - Games for Kids
bluejetty:00087013:ios.summary:
Welcome to Galaxy Kids Chinese, the world's first Chinese language learning app for kids aged 3-8 years old that utilizes AI technology to provide free-flowing conversation and real-time grammar correction! 
With our virtual Chinese AI Tut
bluejetty:00087013:ios.description:
Welcome to Galaxy Kids Chinese, the world's first Chinese language learning app for kids aged 3-8 years old that utilizes AI technology to provide free-flowing conversation and real-time grammar correction! 
With our virtual Chinese AI Tutors, kids will have the opportunity to learn Mandarin Chinese in a way that feels like they are speaking with a native tutor at home. Our lovable AI Buddies will guide children through a step-by-step learning path, teaching them over 1000 new words and 50 sentence frames while developing their interest and confidence in speaking Chinese in daily life. 
Our highly structured YCT-based curriculum is packed with numerous storybooks, interactive Chinese lessons, and fun games to keep kids engaged and motivated. With our Speech Lab feature, children can get real-time feedback on their pronunciation, ensuring they adopt correct Chinese pronunciation from the start. Plus, our Mini-Chat feature allows kids to practice essential Chinese conversations in real-world scenarios such as self-introduction, food ordering, and transportation. 
Galaxy Kids Chinese offers a variety of learning styles to promote memory and language retention, ensuring the best Chinese language learning experience for kids. With over 2000+ Chinese language activities and 400+ Chinese speaking lessons for children, our step-by-step curriculum provides a comprehensive and engaging approach to learning Chinese. 
Our app is developed by curriculum and children's education specialists, making it kid-friendly and free of advertisements. Plus, with a Parent Dashboard, parents can track their child's progress and ensure they are getting the most out of their learning experience. 
Galaxy Kids is a free-to-use mandarin Chinese learning application. With a subscription upgrade, learners can enjoy unlimited access to the chat feature and all fun content, including videos, activities, songs, word games, storybooks, and updates on the application. 
Why Choose Galaxy Kids Chinese? 
* Inspire kids to speak Chinese frequently, confidently, and correctly. 
* Adopt correct Chinese pronunciation. 
* Fun activities that keep babies, and preschool kids engaged with interactive animation. 
* Learn over 1,000 imperative Chinese words through speaking practices. 
* Developed by curriculum and children's education specialists, kid-friendly and has no advertisement. 
Main Features: 
Chat Buddy

bluejetty:00092376:ios.name: Heavy Headlines
bluejetty:00092376:ios.summary: Built BY a metalhead FOR metalheads Heavy Headlines for iPhone, iPad - and now Apple Watch - is the BROOTAL one-stop destination for all of your metal news, new album release, and concert listing needs. To put it another way, I'm a big met
bluejetty:00092376:ios.description:
Built BY a metalhead FOR metalheads Heavy Headlines for iPhone, iPad - and now Apple Watch - is the BROOTAL one-stop destination for all of your metal news, new album release, and concert listing needs. To put it another way, I'm a big metal fan and much to my surprise there was just nothing in the app store that did what I was looking for - show me metal news and do it well. So as a professional app developer I took it upon myself to fill that void with the following design goals in mind:
1. Make it simple, slick, and easy to use with a fun interface. It should "just work."
2. Pack it with the innovative features of iOS and Apple devices that I would expect from a great app.
3. Make it metal. Make it fun.
Hopefully I've achieved that and more. Let me know in the reviews.
If you find any bugs or have any suggestions please send me feedback directly from the app. I want to hear from you! Just hit the menu button in the header and select "Send Feedback"
Features:
- Aggregates content from the world's top sources of metal news in one convenient app.
- Innovative "My Bands" feature figures out your favorite metal bands from your Apple Music and iTunes libraries and then surfaces stories about them to the top of your feed. You can also Blacklist the ones you don't want to get news about.
- Explore new metal releases and top selling albums. Open them directly in Apple Music or Spotify.
- Concert Tickets! Heavy Headlines automatically finds upcoming shows in your area featuring your Favorite Bands and even lets you purchase tickets for them right through the app.
- Full background fetch integration refreshes your metal news automatically for you in the background so it's ready for you every time you open the app.
- Automatically receive notifications when new stories about your Favorite Bands are detected! 
- Have multiple devices? No problem. The app uses iCloud to automatically synch your settings and to keep track of the articles you've already read across all your devices.
- Don't like the default look of the app? Heavy Headlines comes packed with over 20 different themes inspired by iconic metal album covers.
- Sleek fullscreen reading experience. Simply scroll the article you're reading to enter fullscreen mode.
- Lots of other little fun "metal" touches throughout to warm even the blackest of hearts.
Please note: The notifications will only work if you allow Heavy Headlines to refresh content in the background. You can do this by going to iOS Settings > General > Background App Refresh and turning it on for Heavy Headlines.
