The Cirrus IQ app is the mobile pilot intelligence hub that organizes your Cirrus Life. Owners of connected SR-Series and Vision Jet aircraft may wirelessly access aircraft data from virtually anywhere in the world. IQ PRO includes a suite of features that provide vertically integrated aircraft management and pilot performance such as:

•        Remote Aircraft Sync for fluid levels, battery health, and oil temperature
•        Flight Summary with passenger manifest and purpose
•        Approach Score - gain insights on every landing
•        Inspection and Life-Limited Part tracking
•        Export flight lists and aircraft flight data
•        Automatic Database Updates for aircraft equipped with Garmin GDL 60 (Separate database subscription required)

Available for Cirrus aircraft models:
SR-Series starting in model year 2020
Vision Jets starting with serial number 0463

bluejetty:00121852:ios.description:
Welcome to PlayPilot, your go-to app for finding and connecting over the best movies, shows, and podcasts from all your favorite streaming services like Netflix, Disney+, MAX, Amazon Prime, Apple TV, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts. We bring together all the content you love and the friends you want to talk about it with.
DIVE INTO PLAYPILOT:
• Follow & Connect: See what your friends and favorite critics are watching and listening to, and meet similar users who share your tastes in entertainment.
• Rate & Review: Share your thoughts on movies, shows, and podcasts, and join the conversation by replying to reviews or tagging friends.
• Create Lists: Make themed lists of your favorite content and get daily recommendations tailored just for you.
• Discover & Stream: Find where to watch any movie, show, or listen to any podcast directly on our app. Filter by free and paid services, and browse using filters like IMDb rating, genre, production year, or podcast language.
• Your Personal Library: Keep track of everything you're watching and listening to. Access your saved titles, ratings, and lists easily, and get notified about new episodes.
Whether you're into jump scares or heartwarming romance, we've got the perfect match and community for you!

bluejetty:00088800:ios.description:
Humanize AI is an advanced writing tool that combines AI humanizer technology, Humanize AI features, and a reliable AI detector. It helps transform AI-generated text into natural, polished writing while also identifying whether content is human-written or AI-generated. Perfect for students, professionals, teachers, and creators, Humanize AI ensures clear, authentic, and trustworthy results.
Humanize AI is the iPhone app of RealWrite AI. Use the same account on the web at realwrite.ai: a Pro subscription bought in the app works there too.
HUMANIZER
Humanize AI converts AI-generated text into natural, human-like writing
Humanize AI for essays, emails, blogs, and professional documents
Multiple tones available: Casual, Formal, Friendly, Funny, Conversational
AI humanizer keeps meaning intact while improving flow and readability
SMART PARAPHRASER
Rewrite text while preserving the original intent
Improve clarity, style, and variation with Humanize AI technology
Avoid repetition and refine writing for better readability
Ideal for students, researchers, content creators, and writers
AI DETECTOR
Detect whether text was written by AI or by a human
AI detector provides detailed analysis with confidence scores
Works on AI-generated and AI-refined content
Practical for teachers, reviewers, and professionals checking originality
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
Powered by Claude AI for high-quality Humanize AI results
Voice input support for fast text entry
Quick copy, paste, and share functions
History tracking to revisit previous Humanize AI generations
Clean interface with light and dark mode options
PRO FEATURES
Unlimited Humanize AI generations with faster processing
Access to advanced tones, premium writing styles, and full AI humanizer tools
Ad-free usage and priority support for professionals
SUITED FOR
Students and academics using Humanize AI for essays and research papers
Writers and editors refining drafts with the help of an AI humanizer
Business professionals polishing reports and emails with Humanize AI
Social media managers creating authentic, engaging captions and posts
Teachers, reviewers, and professionals using the AI detector to verify content
PRIVACY AND SECURITY
No account required, no personal data stored
Secure and private Humanize AI processing by design
Some features require a Pro subscription. The free version of Humanize AI includes limited generations.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.freeprivacypolicy.com/live/20cf4b21-51df-46a7-984a-266adc9c144c

bluejetty:00092886:ios.description:
Viajar a trabalho e economizar nunca foi tão simples. Já experimentou?
Baixe o app VOLL!
Ressignifique a mobilidade corporativa e chegue ao seu destino de maneira segura e descomplicada.
Com o app VOLL, você tem acesso às opções de transporte disponibilizadas pelos maiores aplicativos de transporte urbano, passagens aéreas, hospedagem e locadoras de carros de maneira personalizada, de acordo com seu perfil e a política de viagens de sua empresa.
+ Passagens aéreas
Pesquise entre as principais companhias aéreas do mercado e reserve seu próximo voo, com tarifas diferenciadas, em poucos minutos.
+ Mobilidade urbana
Escolha sua modalidade de transporte desejada, de acordo com a sua preferência. Seja motorista por aplicativo ou táxi, você terá acesso às melhores ofertas com o melhor custo benefício, sem precisar consultar vários apps. Você ainda pode usar seu carro próprio e o pedido de reembolso é encaminhado diretamente para a sua empresa.
+ Hotéis
Garantimos o menor preço! Compare vários sites para reservar o mesmo quarto de hotel, pelo menor valor. Escolha a melhor opção de hospedagem de acordo com seu perfil, filtrando pela quantidade de diárias e faixa de valores, numa pesquisa otimizada com a política de viagens da sua empresa.
+ Aluguel de carros
Precisa alugar um veículo para usar a trabalho? É muito fácil fazer isso diretamente com o app da VOLL. Em poucos segundos, você confirma sua locação de forma online e com descontos corporativos exclusivos.
+ Gestão de despesas e reembolsos
Organizar comprovantes de despesas durante a viagem é muito mais simples com o app VOLL. Alimentação, estacionamento, pedágio e outros tipos de gastos podem ser digitalizados no app e enviadas automaticamente para a sua empresa. Chega de perder tempo conferindo notinhas e calculando os valores do reembolso! O app VOLL faz tudo para você.
Funcionalidades para facilitar a sua jornada:
> Chat com motorista
Tenha contato direto e acompanhe a localização em tempo real do motorista, de maneira segura.
> Edite a sua viagem
Adicione múltiplas paradas, edite seu destino, compartilhe sua viagem com quem você quiser!
> Experiência incrível
Segurança e bem-estar é coisa séria. Por isso, você terá acesso ao suporte da VOLL via chat, 24 horas por dia. Oferecemos também um suporte emergencial, garantindo a sua privacidade.
> Dê adeus às notinhas!
Todas as viagens são faturadas diretamente para a empresa e o processo é todo digital. Sendo assim, você não precisa se preocupar em guardar os papéis das notas fiscais, comprovantes e outros documentos. Digitalize tudo pelo app e livre-se das notinhas!
> Sua jornada de trabalho unificada em um só app
Com o app VOLL, você resolve toda a sua rotina fora do escritório, ou do home-office, em único aplicativo - ou pela web, como preferir!
Precisando de ajuda? Acesse nossa página especializada.
Siga-nos no Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/go.voll/
Atualize-se conosco no Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/govoll
Acesse nosso blog: https://govoll.com/blog/

Modify player attributes, adjust physics settings, and experiment with different race styles to make every simulation unique.

Fair prices
Tickets on Theatr are listed at or below the price paid. No markups — just tickets people can no longer use.

Plans change, and tickets move quickly. When you list, we instantly notify local buyers looking for tickets like yours. Most tickets sell within an hour, including listings posted on the day of the event.

For sellers

When your tickets sell, we’ll let you know. Transfer the tickets, confirm in the app, and get paid to your account 2 business days after the event.

Set Notify for events you care about, and we’ll let you know when tickets appear within your price range.

Theatr is also a place to discover what’s on, follow what the community is talking about, and keep track of your own live-event life. Read community picks, browse live-event content, mark shows as watched. Earn Karma as you buy, sell, and contribute.

bluejetty:00065863:ios.name: Cat Fishing 2
bluejetty:00065863:ios.summary: Catch & release feline fun from Friskies with Cat Fishing 2: purrhaps the best game ever created fur cats. It’s pawesome for playtime because it provides the mental stimulation to keep your cat’s mind active while also scratching their hunt
bluejetty:00065863:ios.description:
Catch & release feline fun from Friskies with Cat Fishing 2: purrhaps the best game ever created fur cats. It’s pawesome for playtime because it provides the mental stimulation to keep your cat’s mind active while also scratching their hunting itch. So it could save the day AND your furniture!
Cat Fishing 2 is the catch of the day for cats who crave a challenge. They’ll prowl for prey in the pond of your picking and earn points along the way. It’s crafted with cats in mind, freshly stocked with special sounds to keep their interest and schools of fish to keep ‘em clawing back for more. There are endless ways to play. You can create an account, customize your play and save your cat’s settings. Or you can skip those steps and get right to gaming. Either way, you’ll be feline great about squeezin’ in some good clean catfishing fun with your favorite felines - and Friskies!
How to play Friskies® Cat Fishing:
• Place your mobile phone or tablet on a flat surface near your cat.
• Tap “PLAY”
• Watch your cat tap the screen to catch fish and score points.
• To personalize the screen just for your little kitty, tap on the fish in upper right-hand corner. Select any of the 10 different fish and pond options and hit reset.
• If your cat stops playing for 30 seconds or more, the game will "meow" to attract her attention • Reward your cat for winning. (We suggest some Friskies® Seafood Sensations®.)
Please be aware that in our experience, the bare glass screen holds up trouble-free to a cat’s claws, but plastic add-on screen protectors might not.
Friskies Fun Membership FAQ
How much does it cost to subscribe? 
• Membership is FREE. 
• Users must signup and opt into the Friskies email list to join.
What features do you get?
• Endless game play with no time limits or screen interruptions
• No ads
• Unlimited access to all special fish types and settings

bluejetty:00076340:ios.name: Holy Bible Recovery Version
bluejetty:00076340:ios.summary: The Holy Bible Recovery Version App contains Living Stream Ministry's Recovery Version of the Holy Bible with its numerous study aids, including the subject and background of each book; detailed, interpretive outlines; enlightening footnote
bluejetty:00076340:ios.description:
The Holy Bible Recovery Version App contains Living Stream Ministry's Recovery Version of the Holy Bible with its numerous study aids, including the subject and background of each book; detailed, interpretive outlines; enlightening footnotes, valuable cross references, and a variety of useful charts and maps. The free installation comes with the full text of the Recovery Version and footnotes, outlines, and cross references for only the Gospel of John. Some of the features of the app include:
* Deep linking—When accessing Living Stream Ministry's ebooks available through Google, Apple, Barnes and Noble, Amazon, or Kobo, verse reference links will open in the Holy Bible Recovery Version App.
* Annotations—Create and manage tags, notes, and highlights on verses of the Bible.
* Bookmarks.
* User data import and export—The user has complete control of annotations and other data.
* Dedicated footnotes and cross reference viewer—Read and study notes and references without losing your place.
 * Preview verses and other footnotes referenced in a footnote.
 * Advanced cross reference expansion for viewing cross references without losing your place.
* Footnote and cross references toggle—Easily toggle features like highlights, footnotes, and cross references, so that you can choose how you want to read or study.
* Charts & Maps.
* Verse and footnote search.
* Copy, paste, and share functions.
* Light, dark, and sepia display modes.
* Profiles—Create multiple "copies" of the Bible for various types of reading, each complete with its own reading profile, annotations, and navigation history, whether full-featured with all resources on hand or clean and simple.

bluejetty:00081204:ios.name: DIY Flower Language Keyboard
bluejetty:00081204:ios.summary:
Let’s discover how to make personalized wallpaper based on your name!
Let floral letters write your name and message to your lover or crush! Imagine a real flower bouquet made just for your name and your partner's name!
DIY Flower Languag
bluejetty:00081204:ios.description:
Let’s discover how to make personalized wallpaper based on your name!
Let floral letters write your name and message to your lover or crush! Imagine a real flower bouquet made just for your name and your partner's name!
DIY Flower Language Keyboard is an app that helps you do this. All you need to do is type your name using the flower keyboard in the DIY Flower Language Keyboard application. 
Each letter on the keyboard corresponds to a flower with its own unique style and color. Your name will be spelled out with these floral letters, following the language of flowers.
Moreover, DIY Flower Language Keyboard will create fun, peaceful, and meaningful experiences.
*** Main Features ***
Flower Letter Based Bouquets:
► With a flower keyboard, each letter represents a unique and meaningful flower. Explore your name written in the language of flowers. How beautiful! We can't wait to see your friends' reactions and admiration for these beautiful flower bouquets you create!
Customizable Keyboards:
► Choose from a variety of themed keyboards, where each letter corresponds to a different flower. Personalize your bouquets by selecting your favorite flowers or mixing and matching letters from various keyboards.
Soothing Music:
► DIY Flower Language Keyboard is dedicated to giving you the best possible experience. Enhance your flower creation experience with calming, soothing music. Customize your playlists, enjoy nature sounds, or meditate while designing your floral masterpieces.
Set as Flower Wallpaper:
► Save your stunning and unique creations and choose to set them as wallpapers for your lock screen. Imagine the admiration and "wows" you'll get from your friends and lovers!
Customization Options:
► DIY Flower Language Keyboard not only provides beautiful floral letters on the keyboard but also many customization options for your flower bouquet representing your name!
► Wrappers: Choose from a variety of stunning wrappers with different styles and colors.
► Bows: Bows are essential for a beautiful flower bouquet. Add them to your unique bouquets now!
► Pots: In addition to wrappers, our app also provides various awesome pots to help you unleash your creativity.
► Background themes: Adjust the color you want, choose a beautiful available theme, or even import your own photo to set it as the background theme of your wallpaper.
► Tags: Personalize your tags with various styles, colors, and text fonts.
Download DIY Flower Language Keyboard right now and step into a stunning and awesome flower world! Creating a flower bouquet with your name or your partner's name is the best way to express your soul and love. Let these flower bouquets speak your message!
We would be excited to receive your suggestions for future features of the app or database additions or any feedback you may have!
Please email us at bkmobile.software@gmail.com
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/kien-hoang-terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/kien-hoang-privacy-policy

Boy Howdy's Double Deck Solitaire is just like classic Klondike solitaire but with two decks for a more relaxing game, and it's 100% FREE!

• Beautiful, easy to read cards!
• NEW - Low Vision Mode!
• No timers at all! Just relax and have fun!
• Unlimited undo support, with no penalties if you want to go back and try things a different way!
• Global high score leaderboards with Game Center
• Your progress is automatically saved, all the time, so go ahead and take that call or jump out to any other apps - you can come back and pick up playing right where you left off!
• Sounds can be disabled if you want a quiet game
• You can even listen to your own music while you play
Thanks for playing!
Search for Boy Howdy to see all our free games!

bluejetty:00071170:ios.description:
Esmaül Hüsna — Allah'ın 99 güzel ismini Arapça yazılışı, Türkçe okunuşu ve anlamıyla öğrenin, dinleyin ve ezberleyin. 
Esmâü'l-Hüsnâ "en güzel isimler" demektir ve Allah'ın yüce isimlerini ifade eder. Bu uygulamayla Allah'ın en güzel isimlerini dilediğiniz an inceleyebilir, sesinden dinleyebilir ve kolayca ezberleyebilirsiniz.
ÖZELLİKLER
• 99 ismin tamamı: Arapça yazılışı, okunuşu ve anlamı
• Sesli okuma — her ismi doğru telaffuzuyla dinleyin
• Esmaül Hüsna Testi — 3 farklı modda (okunuş, Arapça, anlam) kısa ve eğlenceli test
• Sesli Zikir — isimleri sesiyle birlikte, dilediğiniz hızda zikredin (dijital tesbih)
• Anlamı, sıralanışındaki hikmet ve hangi ayetlerde geçtiği
• Açık ve koyu tema
• İnternet bağlantısı gerektirmez — her yerde kullanın
• Reklamsız kullanım seçeneği
Allah'ın En Güzel İsimleri Hakkında
Kur'ân-ı Kerîm'de Allah'ın isimleri "En Güzel İsimler" olarak anılır. İlgili âyetler: El-A'râf (7:180), El-İsrâ (17:110), Tâhâ (20:8), El-Haşr (59:24).
İslam âlimleri arasında isimlerin tam sayısı konusunda farklı görüşler vardır; bazı isimler yalnızca Kur'ân'da, bazıları hadislerde, bazıları her iki kaynakta yer alır. Bu nedenle farklı kaynaklarda farklı 99 isim listeleri bulunur. Büyük İslam düşünürü İbn Arabî, Allah'ın 99 isminin âlemin içsel sırlarını barındırdığını ifade etmiştir.
Allah'ın selâmı üzerinize olsun.

İslam âlimleri arasında isimlerin tam sayısı konusunda farklı görüşler vardır; bazı isimler yalnızca Kur'ân'da, bazıları hadislerde, bazıları her iki kaynakta yer alır. Bu nedenle farklı kaynaklarda farklı 99 isim listeleri bulunur. Büyük İslam düşünürü İbn Arabî, Allah'ın 99 isminin âlemin içsel sırlarını barındırdığını ifade etmiştir.

Allah'ın selâmı üzerinize olsun.

Through easy to understand narrated texts, educational games and incredible illustrations, it teaches children basic information about dinosaurs, including what they looked like, how they lived, how they reproduced, and what they ate...
The app also has lots of educational games to play without any rules, pressure or time limits. Suitable for all ages!
FEATURES 
• Learn basic information about dinosaurs.
• Lots of educational games including: finding buried bones, learning dinosaur names, playing puzzles, pretending to be a paleontologist, putting dinosaur skeletons together...

• Content suitable for children aged 4 and over. Games for the whole family. Hours of fun.

• Play fun and educational games.
• Enjoy the educational entertainment.

bluejetty:00087823:ios.description:
Your vinyl collection deserves more than a spreadsheet.
My Vinyl+ is the premium companion for vinyl collectors - a powerful, beautifully designed app that brings your record collection to life. Sync with Discogs, scan barcodes, track your collection's value, and see every pressing rendered in stunning detail.
▸ SEE YOUR RECORDS LIKE NEVER BEFORE
Every record in your collection gets a custom vinyl visualization that matches its real pressing:
• Standard, colored, and picture disc rendering
• Marble swirl patterns with realistic procedural textures
• Splatter vinyl with customizable accent colors
• Clear and translucent pressings with glass-like depth
• Split-color vinyl with support for 2 to 6 sections
• Auto-detect vinyl color directly from Discogs release notes — powered by on-device AI, no data leaves your phone
Pull the record out of its sleeve with a satisfying physics-based animation. It's the closest you'll get to handling your vinyl without leaving the couch.
▸ YOUR ENTIRE COLLECTION, ORGANIZED
• Sync your Discogs collection and wantlist automatically
• Scan barcodes to instantly add records
• Identify music with audio recognition powered by Shazam technology
• Swipe between Collection and Wantlist with a fluid gesture
• Jump to any letter with the alphabetic quick-scroll bar
• Search by artist, album, label, year, or format
• Add notes, rate records, and track sleeve and media condition
▸ KNOW WHAT YOUR COLLECTION IS WORTH
Track the market value of your vinyl collection over time. See individual record values, total collection worth, and how they trend — all powered by real Discogs marketplace data.
▸ RECORD STORE DAY
Never miss a release. Browse upcoming Record Store Day titles, save them to your RSD wishlist, find participating stores near you, and share your list with fellow collectors — fully localized in 6 languages.
▸ LISTEN INSTANTLY
Tap any record to play it through your favorite streaming service:
• Apple Music
• Spotify
• Tidal
No switching apps. No searching. Just tap and listen.
▸ WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Showcase your collection right on your home screen:
• Random Record — rediscover a gem from your shelves every day
• Collection Counter — see your collection size at a glance
▸ ASK AI ABOUT YOUR RECORDS
Curious about a pressing's history, the story behind an album, or what makes a release collectible? Get detailed AI insights from the assistant, about any record in your collection.
▸ BUILT FOR iOS
Designed to feel native on every Apple device:
• Liquid Glass interface on iOS 26
• Siri Shortcuts for hands-free record management
• Dark mode throughout
• Dynamic Type and VoiceOver accessibility
• iPad optimized layouts
• Home screen widgets
▸ PRIVACY FIRST
Vinyl color detection runs entirely on-device. Your collection data syncs securely. No tracking beyond what you choose to share.
▸ CONNECT YOUR ACCOUNTS
• Discogs — full collection and wantlist sync
• Apple Music, Spotify, Tidal — instant playback
• Shazam-powered audio recognition
---
My Vinyl+ is free to download with core features included. Unlock the full experience — including unlimited collection sync, value tracking, widgets, and AI insights - with My Vinyl+ Platinum.

Your record collection deserves more than a spreadsheet.

My Vinyl+ brings your vinyl, CDs and cassettes together. Sync with Discogs, scan records, explore your collection in 3D and rediscover the stories on your shelves.

YOUR RECORDS IN 3D
Tap to slide a record out of its sleeve and drag to turn it over. See covers, labels, discs and booklets from the release's photos. Touch and hold a gallery image to choose the cover, label or disc, or back shown on your 3D record. Prefer a flat view? Choose 2D in Settings.

Bring colored pressings to life, from marble and splatter to clear and split vinyl. Vinyl colors can be detected from release notes.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
On the open iPhone Duo, your vinyl record fills one screen beside its details. Open the hinge to slide the vinyl out of its sleeve. Enjoy larger artwork and artist logos on the redesigned record page.

COLLECTION MEMORIES
Discover and the On This Day widget remind you when you added a record or when it first came out. Revisit the albums that have been part of your life.

ORGANIZE EVERY COPY
- Sync your Discogs collection and wantlist.
- Scan barcodes and search by artist, album, label, year or format.
- Add notes, rate records, and track media and sleeve condition.
- Record limited-edition details beside your grading, with pressing sizes suggested from release notes.

KNOW YOUR COLLECTION'S VALUE
Explore Discogs marketplace values in the redesigned Insights view. See a record's estimated value by condition, with your copy's grade marked. Use privacy mode to hide your collection's value in Insights, Discover, sharing and widgets.

LISTEN AND DISCOVER
Open albums in Apple Music, Spotify or Tidal. Identify music with Shazam-powered audio recognition. Browse Record Store Day releases, build an RSD wishlist, find participating stores and share your list.

YOUR COLLECTION AT A GLANCE
Put Album Mosaic, Random Album, Collection Stats and On This Day widgets on your Home Screen. Tap an Album Mosaic cover to open its record, or use the extra-large widget size on supported devices. Ask Siri or use Shortcuts to manage records, including Count My Collection.

MORE ABOUT YOUR MUSIC
Explore AI insights about albums, pressings and the stories behind your records.

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Enjoy native layouts, dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support.

bluejetty:00081330:ios.description:
THE WORLD’S MOST GENEROUS WORKOUT TRACKER
StrengthLog is the workout tracker for people who take their training seriously, whether you’re just
getting started or have been lifting for decades.
Plan your training. Log every set. Track your progress. Follow proven training programs or build your
own. Compare your strength with other lifters. Set goals, build streaks, and challenge your friends.
And unlike many workout apps, StrengthLog gives you everything you need to train effectively for
free. Unlimited workout logging. No ads. No trial that suddenly locks you out.
100% gains, 0% ads.
BUILT FOR LIFTERS, BY LIFTERS
StrengthLog has been developed together with hundreds of thousands of lifters, from beginners to
competitive strength athletes.
Our library contains 600+ strength, cardio, and mobility exercises with instructions and videos. You
can also create your own exercises.
Log as you train or plan ahead with our calendar. Follow a ready-made training program, build your
own, or simply decide what to do when you get to the gym.
Your training history, PRs, statistics, and Strength Levels make it easy to see where you’ve been and
where you’re going.
TRAIN TOGETHER
Connect with friends and make your training a little more social.
See when your friends train, celebrate their progress, compare PRs and Strength Levels, and create or
join challenges together. Challenge each other to train more often, do more reps, or reach whatever
ridiculous goal you can come up with.
You choose who you connect with, and your full training log stays private.
FREE FEATURES
• Log unlimited workouts, forever.
• Support for both kg and lbs.
• 600+ exercises with instructions and videos.
• Create unlimited custom exercises.
• Follow popular workouts and training programs.
• Build your own routines and programs with linear progression.
• Plan workouts and programs in your training calendar.
• Track PRs and exercise history.
• Compare your strength with other lifters using Strength Levels.
• Track training volume, workouts, and other statistics.
• Create training goals and streaks.
• Complete our monthly challenges.
• Connect with friends and challenge each other.
• Use our rest timer and plate calculator.
• Estimate your 1RM and get suggested PR warm-ups.
• Track body measurements and progress pictures.
• Connect with Apple Health.
GO PREMIUM
StrengthLog Premium unlocks our most advanced tools while supporting the continued development
of the app.
Premium includes:
• Build unlimited training routines and programs with double and triple progression.
• Our complete library of training programs for strength, bodybuilding, powerlifting, powerbuilding,
sports, and more.
• Advanced statistics for your training, muscle groups, and exercises.
• Muscle heat maps showing what you’ve trained over any period.
• Customizable favorite graphs.
• Advanced logging with RPE, Reps in Reserve, % of 1RM, and quick set stats.
• More tools for analyzing and planning your training.
• Unlimited goals and streaks.
• Connect your account to ChatGPT or Claude using our MCP integration.
Whether you want a simple workout log or enough training data to disappear down a statistical rabbit
hole for an entire evening, StrengthLog has you covered.
Have an idea, found a bug, or just want to tell us what you think? Contact us at app@strengthlog.com.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
StrengthLog Premium is an automatically renewing subscription.
• Choose between 1, 3, and 12 months.
• Your App Store account will be charged upon purchase and your subscription will renew
automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings.
APPLE HEALTH
With your permission, StrengthLog can read relevant data from Apple Health and share your
completed workouts with it. You control what data StrengthLog can read or write through your Apple
Health permissions.

bluejetty:00096723:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in Cat Blast Blocks, a satisfying blend of color-matching strategy and pixel-blasting fun! This is not just a pixel game; it is a brain-teasing puzzle adventure designed to sharpen your logic while providing a relaxing esca
bluejetty:00096723:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in Cat Blast Blocks, a satisfying blend of color-matching strategy and pixel-blasting fun! This is not just a pixel game; it is a brain-teasing puzzle adventure designed to sharpen your logic while providing a relaxing escape!
KEY FEATURES:
- Strategic Puzzle Gameplay: Experience a unique twist on block puzzles. It’s not just about speed; it’s about planning. Master the flow of blocks and execute the perfect clearing sequence.
- Vibrant Pixel Art: Dive into a visually stunning world filled with colorful pixel flows and satisfying explosion effects that make every match feel rewarding.
- Stress-Free & Timer-Free: Play at your own pace. Enjoy a relaxing gaming environment with no time limits, allowing you to focus purely on your strategy and puzzle-solving skills.
- Offline Play Supported: No Wi-Fi needed. Enjoy uninterrupted puzzle solving anytime, anywhere—perfect for commutes or relaxing breaks.
HOW TO PLAY & MASTER:
- Tap to Launch: Send the mini cat onto the conveyor belt to see how it blasts pixel blocks.
- Match Colors: Shoot and blast all the same colored pixel blocks from outside to inside to win.
- Manage Your Ammo: The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. When it runs out, it will leave the game board. If ammo remains, it slips into one of five waiting slots. Tap again to bring the cat back from the waiting slot and continue firing at the pixel flow blocks.
- Watch the Capacity: The conveyor belt and waiting slots are limited. Manage the timing and order of your shots to avoid overloading the belt!
WHY PUZZLE LOVERS CHOOSE CAT BLAST BLOCKS:
- Brain Training: Enhances logical thinking through complex color-sorting challenges.
- Satisfying Mechanics: The combination of audio-visual effects and smooth block destruction offers a deeply satisfying experience.
- Progressive Difficulty: With hundreds of levels, the game scales with your skill, introducing tricky obstacles that require smart tactics to solve.
Ready to test your logic? Download Cat Blast Blocks for FREE and start your strategic adventure today!

bluejetty:00175712:ios.description:
AALocker is a highly useful screen time control app designed for parents. It offers flexible and effective features to help parents manage the time their children spend on devices.
With AALocker, parents can:
- Block specific apps such as social media and games to gain better control over their children's device usage.
- Set up schedules based on daily needs like study time and leisure time, and authorize certain apps for certain time slots to avoid accidental overuse or excessive addiction.
- Apply usage limits to each app, so that if a child exceeds the preset time limit, the app will be locked, thereby limiting excessive use of the device and the app.
- AALocker also support focus mode based on the user's set location. With this feature, parents can specify certain apps to be blocked when the device is in a specific location range.
In short, AALocker is a highly practical app that can help parents control their children's screen time and device usage while facilitating their growth in a simple and user-friendly way.

bluejetty:00017918:ios.description:
FNB-Anywhere is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FNB-Anywhere:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FNB-Anywhere app, you must be enrolled as a First National Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00170128:ios.name: Lock Screen Widgets Live
bluejetty:00170128:ios.summary:
Keep favorite apps and everyday information within reach. Build a Lock Screen that works for you with app shortcuts, a calendar, a pedometer and an event countdown.
App Launcher — your favorites together
• Collect favorite apps and tap to
bluejetty:00170128:ios.description:
Keep favorite apps and everyday information within reach. Build a Lock Screen that works for you with app shortcuts, a calendar, a pedometer and an event countdown.
App Launcher — your favorites together
• Collect favorite apps and tap to open them.
• Touch and hold icons to reorder them, or remove apps you no longer need.
• Browse the catalog or search the App Store. Set up personal launchers with a named Apple Shortcut or a supported app URL.
App Dock — up to 10 apps on your Lock Screen
• Show app shortcuts as a Live Activity, with Dynamic Island access on supported iPhones.
• Show or hide app names, choose grayscale icons and adjust padding.
• Choose system, translucent or solid backgrounds and adjust background opacity.
• Reorder or remove apps in either the Launcher or App Dock preview. Tap Update App Dock to apply changes to your running Dock.
• Save different app lists, orders and appearances as Dock profiles. Create, duplicate, rename and switch profiles for different parts of your day.
• Apply Standard, Minimal, Monochrome or Spacious design presets, then fine-tune the appearance.
• Adjust Dock styles while the preview stays visible at the top. Scroll through the options and apply your changes with the button at the bottom.
System controls — quicker access on iOS 18 or later
• Add controls to open App Dock settings, start or update your selected Dock, or apply a saved profile.
• Use them in Control Center, supported Lock Screen controls or the Action button on supported iPhones.
• Controls open this app to apply changes; unlocking may be required.
Lock Screen launcher widgets
• Add circular or rectangular app shortcuts.
• On iOS 17 or later, choose a default app from inside the app, or select a different app for each widget in the Lock Screen editor.
• On iOS 16, use the existing individual app shortcut widgets.
Calendar — today and the weeks around it
• See today's weekday and date in a circular widget.
• Choose 3 or 4 rows for the rectangular calendar.
• Pick the row containing today to show more of the past or upcoming weeks.
• Settings save automatically, with a preview as you make changes.
Pedometer — follow your daily movement
• Check steps, progress toward your goal and distance.
• Set a daily step goal and choose kilometers or miles.
• Refresh in the app and check the last update time. On iOS 17 or later, you can also tap the pedometer widget to refresh.
Countdown — keep important dates in sight
• Save an event name and date, then see the days remaining or elapsed in a widget.
• Use it for anniversaries, trips or other dates you want to remember.
Illustrated help, inside the app
Find visual instructions for adding widgets and using each feature. Search the guides even offline. The app supports 12 languages.
Good to know
• Steps require Motion & Fitness permission. iOS controls when widgets refresh automatically.
• App Store search does not identify installed apps. Launch support varies by app, and opening may pass through this app or Shortcuts.
• A Dock session can stay active for up to 8 hours and remain on the Lock Screen for up to 4 more hours. It may end sooner. Optional renewal works while this app is open; start the Dock again if it ends.

The information in this app is documented by a healthcare professional in the Electronic Medical Record ONLY after solicited consultation and is then selectively and carefully shared with the patient for their easy access.

bluejetty:00153505:ios.description:
Offline Music Player is the ultimate music player for enjoying your favorite songs anytime, anywhere. Listen to offline music with no Wi-Fi required, stream online HD music videos, and access global radio stations—all in one powerful offline music player. Whether you want to relax, commute, or travel, this mp3 player delivers a smooth listening experience without internet.
With Offline Music Player, you can manage, organize, and discover music efficiently. The app now includes enhanced music recognition, letting you identify any song instantly while importing, including album cover, artist, and lyrics.
Three Ways to Enjoy Music
Offline Music Playback
Play your personal offline music collection anywhere. The offline player allows you to enjoy songs anytime, even with no Wi-Fi or without internet.
Online HD Music & Video Streaming
Stream high-definition music videos on demand via YouTube. Discover new songs and enjoy a visual music experience directly within your music player.
Global FM Radio
Listen to over 100,000 FM radio stations from 200+ countries. Enjoy music, news, and talk shows worldwide, complementing your offline music library.
Key Features
Professional Music Player & MP3 Player
Supports multiple audio formats including MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, WMA, PCM, and more. Play your offline music without converting files. This mp3 player ensures high-quality sound for every song.
Multiple Import Methods & Music Downloader
Easily add songs from local storage, Wi-Fi transfer, Apple Music, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, or OneDrive. The built-in music downloader allows you to import tracks efficiently and expand your offline music library.
Advanced Audio Equalizer
Customize sound with the 5-band equalizer, bass boost, and reverb effects. Every song can be played exactly the way you like, whether using wired or Bluetooth headphones.
Enhanced Music Recognition
Import any short audio clip to instantly identify the song. The app automatically detects artist, album cover, and lyrics during import, helping you organize your offline music library quickly.
Sleep Timer
Set a timer to stop music automatically. Ideal for listening to songs before bedtime, even without internet.
Quick Sort & Global Search
Sort songs by name, album, artist, duration, or file size. Use global search to quickly find any track in your offline music player.
Powerful Tag Editor
Edit song titles, artist names, album covers, release dates, genres, and more. Customize your offline music experience for full personalization.
Custom Themes & Skins
Choose from multiple built-in themes and player skins. The interface of this offline player is modern, clean, and fully customizable.
Headphone & Bluetooth Support
Enjoy clear, stable playback on wired or Bluetooth headphones. This music player ensures a premium experience for every song.
Why Choose Offline Music Player
Reliable music player for everyday use
Full offline music support, even with no Wi-Fi
Powerful mp3 player with multi-format support
Listen to music without internet anytime
Built-in music downloader and enhanced music recognition
Smart organization, tagging, and global search
Stream online HD music videos and global radio seamlessly
Ideal offline player for iPhone and iPad
Download Offline Music Player now and enjoy unlimited offline music, complete mp3 player features, and seamless playback for every song.
Privacy & Subscription
We strictly follow our privacy policy to protect your data. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.

Listen to offline music with no Wi-Fi required, stream online HD music videos, and access global radio stations—all in one powerful offline music player. Whether you want to relax, commute, or travel, this mp3 player delivers a smooth listening experience without internet.

With Offline Music Player, you can manage, organize, and discover music efficiently. The app now includes enhanced music recognition, letting you identify any song instantly while importing, including album cover, artist, and lyrics.

Three Ways to Enjoy Music

Offline Music Playback
Play your personal offline music collection anywhere. The offline player allows you to enjoy songs anytime, even with no Wi-Fi or without internet.

Online HD Music & Video Streaming
Stream high-definition music videos on demand via YouTube. Discover new songs and enjoy a visual music experience directly within your music player.

Global FM Radio
Listen to over 100,000 FM radio stations from 200+ countries. Enjoy music, news, and talk shows worldwide, complementing your offline music library.

Key Features

Professional Music Player & MP3 Player
Supports multiple audio formats including MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, WMA, PCM, and more. Play your offline music without converting files. This mp3 player ensures high-quality sound for every song.

Multiple Import Methods & Music Downloader
Easily add songs from local storage, Wi-Fi transfer, Apple Music, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, or OneDrive. The built-in music downloader allows you to import tracks efficiently and expand your offline music library.

Advanced Audio Equalizer
Customize sound with the 5-band equalizer, bass boost, and reverb effects. Every song can be played exactly the way you like, whether using wired or Bluetooth headphones.

Enhanced Music Recognition
Import any short audio clip to instantly identify the song. The app automatically detects artist, album cover, and lyrics during import, helping you organize your offline music library quickly.

Sleep Timer
Set a timer to stop music automatically. Ideal for listening to songs before bedtime, even without internet.

Quick Sort & Global Search
Sort songs by name, album, artist, duration, or file size. Use global search to quickly find any track in your offline music player.

Powerful Tag Editor
Edit song titles, artist names, album covers, release dates, genres, and more. Customize your offline music experience for full personalization.

Custom Themes & Skins
Choose from multiple built-in themes and player skins. The interface of this offline player is modern, clean, and fully customizable.

Headphone & Bluetooth Support
Enjoy clear, stable playback on wired or Bluetooth headphones. This music player ensures a premium experience for every song.

Why Choose Offline Music Player

Reliable music player for everyday use

Full offline music support, even with no Wi-Fi

Powerful mp3 player with multi-format support

Listen to music without internet anytime

Built-in music downloader and enhanced music recognition

Smart organization, tagging, and global search

Stream online HD music videos and global radio seamlessly

Ideal offline player for iPhone and iPad

Download Offline Music Player now and enjoy unlimited offline music, complete mp3 player features, and seamless playback for every song.

Privacy & Subscription

We strictly follow our privacy policy to protect your data. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00089137:ios.description:
Amaru is here to support your self-care!
Feed, pet, customize, and play minigames with the adorable Amaru while being rewarded for taking care of yourself! The game contains engaging goal-setting, mindfulness, and journal activities that provide a fun way to build focus and resilience to stress, anxiety, and depression.
Explore the mysterious world of Enso to earn Collectibles, unlock Amaru’s story, and help him find his way home!
“Finally, a game that promotes (and reinforces) positive, long-term mental-health habits! It's enjoyable & the artwork is beautifully done. Daily goals are customizable, but there is a variety of preset goals to choose from to get you started. It's calming at the end of your day and refreshing at the beginning. Doesn't leave you frustrated and mentally depleted like most other games. Plus, magic kitties!”
“It's clear that the people behind this app care about helping people. I am genuinely floored about how focused the game is on self-care and the player. This is especially apparent in the 'free trial' aspect of this app- none of the self-care elements are behind a paywall, and they have an entire system for people to donate full copies of the game to those in financial need. The game is reassuring and never unhealthily pressures. also the animation is so good. I'd say more but I have no more space.”
FINANCIAL NEED? READ BELOW!
Want the full version but can’t afford it? No problem! All the self-care features in the app are completely FREE, and the game contains NO ADS! There will be points where you will be asked to pay to unlock story features or optional skins, but if you have financial need, you can apply for a free copy through our Keys for Those in Need Program. You’ll be given a place in line, and when a copy becomes available, you’ll receive it for FREE! We just ask that you pay it forward when you can!
WHAT’S INSIDE:
 • A virtual pet to feed, pet, and care for! 
 • Make Amaru your own with custom colors and skins!
 • Beautiful hand-drawn animation that evolves as your Bond grows stronger.
 • A goal-setting system that rewards you for self-care.
 • Journaling modes that promote free expression and support well-being. 
 • 20+ guided breathing and mindfulness meditation recordings scientifically shown to reduce stress, anxiety and depression with voicing and subtitles.
 • Fun, low-pressure Mini-games to play with Amaru 
 • Gorgeous environments with unique, relaxing soundscapes like ocean waves or falling rain.
 • 100+ lore-rich items revealing details about the fantasy world of Enso and its inhabitants.
 • Hundreds of player-submitted Affirmation messages to brighten your day!
LANGUAGES:
This app is only in available in English.
FOLLOW US:
@fogofmaya on IG and TikTok. You can communicate with us via Discord (link is in the app).

bluejetty:00070510:ios.summary:
WhatsAgain is a powerful WhatsApp Web companion for iPhone and iPad. Use multiple WhatsApp accounts, manage dual chat sessions, and access WhatsApp Web in a clean full-screen experience.
Perfect for users who need WhatsApp and WhatsApp Bus
bluejetty:00070510:ios.description:
WhatsAgain is a powerful WhatsApp Web companion for iPhone and iPad. Use multiple WhatsApp accounts, manage dual chat sessions, and access WhatsApp Web in a clean full-screen experience.
Perfect for users who need WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business on the same device, manage personal and work chats, or keep several accounts organized from one app.
With WhatsAgain you can:
• Pair WhatsApp Web accounts using a QR code
• Add and manage multiple chat sessions
• Use WhatsApp Web on iPhone and iPad
• Organize personal, work, support, or business accounts
• Rename sessions for easier access
• Import and review session records from Files or AirDrop
• Enjoy a modern interface with Premium Dark Mode 
Whether you use WhatsApp for personal messages, WhatsApp Business, customer support, or dual chat account management, WhatsAgain helps you keep everything easier to access.
WhatsAgain works by connecting to the official WhatsApp Web service. Open the app, scan the QR code from your WhatsApp account, and start using your session inside WhatsAgain.
Use WhatsAgain as your WhatsApp Web client when you need a second WhatsApp account, WhatsApp Business access, dual messenger workflows, or a cleaner iPad chat experience. It is designed for users who manage work chats, customer messages, support accounts, personal conversations, and multi-account WhatsApp sessions from one place.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
You can find all related information in these links:
PGDMobile / iWazowski.com Terms of Service: https://pgdmobile.com/legal/pdf/Terms_of_Service.pdf
PGDMobile / iWazowski.com Privacy Policy: http://pgdmobile.com/legal/pdf/Privacy_Policy.pdf
1) About Subscription:
WhatsAgain offers you the following subscription:
Monthly Membership offers a monthly subscription for $0.99 after a 3-day free trial. After buying this subscription, you will unlock the following features: Send audio messages, you will be able to signin the app with your Google account, you will be able to save your WhatsApp Web session in the cloud, you will be able to open your stored sessions in other device signing in with your Google account.
2) About end of trial and subscription renewal:
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
3) About canceling trial or subscription:
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer have access to premium features.
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at support@iwazowski.com
Disclaimer: WhatsAgain is a third-party app for WhatsApp. It does not have, nor does it exist, any commercial relationship, nor is it endorsed or endorsed by WhatsApp, Facebook Inc. or any of its affiliates. The application connects to your official WhatsApp Web account and complies with the terms of use of WhatsApp.

bluejetty:00117714:ios.name: Erste mBanking
bluejetty:00117714:ios.summary:
Erste mBanking usluga je mobilnog bankarstva Erste banke kojom jednostavno i sigurno možete obavljati sve svoje financijske transakcije pametnim telefonom, a uz standardnu identifikaciju 4-znamenkastim mPIN-om, ili biometrijom.
Jedinstven
bluejetty:00117714:ios.description:
Erste mBanking usluga je mobilnog bankarstva Erste banke kojom jednostavno i sigurno možete obavljati sve svoje financijske transakcije pametnim telefonom, a uz standardnu identifikaciju 4-znamenkastim mPIN-om, ili biometrijom.
Jedinstveni zaslon za unos naloga još više olakšava plaćanja i prijenos sredstava. Opcija Slikaj i plati, s kojom je ručno popunjavanje naloga postalo prošlost, sad vam je nadohvat prsta, a umjesto internim prijenosom sva kunska plaćanja zadajete na jednom zaslonu.
Korisnici mogu učitavati fakture iz galerije ili skenirati pojedine elemente fakture, pregledavati i potpisivati naloge u kunskim datotekama te naručivati izvode i fakture za svoje poslovne račune uz znatno niže naknade.
Sigurnu prijavu u usluge e-bankarstva omogućuje mToken - jednostavna opcija unutar mBankinga koja unosom 4-znamenkastog mPIN-a daje kontrolu nad vlastitim transakcijama. mToken je besplatan, a za njegovo je korištenje potrebno imati ugovorenu uslugu NetBanking ili FonBanking te potom preuzeti mBanking aplikaciju.
Osim navedenoga, Erste mBanking omogućuje:
* praćenje stanja i prometa po svim Erste računima
* pregledavanje svih transakcija zadanih putem mBankinga i NetBankinga
* plaćanje svih vrsta računa u kunama općom uplatnicom te izvršavanje obveza po kreditima i obavljanje kupoprodaje deviza
* pregledavanje oročene štednje i kredita i postavljanje zahtjeva za predodobrenim kreditom
* pregledavanje stanja, transakcija i računa kreditnih kartica
* pregledavanje ugovorenih fondova te zadavanje zahtjeva za otkup i izdavanje fondova
* pregledavanje tečajne liste i preračunavanje valuta
* pronalazak najbliže Erste poslovnice ili Erste bankomata
* aktivaciju mBankinga preko aplikacije, bez odlaska u poslovnicu
* pregledavanje i ažuriranje osobnih podataka
Minimalna podržana verzija iOS-a je 15.2.
Za korištenje Touch ID funkcionalnosti potrebno je imati model iPhone 5S ili noviji.
 Erste mBanking is Erste Bank's mobile banking service, which enables you to carry out all financial transactions using only your smartphone. Depending on settings and devices, it provides authentication by 4-digit mPIN or with biometry.
The unique/unified payment screen makes payments and fund transfers even easier. The PhotoPay feature, with which manually filling orders has become a thing of the past, is now at your fingertips, and the internal transfer option has been incorporated into a single screen, where you can make all types of national payments.
You can upload invoices from the gallery or scan parts of the invoice, review and sign orders for national payment files, and order statements and invoices for their business accounts with significantly lower fees.
Erste Bank's secure e-banking services are accessible via mToken, a simple option  within the mBanking app that lets you control all your financial transactions via a  4-digit mPIN. As a NetBanking or FonBanking user, you can download the free mBanking app and start using the mToken option.
In addition to the above, Erste mBanking allows:
* monitoring of balance and traffic by all Erste accounts,
* view all transactions made on mBanking and NetBanking,
* payment of all types of national invoices by general payment slip, execution of obligations per loans, and conducting foreign currency purchases,
* reviewing terms of savings and loans as well as setting requirements for a pre-approved loan,
* check balances, transactions, and view credit card accounts,
* reviewing contracted funds and issuing requests for the purchase and issuance of funds,
* viewing exchange rates and converting currencies,
* assistance in locating the nearest Erste branch or Erste ATM,
* activation of the mBanking app through the application itself, without visiting the branch,
* view and update of personal information.
Minimal version requirement: iOS 15.2.
The Touch ID feature is available on iPhone 5s or later.

Try your hand at the wedding business! Holly runs a chain of wedding salons, and your job is to help her manage and develop it, while providing top-notch customer service. 
Salon customers have dozens of things to do: make a beautiful bouquet, choose a fabulous dress or an elegant suit, find unique gifts for the bride and groom – and that’s only the half of it. The money you earn can be used to hire staff and upgrade equipment. As for the experience you gain, it will come in handy soon: Holly is getting married, too, and she wants her wedding to be absolutely perfect!

- 7 types of mini game to test your reactions and observation skills
- Demanding customers and challenging situations
- Wedding preparations
- Business and romance in perfect harmony

bluejetty:00140903:ios.description:
Imagine your paper planner is always at hand, without the need to carry stationery to write things down.
What if we told you we’d made your wish come true? 
FLIP THROUGH PAPER PAGES
For those who value nature but miss the feel of paper, we’ve created the best planner design with realistic page-flipping! 
YOUR WEEKLY RHYTHM, YOUR RULES
Whether you're mapping out a busy workweek or a slow Sunday, arrange your days however you like.
MONTHS, SIMPLIFIED
Your real calendar, swipeable month to month. Today stands out in color. Add plain-text tasks in seconds. Because sometimes a month needs its own page. And yes, it still lives inside your cute weekly planner world.
CHOOSE THE BEST THEME
Minimalist. Cute. Colorful. Botanical. Or something in between. Every theme turns your digital planner into a space you actually want to look at.
MAKE IT YOURS — THE ARTFUL WAY
Turn a simple weekly schedule into something you actually enjoy. Scribble tasks with style — checkmarks you’ll love, markers that mean something, and fonts that bend to your mood (italic, bold, or strikethrough the done list). Switch page colors, pick a different layout, drop aesthetic stickers or generate one with AI. Because making your schedule cute isn't about extra steps; it's about making your daily rhythm feel lighter.
KEEP YOUR THOUGHTS PRIVATE
Protect your personal plans and ideas with a password lock, ensuring everything remains private and secure. 
A WEEK AT A GLANCE
See seven days without clutter. Make lists, style them, get things done — your time, your layout. No rigid grids, just rhythm.
Plan your days with intention. Make your calendar feel less like a tool and more like your own cute planner.
The free version keeps it simple — one theme, basic tools, and a clean start.
Upgrade to unlock the full palette: all visual themes, any color from the wheel, password privacy, and a library of checkboxes that actually feels good to tap. Because planning shouldn’t feel restricted — just inspired.
Privacy policy: https://creativeworkshop.club/privacy
Terms of use: https://creativeworkshop.club/tos

Tackle math the smart way. From simple arithmetic to complex equations, our app helps you solve math problems with ease. Simply point your phone camera and capture the equation. Using powerful photo math and foto math features, the app provides instant and accurate answers. This is more than just a free math solver — it's a complete solution for anyone who needs help with math.

- Snap a photo of your math problem with the camera math function.
- Instantly get solutions using photo math and math answer scanner tools.

- Step-by-step breakdowns to help you understand, not just memorize.
- Interactive graphs for visual learners tackling geometry and functions.
- Take on quizzes to test your knowledge and track progress.
- Receive smart tips and learning tricks with every solution.
- Works with printed and handwritten problems — your paper notes are covered.
- Solve arithmetic, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, calculus, and more.
- An intuitive, clean interface built for speed and simplicity.
** Designed for All Levels of Learning **
Whether you're a student needing a geometry solver, a parent helping with homework, or simply brushing up on skills, this app is your best companion. You can take a picture, scan, and solve using camera math tools that are faster and more accurate than ever. ENTER THE WAR. BECOME A HERO.
Step into the boots of a fearless soldier and experience the intensity of World War 2 in an action-packed offline FPS. Fight through dangerous battlefields, complete challenging missions, and lead the charge against enemy forces—all without an internet connection.

Europe & Pacific environments
Slow-motion kill cams
Extraction missions
Immersive 3D graphics

Optimized for storage and battery efficiency
No internet? No problem.
Load your weapon, join Max, enter the battlefield, and fight your way through history.
CALL OF COURAGE: WORLD WAR 2 THE BATTLE IS IN YOUR HANDS.

bluejetty:00039570:ios.summary:

Yatırım hesabınla NASDAQ ve New York Stock Exchange üzerindeki his
bluejetty:00039570:ios.description:
**Hızlı ve kolay yatırım yap
Uygulamayı indirerek dakikalar içinde yatırım hesabını açabilir, para yatırıp hemen yatırıma başlayabilirsin.
**Amerikan borsasından hisse al
Yatırım hesabınla NASDAQ ve New York Stock Exchange üzerindeki hisselere ve borsa yatırım fonlarına (ETF) yatırım yapabilir, opsiyon işlemlerini gerçekleştirebilirsin. Apple, Tesla ve Amazon gibi dünyaca ünlü şirketlerin hisse senetlerini dilediğin tutarda tek tıkla alabilirsin.
**Avrupa borsalarıyla yatırımlarını çeşitlendir
Almanya’nın SAP, Allianz, Siemens gibi büyük şirketlerine doğrudan euro ile yatırım yapabilir, euro ile temettü alabilirsin.
**Avantajlı kur oranları
Midas yatırım hesabına Türk Lirası ya da Amerikan Doları gönderebilirsin. Ayrıca avantajlı kur oranlarıyla dolar alım-satım işlemleri yaparak Amerikan borsalarına ya da Borsa İstanbul'a yatırım yapabilirsin.
**Borsa İstanbul'da hisse al-sat 
Borsa İstanbul'daki Türk Hava Yolları, Aselsan, Tüpraş ve Enka gibi şirketlere yatırım yapabilir; BIMAS, FROTO gibi hisseleri portföyüne ekleyerek temettü alabilirsin.
**Midas SPK lisanslı, güvenilir bir kurumdur
Tıpkı bankalar gibi Midas da düzenli olarak denetlenen ve belli regülasyonlar çerçevesinde hareket eden bir finans uygulamasıdır.
*SIPC hesap güvencesi
Yatırım hesabına $500.000’a kadar SIPC hesap güvencesi, Türkiye'de ilk defa Midas yatırım hesabında.
**Halka arza katılım Midas'ta
Midas yatırım hesabınla borsada satış yöntemiyle halka arzlara katılabilirsin. Şirketin ismini veya borsa kodunu yazıp talep ettiğin hisse adedini girerek borsadan satış yöntemiyle halka arzlara katılabilirsin.
**VİOP ve varant Midas’ta
Vadeli işlem ve opsiyon piyasası ile hisse, endeks, döviz ve kıymetli maden kontratlarını kapsayan türev ürünlere Midas ile kolayca yatırım yapabilirsin.
**Yatırım fonları Midas'ta
Midas yatırım hesabınla fon alıp satabilirsin. Tema ve koleksiyonlarla fonları kolayca inceleyebilir, yeni fonlar keşfedebilirsin. TEFAS fonlarında komisyon ödemediğin gibi hesap işletim ya da saklama ücreti vb. masraflarla da uğraşmazsın.
**Hisse senedi al
Kullanıcı dostu arayüzü ile Midas'ta hisse al-sat işlemleri çok kolay. Midas uygulamasındaki Borsa İstanbul ile Amerikan ve Avrupa borsalarına dair güncel içerikleri ve uzman hisse listelerini takip ederek yatırımlarına kolayca yön verebilirsin.
**Parça hisse ile dilediğin tutarda hisse al
Amerikan borsalarında hisse fiyatı ne olursa olsun, dilediğin hisseyi bütçene uygun tutarla almanı sağlayan "Parça Hisse" özelliği Türkiye'de ilk defa Midas'ta.
**Ücretsiz canlı borsa verisi Midas'ta!
İlgilendiğin hisseleri Takip Listene ekleyip hisse fiyatlarını ANLIK olarak izleyebilirsin.
**Midas'ta altın alım-satım fırsatı
Darphane tarafından halka arz edilen Altın Sertifikası Midas'ta. Midas yatırım hesabınla dilediğin zaman nakde veya fiziksel altına dönüştürebileceğin Altın Sertifikası alabilirsin.
**Dünya piyasaları cebinde
Türk, Amerikan ve Avrupa borsalarına dair güncel haberler, analizler; piyasalara yön veren finans ve ekonomi haberleri ile borsa gündemini takip etmek çok kolay.
"Piyasalar" sayfasından BIST 100 ve BIST 30 gibi BIST endekslerinin yanı sıra S&P 500, Nasdaq ve DAX gibi dünya endekslerini de takip edebilirsin.
**Gizli ve ek ücret yok
Diğer aracı kurumlar, periyodik olarak hesap işletim ücreti alırken Midas'ta hesap işletim ücreti ödemezsin. Yatırımların Midas hesabında durduğu sürece, hiç işlem yapmasan bile ek ücret talep edilmez.
Her türlü öneri ve soru için destek@getmidas.com adresimizden veya getmidas.com ve midasmenkul.com adresinden ulaşabilirsin.
Midas ile hemen yatırıma başla.
Aracılık hizmetleri, yatırım hizmet ve faaliyetleri, Sermaye Piyasası tarafından yetkilendirilen lisanslı Midas Menkul Değerler A.Ş. aracılığıyla sunulmaktadır. Sunulan hizmetlere erişim Midas Finansal Teknolojiler A.Ş. tarafından sağlanan Midas mobil uygulaması üzerinden sağlanmaktadır.

- Supports sending instant push notifications.
- Provides the option to click snapshots in event logs to play back previous events.
- Displays camera locations and event icons on E-maps to allow for comprehensive monitoring.

bluejetty:00178982:ios.description:
DRIVE SAFELY AND AVOID FINES
Yanosik is an app with an unbeatable warning system appreciated by millions of drivers. It will notify you about speed checks, speed cameras, road disruptions, accidents, and even unmarked police cars. Use the online-updated database of reports and measuring devices in Poland and across Europe to travel more safely and with greater peace of mind — also abroad.
NAVIGATE WITH AN ONLINE MAP
Yanosik guides you based on up-to-date road data and a multi-million address database. We add new roads and take changes in traffic organization into account to help you reach your destination more efficiently.
AVOID TRAFFIC JAMS WITH YANOSIK TRAFFIC
Yanosik is your source of road information both on expressways and in Poland’s largest cities. You will receive advance information about disruptions along your route, so you can reach your destination efficiently without sitting in traffic. You will also stay up to date with events in your city that may affect traffic.
LISTEN TO RADIO YANOSIK ON THE ROAD AND BEYOND!
Yanosik not only helps you on the road, but also makes your journey more enjoyable. Turn on Radio Yanosik, listen to great music, and vote for the best songs. You will also find interesting shows, podcasts, and news from Poland and around the world. You can listen to Radio Yanosik not only while traveling, but anywhere you have internet access.
WE HAVE EVERYTHING A DRIVER NEEDS
Yanosik is every driver’s best friend! It will help you with many matters related to driving and owning a car. In the app, you have the most important features at your fingertips. In addition to the road communicator and navigation, you can use many services:
- You can place a vehicle sale listing FOR FREE and browse offers of verified cars (Autoplac),
- compare car insurance offers and buy a policy in just a few minutes,
- purchase vignettes for trips abroad,
- pay for motorway travel in Poland,
- buy travel insurance,
- check your vehicle history, including mileage, repairs, and number of owners,
- use a record of expenses related to your car,
- check where to refuel at the lowest price,
- find a repair shop, check its reviews, and book an appointment,
- use additional discounts,
- add your regular routes to favorites and check the current travel time and weather at a given location,
- call roadside assistance and emergency services,
- order products from our store or connect additional devices.
USE FOR FREE OR SUBSCRIBE
The Yanosik app is available free of charge and contains advertising content. Ads can be turned off at any time by purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00169577:ios.description:
Ragnarok Origin: ROO — a sequel to the beloved, classic RO. Officially developed and operated by Gravity.
Participate in the new server launch events to win luxurious rewards and embark on a new adventure!
Immerse yourself in a vast fantasy world full of mysterious monsters and extraordinary characters. Explore massive landscapes, legendary kingdoms, and dreadful dungeons with your pets and pals!
=== Features ===
-- Adventure never ends. Sakura falls, shadows rise to protect the homeland --
The new ROO expansion, Misty Amatsu, is now live!
Follow the path of the Ninja into a world never before explored—where love and truth lie buried beneath corruption.
In Amatsu, falling sakura paint a picture of beauty, while danger quietly hides within its romance.
A new job, a new map, a new story—an unknown adventure awaits.
[Amatsu Scroll Unfolds]
For years, the sound of falling petals echoed through the mist.
The new map Amatsu, a city shrouded in an unseen curse, finally reveals itself to adventurers.
Nestled between mountains and water, this lush island is filled with blooming sakura and elegant wooden buildings—peaceful, yet unsettling.
Beneath its beauty lingers an unknown evil.
Now the seal is broken. Step into this forbidden land, lift the mist behind its sorrowful beauty, and uncover the truth and love buried within.
This time, the adventure is no fairy tale.
[New Job: Ninja – Shadow Strike]
From the shadows, blades are drawn. The first new job from the East—Ninja—joins the battlefield!
They wear no heavy armor and cast no long incantations.
Instead, they move like the wind, strike from the shadows, and wield deadly precision with throwing weapons.
Ninjas excel in mobility and burst damage. At 3rd job advancement, they can choose between Kunai or Ninjutsu builds.
Master both arts to greatly enhance your damage and become an unpredictable force on the battlefield.
Join Ninja and protect the peace of Amatsu.
[New Monsters · MVPs Arrive]
The curse awakens. Monsters emerge.
With the opening of Amatsu, unknown creatures rise from the shadows.
Deep within lies an ancient Underground Shrine, its stone walls worn and runes faintly glowing.
In the flickering candlelight, the air is heavy with mystery and unease.
Whispers echo through the halls, as if responding to forgotten rituals—power long dormant stirs once more.
New MVPs such as The Immortal Koshei and Samurai Specter await challengers!
Defeat them to earn extra rewards and exclusive titles.
Sound the horn—the hunt begins.
[Level Cap Increased to 150]
The boundaries of adventure expand once more. The level cap has been raised to 150.
Prepare yourself for the next chapter of your journey!
=== Stay Connected ===
Join Ragnarok Origin: ROO and embark on a journey to protect Midgard together!
Kind Reminder
Ragnarok Origin is free to download, with some of its contents and features requiring in-app payment;
Please keep your gaming time in check, and maintain proper rest.

bluejetty:00042595:ios.description:
Your All-In-One Digital Wallet & Barcode Scanner
Add any barcode to your wallet by simply scanning them. From store cards and membership cards to boarding passes to concert tickets, keep everything organized in one place.
Easy to Use
Our lightning-fast scanner reads any barcode instantly. Best of all, it works completely offline - no internet required! Display your barcodes when you need them or set helpful reminders so you never forget to use them.
Works with Everything
Anycode Wallet supports a wide range of formats for any situation:
* Shopping: UPC, EAN for retail products and store cards
* Travel: Aztec for tickets, PDF417 for boarding pass wallet
* Events: QR codes for concerts, venues, and more
* Coupons: Scan and store discount codes and offers
* Business: Code 39, Code 128, Data Matrix for inventory
* Specialty: Codabar, ITF, Telepen for specialized uses
With all these formats supported, you really can forget your physical wallet! Simple, reliable, and always ready when you need it.
Create Your Own
No barcode? No problem! Create any barcode with ease. Whether you need a custom code for your business or want to generate a QR code for sharing, we've got you covered.
Subscription Terms
Choose monthly or yearly subscription to unlock premium features. Payment charged to iTunes Account at purchase confirmation. Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before period ends. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to end of current period. Manage subscriptions in Apple Account Settings.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://anycodewallet.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://anycodewallet.com/terms-conditions.html

bluejetty:00179152:ios.name: My Health Planner
bluejetty:00179152:ios.summary: My Health Planner helps connect you with your care team right on your iPhone or iPad. You can send a private message at any time to your care team — it's as easy as texting, but more secure. Your care team can help you feel in control of yo
bluejetty:00179152:ios.description:
My Health Planner helps connect you with your care team right on your iPhone or iPad. You can send a private message at any time to your care team — it's as easy as texting, but more secure. Your care team can help you feel in control of your health and ensure you understand what you need to do to feel your best.
Keep in touch with our care management team — in between appointments. Set reminders to help remember your medications, and track your steps and progress over time. We take your privacy and security seriously and My Health Planner is fully HIPAA compliant.
My Health Planner is free for eligible members as part of your benefits — just sign up with the access code you received from your care team. You will need your insurance card as well.
If you have questions or need help signing up, please call the number on the back of your member ID card.
Who can use this app:
- If you are a member of BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina, BlueChoice Health Plan or the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Service Benefit Plan, also known as the Federal Employee Program (FEP ® )) this app is for you.
- If you are a member of a different BlueCross plan, this app may be included. Just check the back of your insurance card to see if “My Health Toolkit” is part of your health plan’s website.
- This app supports all medical and dental benefit plans administered by BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina and BlueChoice Health Plan. This app also supports some large employer plans administered on behalf of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Florida, CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Kansas, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Kansas City, Excellus BlueCross BlueShield, BlueCross BlueShield of Western New York, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina, BlueCross & BlueShield of Rhode Island, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Vermont, Capital Blue Cross and BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee. Each of these Blue Plans is an independent licensee of the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association.
The app supports most of our members, but will not work for:
Medicaid members
My Health Planner works with Apple Health for certain care programs, such as those that provide a step count task.
Seek a doctor’s advice before making any medical decisions. This app is designed for education and to provide support between provider visits. If you're enrolled in an eligible care program you may connect a glucometer to share readings with your care management team, but should continue to check with your doctor before making any changes to diet, exercise, or treatment plan.

bluejetty:00131655:ios.summary: ICD10 Consult puts the most searchable, complete, current ICD-10-CM resource at your fingertips — the full 2027 code set, effective October 1, 2026. With flexible search that speaks your language, a deep understanding of the codes, customiz
bluejetty:00131655:ios.description:
ICD10 Consult puts the most searchable, complete, current ICD-10-CM resource at your fingertips — the full 2027 code set, effective October 1, 2026. With flexible search that speaks your language, a deep understanding of the codes, customizable code notes integrated into your search results, and more, this is the resource you wish your EMR provided.
With ICD10 Consult, you'll never have to flip through a 30-pound book or go hunting for a coding reference page again... nor will you scratch your head wondering which "magic word" is in the code's name.
• Modern, fast interface with full iPad split view, hardware keyboard, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver support — Liquid Glass design on iOS 26, and runs on iOS 17 or later
• Deep code analysis allows easy handling of laterality, encounter, and staging codes, letting the app do the work of finding the perfect code
• Add your own custom notes to any code — searchable, and shown seamlessly within your search results
• Tens of thousands of medical acronyms and synonyms are transparently cross-referenced to let you search using the terms you are used to; e.g. "MI" to "Myocardial Infarction"
• Search term flexibility understands that, for example, "vertebrae" matches "vertebra" and "ovarian" matches "ovary"
• ICD-10 tabular and alphabetical indexes integrated and simultaneously accessed to maximize results
• Instant linkage within code descriptions
• Coding guidelines as well as section and chapter instructions tightly integrated
• Know at a glance if a code is valid for reimbursement or if more specificity is needed
• Browse diagnoses by chapter, section, and subsection; search within specific hierarchies
• Favorites list allows quick access to your most common codes, with groups to organize them
The 2027 ICD-10-CM codes took effect October 1, 2026, and the app is updated every October with the new year's code set. The complete code database is drawn directly from the data files published by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).
ICD10 Consult is ad supported to provide you with the current, up-to-date codes. An annual auto-renewing subscription is available to disable ads. There are no bait-and-switch limited features.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://regularrateandrhythm.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00150171:ios.summary:
