bluejetty:00150171:ios.description:
The CobbLinc app is a one-stop-shop app for Cobb's Microtransit and Paratransit services. 
Microtransit 
CobbLinc Go is a new on-demand microtransit transit service tailored to improve access in South Cobb, across Austell, Powder Springs, and southwestern Marietta. The service will operate in one large service area comprising the previous three FLEX zones. Commute, run errands, connect to the route 25 & 30 bus lines, and more, all on your schedule. The service is a part of a two-year pilot program to enhance public transportation in South Cobb.
Book a microtransit ride in the CobbLinc app or call us a few minutes before you're ready to leave. We'll pick you up and drop you off steps from your door. When you ride, you'll be grouped with others headed in the same direction. Wheelchair accessible vehicles are available.
Paratransit
CobbLinc's Paratransit Service is a shared-ride, curb-to-curb service for customers with disabilities who are not able to use the regular bus service (also called "fixed route") for some or all of their trips because of a disability or other limitations. CobbLinc provides Paratransit Service through a contract with Transdev, but monitors and oversees all aspects of the service. Connect to shopping, social events, medical appointments, hospitals, jobs, and more around Cobb County with our free app, CobbLinc.
Paratransit service is provided Monday through Sunday and the daily operating hours are comparable to CobbLinc's local bus service hours. The service area for CobbLinc's Paratransit Service covers a three-quarter (¾) mile radius around the existing local bus routes in Cobb County and limited areas in Fulton County. 
Please call CobbLinc to book your trip up to 3 days in advance, and receive trip reminders and updates on vehicle arrival time. The reservationist will let you know your 30 minute pickup window for when the vehicle will arrive. You are expected to be ready at any time during that pickup window. On the day before your trip, you will receive an automated call or text reminder for each trip you have scheduled.
When our vehicle is near your location on the day of the trip, we will send you an automated call or text notification. When your driver arrives, they will wait up to 6 minutes at your pickup location. If they arrive early, they will wait until the start of your pickup window, and then wait another 6 minutes.
There may be others on board, and you may make some additional stops before you reach your desired destination. You can track your ride and share your status in real-time from the app. 
Our vehicles are wheelchair accessible and are operated by specially trained drivers. Whether you want to run an errand, visit a friend, or need reliable transit to recurring events (work, appointments, etc.), CobbLinc will get you there!
Questions? Reach out at 770-429-4444

bluejetty:00132259:ios.description:
Speedify keeps you online when your internet drops. Bond Starlink with 5G, 4G, Wi-Fi, or Ethernet so satellite obstructions, dead zones, and dropouts can't take down your video calls, livestreams, or work. Plus a fast VPN to keep it all secure.
Most apps switch between internet connections. Speedify uses all of them at the same time, splitting your traffic across every available link, so a single dropout never reaches your apps. Calls don't reset. Streams don't buffer. Uploads don't restart. You stay online.
BUILT FOR STARLINK
Starlink is fast, but it's not perfect. Satellite handoffs cause brief signal gaps. A tree branch or rain storm causes obstructions. A power blip takes the dish offline. Speedify covers all of it by bonding your Starlink with cellular, Wi-Fi, or a second connection, so when Starlink stutters, the other connection picks up the slack instantly.
- Bond Starlink with 5G, 4G, Wi-Fi, or Ethernet
- Real-time Starlink dish telemetry inside the app: see obstructions, alignment, signal quality, hardware and software versions
- Get alerted to obstructions or hardware errors before they take you offline
- Bond two Starlink dishes into one network for double the bandwidth and full redundancy
- Works for fixed homes, RVs, boats, remote sites, and anywhere a single dish isn't enough
WHO USES SPEEDIFY
RV TRAVELERS & BOATERS: Combine Starlink with cellular so trees and dead zones don't end your work day. Pair & Share lets you bond connections with others traveling with you.
REMOTE WORKERS: Stay on Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet without freezing when your home internet hiccups.
LIVESTREAMERS & CREATORS: Combine Wi-Fi, cellular, and Starlink for smooth streams to Twitch, YouTube, and broadcast destinations.
GAMERS: Reduce lag and packet loss by using all your connections at once.
JOURNALISTS & FIELD CREWS: Bond every available connection for live broadcasts and file uploads from anywhere.
HOW SPEEDIFY WORKS
CHANNEL BONDING: Speedify merges all active connections into one fast, stable link. Traffic splits across all of them and reroutes in milliseconds if any connection drops.
PAIR & SHARE: Bond cellular connections between multiple Speedify users on the same Wi-Fi. Great for road trips, field crews, and events.
FAST, SECURE VPN: Hardware-accelerated encryption protects every app on your device without slowing you down.
NO LOGS: Speedify never records the IP addresses you visit or the content of your traffic.
24/7 SUPPORT: Real humans, every day. Reach us at support@speedify.com.
FREE TO TRY, EASY TO UPGRADE
Speedify optimizes your first 2GB of internet activity across all available connections every month for free. Upgrade for unlimited usage on up to 5 devices for $14.99/month, or save 50% with the annual plan at $89.99/year. Speedify for Families plans include iCloud Family Sharing for you and five family members.
TERMS
- Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00088643:ios.name: Pregnancy Test Checker
bluejetty:00088643:ios.summary: Need a helping hand to see if your pregnancy test is positive or negative? Staring at pregnancy tests day after day to the point where you might even be seeing an imaginary second line? Get a little more assurance with the Pregnancy Test Ch
bluejetty:00088643:ios.description:
Need a helping hand to see if your pregnancy test is positive or negative? Staring at pregnancy tests day after day to the point where you might even be seeing an imaginary second line? Get a little more assurance with the Pregnancy Test Checker app!
Core Features:
- AI-Powered Checker: A tool that helps identify if there’s a visible test line or not, which may suggest a positive or negative result. Simply take or import a photo of your pregnancy test, press the Check button, and the result will be provided. This feature supports all major types of pregnancy tests, and we are continuously improving it for even better accuracy and broader test support.
- Community: Talk to other users like yourself, support one another, and share photos of your tests or other TTC-related photos. You can vote and comment on each other’s posts, providing and receiving support and help throughout your journey.
- Progression Tracking: Save and compare pregnancy tests over time to track changes in test line intensity. Group multiple tests together and use AI-powered analysis to help identify whether your test lines appear to be progressing, declining, or showing a mixed/unclear trend.
- My Journey: Your personal space to track moods, reflections, and pregnancy test results - all securely stored only on your device to protect your privacy. You can also share your entries with the community or discuss them with Eva for personalized insights.
- Eva, the AI Assistant: Eva can help answer any questions you may have about trying to conceive (TTC), pregnancy, fertility, or anything else.
- Tweaking Section: Take or import a photo of your pregnancy test and apply photo effects to make that (hopefully visible) second line easier to see. Current effects include brighten, contrast, grayscale, invert, exposure, gamma, hue, saturation, and sharpen.
We understand how stressful and overwhelming the journey to pregnancy can be, especially for those who have faced challenges and longed for a positive result after months or even years of trying. We sincerely hope this app serves as a supportive companion, providing guidance and encouragement on your path to a healthy and successful conception.
Should you run into any issues, we would sincerely appreciate it if you could send feedback to us first in the app instead of leaving a negative review. We will work to address your issue as quickly as possible. Thank you!

The results and information provided by the app’s AI-powered features are not definitive and should not be relied upon as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or another qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition.

bluejetty:00039661:ios.name: Сільпо: ваша вигода на покупки
bluejetty:00039661:ios.summary:
Завантажуйте мобільний застосунок, користуйтеся послугами доставки з «Сільпо» та LOKO. А ще оцініть інші зручності і вигоди!
ДОСТАВКА І САМОВИВІЗ З «СІЛЬПО»
Доставка продуктів, дитячих товарів та готової їжі, а також доставка з супермаркеті
bluejetty:00039661:ios.description:
Завантажуйте мобільний застосунок, користуйтеся послугами доставки з «Сільпо» та LOKO. А ще оцініть інші зручності і вигоди!
ДОСТАВКА І САМОВИВІЗ З «СІЛЬПО»
Доставка продуктів, дитячих товарів та готової їжі, а також доставка з супермаркетів «Сільпо». Звісно ж, є і доставка піци з Сільпо, а ще доставка квітів і букетів! Все в зручному онлайн-форматі – замовляйте доставку на потрібний день та час. А для тих, хто поспішає, є пришвидшена доставка до 59 хвилин! Треба більше? ВсеДоставка – це можливість замовити ще більше з найбільших дарксторів.
LOKO – ДОСТАВКА ЗА ХВИЛИНИ
Обирайте в додатку «Сільпо» доставку від нашого партнера LOKO. Замовляйте продукти, фрукти і свіжі овочі, товари для дому та гігієни, зоотовари, а ще страви з ресторанів поруч
ЕЛЕКТРОННА КАРТКА «ВЛАСНИЙ РАХУНОК»
Електронна картка «Власного Рахунку» завжди з вами. Скануйте QR на касі щоразу, коли робите покупки в «Сільпо», щоб отримати винагороду. А ще додайте банківську картку в застосунок та використовуйте QR для оплати покупок.
СКАРБНИЧКА
Активуйте скарбничку, щоб зберігати дрібну решту для нових покупок.
БАЛОБОНУСИ І СПЕЦІАЛЬНІ ПРОПОЗИЦІЇ
Вмикайте спеціальні пропозиції та скануйте QR-код на касі магазину або ж замовляйте в застосунку з доставкою чи самовивозом й отримуйте вигоду. Стежте за накопиченням балобонусів за кожну покупку в супермаркеті або онлайн. Ваші балобонуси оновлюються після кожної покупки, тому їх можна витрачати на наступний день
ВІЛЬНОКАСА
Купуйте ще швидше з «Вільнокасою»! Скануйте штрихкоди за допомогою вашого смартфона під час шопінгу у супермаркеті та додавайте товари в кошик. Оплачуйте покупку на Самокасі одним рухом
ІСТОРІЯ ПОКУПОК
Контролюйте ваші покупки та бюджет – усі ваші чеки й список замовлень із доставкою товарів та самовивозом зберігаються в додатку. Можна не друкувати чек, а отримати його в застосунку. Використовуйте функцію «Повторити замовлення»
ПЕРЕВІРКА ЦІНИ
Скануйте штрихкод товару та отримуйте актуальну інформацію про ціну та наявність у вибраному магазині. Сканер цін – це чудова можливість дізнатись ціни та контролювати витрати
АКЦІЇ ТА ЗНИЖКИ
Відстежуйте знижки й акції та заощаджуйте – ми оновлюємо акції «Сільпо» щотижня. Шукайте позначки «Цінотижики», «Цінодіджики», «Тільки онлайн», знижки на Чорну п'ятницю (а в Сільпо Black Friday – рожева) чи інші, щоби отримати інформацію про товари, на які діють вигідні ціни тижня та інші акції. Бавтесь в ігри від Сільпо, щоб отримати особливі спеціальні пропозиції за перемогу.
ГРА «КОЛЕСО ФОРТУНИ»
Крутіть Колесо щодня й отримуйте приємнощі від «Власного Рахунку». Ваш виграш з’являтиметься у розділі «Спеціальні пропозиції». Замовляйте онлайн або скануйте картку лояльності на касі й отримуйте ще більше вигоди від покупок в «Сільпо»
БЛАГОДІЙНІСТЬ
Обирайте благодійну кампанію й перераховуйте балобонуси на добро.
ВІДСТЕЖЕННЯ ДОСТАВКИ
Відстежуйте доставку свого замовлення на карті. Надсилайте чайові Смаковершникам та залишайте відгуки про доставку з супермаркету
ПІДПИСКА ПЛЮХС
«Плюхс» – це більше, ніж підписка на доставку продуктів, це додаткові бонуси та вигідні умови покупок
ДОСТАВКА НОВОЮ ПОШТОЮ
Якщо у вашому населеному пункті немає «Сільпо» або хочете надіслати продукти рідним – замовляйте онлайн, і Нова Пошта доставить у будь-який куточок України
РЕЦЕПТИ
Підготували для вас підбірку унікальних рецептів, а всі інгредієнти для приготування страви можна замовити одним кліком в нашому магазині
СІЛЬПОІНТИ
Отримуйте своє замовлення без черг в спеціально позначеній зоні, а ще отримуйте посилки від компаній-партнерів Maudau, Pampik, Meest, Makeup, E-ZOO та інших
ДОДАТКОВІ ПРОПОЗИЦІЇ
Обмінюйте бали від Fishka на балобонуси, використовуйте вигідні пропозиції при оплаті покупок картками банків-партнерів. Обмінюйте бонуси програми «Обіймашки» від Укрзалізниці та шукайте товари, на які діють знижки при оплаті карткою Mastercard
КЕШБЕК НА ПЕРШУ ПОКУПКУ
При замовленні доставки і при оплаті картками банків-партнерів (Монобанк, ПУМБ, Приватбанк) отримуйте кешбек 10% на першу покупку

Контролюйте ваші покупки та бюджет – усі ваші чеки й список замовлень із доставкою товарів та самовивозом зберігаються в додатку. Можна не друкувати чек, а отримати його в застосунку. Використовуйте функцію «Повторити замовлення»
ПЕРЕВІРКА ЦІНИ
Скануйте штрихкод товару та отримуйте актуальну інформацію про ціну та наявність у вибраному магазині. Сканер цін – це чудова можливість дізнатись ціни та контролювати витрати
АКЦІЇ ТА ЗНИЖКИ
Відстежуйте знижки й акції та заощаджуйте – ми оновлюємо акції «Сільпо» щотижня. Шукайте позначки «Цінотижики», «Цінодіджики», «Тільки онлайн», знижки на Чорну п'ятницю (а в Сільпо Black Friday – рожева) чи інші, щоби отримати інформацію про товари, на які діють вигідні ціни тижня та інші акції. Бавтесь в ігри від Сільпо, щоб отримати особливі спеціальні пропозиції за перемогу.
ГРА «КОЛЕСО ФОРТУНИ»
Крутіть Колесо щодня й отримуйте приємнощі від «Власного Рахунку». Ваш виграш з’являтиметься у розділі «Спеціальні пропозиції». Замовляйте онлайн або скануйте картку лояльності на касі й отримуйте ще більше вигоди від покупок в «Сільпо»
БЛАГОДІЙНІСТЬ
Обирайте благодійну кампанію й перераховуйте балобонуси на добро.
ВІДСТЕЖЕННЯ ДОСТАВКИ
Відстежуйте доставку свого замовлення на карті. Надсилайте чайові Смаковершникам та залишайте відгуки про доставку з супермаркету
ПІДПИСКА ПЛЮХС
«Плюхс» – це більше, ніж підписка на доставку продуктів, це додаткові бонуси та вигідні умови покупок
ДОСТАВКА НОВОЮ ПОШТОЮ
Якщо у вашому населеному пункті немає «Сільпо» або хочете надіслати продукти рідним – замовляйте онлайн, і Нова Пошта доставить у будь-який куточок України
РЕЦЕПТИ
Підготували для вас підбірку унікальних рецептів, а всі інгредієнти для приготування страви можна замовити одним кліком в нашому магазині
СІЛЬПОІНТИ
Отримуйте своє замовлення без черг в спеціально позначеній зоні, а ще отримуйте посилки від компаній-партнерів Maudau, Pampik, Meest, Makeup, E-ZOO та інших
ДОДАТКОВІ ПРОПОЗИЦІЇ
Обмінюйте бали від Fishka на балобонуси, використовуйте вигідні пропозиції при оплаті покупок картками банків-партнерів. Обмінюйте бонуси програми «Обіймашки» від Укрзалізниці та шукайте товари, на які діють знижки при оплаті карткою Mastercard
КЕШБЕК НА ПЕРШУ ПОКУПКУ
При замовленні доставки і при оплаті картками банків-партнерів (Монобанк, ПУМБ, Приватбанк) отримуйте кешбек 10% на першу покупку

bluejetty:00073526:ios.description:
Book like an insider with Vio.
Get hotel discounts, compare hotel prices, and find the best hotel rates with Vio’s transparent pricing.
The Vio.com hotel booking app compares prices across 100+ platforms to show you the best hotel deals and hotel discounts. We surface wholesale pricing and travel deals that most booking sites don't offer, giving you access to the full picture before you book.
Why choose Vio:
Compare cheap hotel prices from 100+ sites, including Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Agoda, Priceline, and more.
Get exclusive savings, with up to 45% off stays when you use the Vio app.
See transparent pricing upfront with no hidden fees or surprise charges at checkout.
Get real-time price insights that tell you the best time to book.
Freeze hotel deals for free while you decide – no pressure or fake urgency.
Search millions of hotels worldwide with filters by price, location, amenities, and hotel type.
Read verified reviews from 100+ trusted travel platforms in one place.
Navigate with map search to find hotels in specific areas.
Book confidently with 24/7 customer support available before, during, and after your stay.

And if you need time to think, you can freeze your deal at no cost.

Download the Vio app to start booking hotels with confidence. Compare prices, access insider rates, and save on your next hotel reservation.

bluejetty:00164217:ios.summary: Major upgrade! No hunting for features or filling out templates—just tell AI what’s on your mind. Share a travel idea, and AI will build an itinerary you can adjust anytime. Record expenses in a sentence, split bills with friends, analyze s
bluejetty:00164217:ios.description:
Major upgrade! No hunting for features or filling out templates—just tell AI what’s on your mind. Share a travel idea, and AI will build an itinerary you can adjust anytime. Record expenses in a sentence, split bills with friends, analyze spending, and manage budgets—all with AI. You can even turn your transactions and travel memories into a personalized AI journal. Enable the AI agent, and it will gradually learn your habits. With Best Tracker, just say the word!
It supports families, couples, friends, travel groups, and small businesses. Simply send voice, text, screenshots, or receipts, and AI recognizes and generates bills in batches, plus provides intelligent financial diagnosis.
【Free Multi-Ledger · Real-Time Sharing】
Create multiple ledgers and invite members to keep accounts together. Data syncs in real time for full transparency. Expense allocation and income distribution support equal split, percentage, shares, specified amounts, and itemized allocation, with auto-generated settlement plans.
【AI Auto Accounting】
Supports Shortcuts, screenshots, voice, text, and image recognition. AI auto-extracts amount, category, time, account, and notes, supports batch generation, and minimizes manual entry.
【AI Financial Analysis】
AI analyzes income, expenses, categories, budgets, and member data to reveal spending patterns, trends, risks, and discrepancies, delivering easy-to-understand insights.
【Multiple Ledger Modes】
Supports personal, shared, AA, and loan ledgers, plus templates for family, travel, business, and more.
【Team & Personal Reports】
View income/expenses by time, category, account, or member. Automatic reports clearly show each member's spending, reimbursements, and allocations for easy reconciliation.
【Calendar View】 · 【Recurring Accounting】 · 【Cloud Backup】
Browse daily records via calendar and backdate entries. Set fixed items like rent or subscriptions to auto-generate. All data is encrypted and cloud-stored — restore anytime by logging back in.
【Member Permissions】 · 【Multi-Person Budgeting】
Admins set view/edit permissions per role. Set budgets by ledger or category and track progress collaboratively in shared ledgers.
【Import & Export】 · 【Account Authorization】 · 【Reimbursement】
Import records from WeChat, Alipay, and more. Export as Excel, PDF, or images. Link bank/cash/wallet accounts or authorize specific members. Support full, partial, and batch reimbursement with clear tracking.
【Multi-Language & Multi-Currency】 · 【Privacy & Security】
Supports global currencies with system/custom rates. Offers password, fingerprint, and facial recognition for data protection.
【Reminders & Notifications】 · 【Dark Mode & Personalization】
Includes repayment, budget, and accounting reminders, plus member and bill change alerts. Dark mode auto-switches, and you can customize themes, cards, backgrounds, and shortcuts.
--Term Of Use（EULA）：https://www.bestrie.com/serviceInfo.html
--Privacy：https://www.bestrie.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00076065:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00076065:ios.description:
StudioMini is a music recording app for musicians who play.
It’s designed to help you capture musical ideas quickly, commit to real performances, and keep moving without getting lost in endless options or editing.
Whether you’re sketching a rough idea, layering parts with bandmates, or finishing a song, StudioMini keeps the focus on playing, not programming.
When inspiration strikes, you don’t need complexity.
You need something that lets you press record and stay in the moment.
WHAT STUDIOMINI IS
StudioMini is built around real performances. It’s for musicians who want to play through ideas, capture takes, and build songs by layering parts - not by assembling music from fragments on a timeline.
You won’t find endless setup steps, complicated routing, or editing tools that pull you out of the moment. StudioMini keeps decisions lightweight so you can stay focused on the music, not the software.
That doesn’t mean you can’t refine a performance. When you need to fix a section, you can punch in without losing the feel of the take. When you’re ready to move forward, you can create a mix and share your song, or take your tracks into any DAW for further production.
StudioMini isn’t trying to replace full desktop DAWs. It’s designed to be the place where musical ideas are captured, shaped, and kept alive - before inspiration fades or momentum is lost.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Capture ideas the moment they arrive
› Press record and play. Capture a rough idea with a single track, or start building right away. StudioMini makes it easy to get something down before the moment passes.
Build songs by layering
› Add parts one at a time by recording real takes. Guitar, vocals, bass, keys - layer performances naturally instead of assembling music from fragments.
Fix what needs fixing, keep the take
› Punch in to re-record just the section you need, without losing the feel of the performance. Refine enough to keep moving forward.
Create a mix, or collaborate
› Create a high-quality mix when a song is ready to listen and share. Or share the StudioMini project itself so bandmates can add their parts and pass it back.
TRUSTED BY MUSICIANS
StudioMini has been used on recordings by Grammy-winning artists and has earned the trust of musicians around the world for over a decade.
It has built a reputation for being dependable and focused - a tool musicians come back to when they want to capture performances and keep ideas moving.
StudioMini is developed by a small team of musicians and indie software developers in Los Angeles, California, with a deep respect for the art of making music.
FEATURES
› Multitrack recording for building songs from real performances
› High-resolution audio recording
› Punch-in recording for fixing sections without losing the take
› Drum track with a curated set of professionally produced loops
› Mixer with faders, mute, solo, and panning
› Create high-quality mixes for listening and sharing
› Share StudioMini projects for easy collaboration with bandmates
› Import and export audio and projects (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, and more)
› Per-project notepad for lyrics, notes, and ideas
› iCloud backup for seamless restore across devices
Terms of Use: https://otreus.com/en/legal/

bluejetty:00136470:ios.name: Barre Eclipse
bluejetty:00136470:ios.summary: Fall in love with body-affirming barre workouts that improve your physical and mental well-being. Barre Eclipse offers music-driven live and on-demand barre classes that blend the best of pilates, strength training, yoga, and elements of da
bluejetty:00136470:ios.description:
Fall in love with body-affirming barre workouts that improve your physical and mental well-being. Barre Eclipse offers music-driven live and on-demand barre classes that blend the best of pilates, strength training, yoga, and elements of dance.
Maintaining a consistent at-home workout routine has never been easier with fresh content added weekly, a new 30-day workout plan every month, and high-quality, top-notch productions.
Explore our extensive workout library with classes that range from 10 minutes to 60 minutes. You can filter workouts by target muscle group, duration, vibe, or equipment to find the perfect exercise. You can organize your favorite classes into custom playlists, add them to a personalized workout calendar, or download them for offline viewing.
BEGINNERS WELCOME: 
Kickstart your barre journey from home with our 30-Day Beginning Barre program. No special props or equipment are needed. Detailed instruction, alignment tutorials, and stunning high-definition demonstrations provide the guidance you need.
HUMAN-TO-HUMAN CONNECTION: 
Say goodbye to algorithms and voiceovers. Experience genuine human interaction with two-way live classes, a vibrant community forum, and boisterous comments from fellow students. It's like having your teacher beside you, grooving to the music, doing the work with you, and offering real-time cues. Every live class helps you feel seen and engaged so you can consistently show up for yourself and your workouts.
BODY-AFFIRMING BURN: 
Embrace the benefits of high-repetition, low-impact exercises with empowering language that uplifts your mental well-being. Barre Eclipse will never tell you to tone, tighten, sculpt, or shrink. Instead, we focus on enhancing your endurance, strength, balance, and flexibility. You'll feel more confident in your skin and motivated by pure good energy. Barre Eclipse is a refreshing refuge from diet and fitness culture.
FRESH CONTENT AND COMMUNITY: 
Enjoy new Barre Hour classes weekly, curated 30-day workout programs each month, and seasonal releases of our themed 7-day barre series. Join community challenges for accountability and discover innovative ways to stay committed to your fitness journey.
Now is your time to fall in love with your workouts! Unlock hundreds of classes for free today. We offer monthly, quarterly, or yearly auto-renewing subscriptions within the app.* It's super easy to cancel. Pricing may vary by region. In-app subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each term.
*You can manage your subscription in your Account Dashboard if you purchased your subscription on our web app. Apple manages all in-app payments made through your iTunes Account. All subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24 hours before the end of the current cycle and charge your account for renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment.
Privacy Policy: https://app.barreeclipse.com/pages/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://app.barreeclipse.com/pages/terms-of-use

Designed for puzzle
bluejetty:00149242:ios.description:
6 word games, one app. Daily crosswords (15x15), mini crosswords (5x5), Sudoku, anagram puzzles, word search, and more — all ad-free, new puzzles every day. Full archive access for $1/month — less than a cup of coffee.
Designed for puzzle lovers who want variety — everything from 15×15 American-style crosswords to timed word searches in one place. Our app is ad-free to provide you with the best gaming experience possible. New puzzles are available to play for free every day, and our puzzle archive contains 14,500+ unique puzzles
Global and local leaderboards allow you to compare your daily puzzle best times and high scores with your friends, family, and other players from around the globe. Don't hold back, go show off your word puzzle skills!
Perfect for fans of: New York Times Crossword, Daily Themed Crosswords, Daily Mini Crosswords, Spelling Bee, Word Cookies, Wordscapes, Brain Training Games, Daily Puzzles, Sudoku, Worldle, Connections, Word Search Pro, Brain Out
LARGE 15X15 AMERICAN STYLE CROSSWORDS AND MINI 5X5 CROSSWORD PUZZLES
Our standard & mini crossword puzzles are themed, fun, and relaxing. Most can be completed in just a few minutes. Challenge your mind with daily puzzles and set new win streaks and race your fastest times.
American-style 15x15 crosswords and mini 5x5 crossword puzzles are easy and enjoyable for crossword enthusiasts everywhere. Offline puzzles enable you to play whenever and wherever you want so you can sharpen your mind, improve your vocabulary, learn new words, and have fun anywhere.
Play the daily crossword free each day, or continue the puzzle fun with unlimited access our crossword bank. Daily puzzles are always free with no ads. And all puzzles are immediately available for hours of endless puzzle solving for just $1/month. Crosswords have been hand-edited and vetted by real crossword lovers to ensure enjoyable game play.
Categorized puzzle packs let you play crosswords relating to your favorite topics including sports, world history, geography, animals, trivia, Lord of the Rings, famous people, religion, sounds, Disney, Marvel, and thousands of other random puzzles.
Features:
Large 15x15 standard American style crossword puzzles
Traditional 5x5 mini crossword puzzles
New puzzles every day
Global and local leaderboards
Achievements
Timer to track how long each crossword puzzle takes
Records your fastest time so you can try to beat your personal record
Optional auto-check to mark correct letters
Timer is paused when you leave the app
Pencil-in letters for words you aren't 100% sure of
Track and view your stats for free including how many puzzles you've completed, fastest completion time, and daily win streaks
Reveal a letter you're stuck on
Reveal a word that has you stuck
Offline puzzles allow you to play anytime, anywhere
No ads
GRAM SLAM PUZZLES
Our gram slam puzzles are fun and classic anagram puzzles. Try to find as many words as you can given 7 random letters. Every puzzle is guaranteed to have at least one "pangram", which is a word that uses all 7 letters at least once. Find 25% of all possible words to solve the puzzle, or keep playing as long as you want and try to reach the "perfect" level by finding every word. Puzzles vary in difficulty, but all are solvable by people of all ages and backgrounds.
WORD LAPSE
Word Lapse is a new spin on an old game. You have 90 seconds to find as many hidden words in the word search as you can. Compete with friends to see who can get the highest score.
SUDOKU
Play this classic logic puzzle by fitting the numbers 1-9 in each row, column, and square.
MIND READER

Our standard & mini crossword puzzles are themed, fun, and relaxing. Most can be completed in just a few minutes. Challenge your mind with daily puzzles and set new win streaks and race your fastest times.

American-style 15x15 crosswords and mini 5x5 crossword puzzles are easy and enjoyable for crossword enthusiasts everywhere. Offline puzzles enable you to play whenever and wherever you want so you can sharpen your mind, improve your vocabulary, learn new words, and have fun anywhere.

bluejetty:00040718:ios.description:
Help its inhabitants with their daily activities and discover their tragic fate during the volcanic eruption.
A true adventure game: travel back in time and solve the mysteries of the city with Flavia or Flavius, and experience history in a unique and fun way!
Features:
· Accurately recreated city
· Choice of character and accessories
· Open world filled with surprises
· More than 60 characters with their own stories and quests
· Varied missions in the city’s famous landmarks
· Rewards in sesterces – the currency of the time
· Save the inhabitants and escape Mount Vesuvius
· Discover the life of the Romans
· Unique comic book style based on archeological archives
Recommended Age: from 9 years old to fully enjoy the game's educational benefits.
Play for free, offline, with no ads or in-app purchases, for the best experience!
Why Pompeii?
Although the eruption of Mount Vesuvius destroyed the city in 79 AD and claimed
many lives, it also preserved a part of Roman history for future generations. Discover
this ancient city like never before.
Created by the Institut Le Rosey:
A collaborative project developed under the direction of a Pompeii expert, with the
participation of students — who composed the original music and contributed to
game design, graphic design, and testing — and produced by DNA Studios.
The sole purpose of the game is to promote history in a fun and engaging way. Le
Rosey is proud to have created this game to make it available to all curious minds,
young and old, who wish to discover Pompeii while learning and having fun.
There is an educational version of the game for a better use in the classroom (see support).
All rights reserved.
Copyright © 2024 Fondation Le Rosey

bluejetty:00158103:ios.description:
SAVE TIME WITH YOUR DIGITAL CLEANING SCHEDULE
Organize your home and save your household time.
REDUCE MENTAL LOAD
Plan all your cleaning and home organization tasks so you don't have to think about them anymore.
FEEL GOOD AGAIN
Together we will create a neat and tidy home for you to finally feel comfy in.
SHARE TASKS FAIRLY
Assign tasks to each family member fairly so that everyone gets to contribute.
What BeTidy can do for you:
CLEANING
Plan your cleaning and household tasks and BeTidy will automatically create an annual plan for you. Frequency intervals help you easily manage recurring tasks.
ORGANIZING
With the help of home organization projects, we guide you step-by-step to the perfect result. Want to organize your wardrobe? No problem, start now and create an organization project. Add before and after images to your projects and let the results motivate you next time around.
DAILY CLEANING SCHEDULE
Your daily plan is created based on your planned cleaning and home organization tasks. You can also view overdue or future tasks at any time. Simply check your completed tasks. And if you want, we can send you daily notifications to remind you of upcoming tasks.
SHARED FAMILY PROFILES
Create custom profiles for your family members. Tasks can be assigned to one or more members. This way you can distribute tasks fairly, because chores and home organization affect all family members.
FIND YOUR MOTIVATION
The ranking shows you who has completed the most tasks. Depending on the effort, tasks award points that are collected once they are checked off. You can challenge your partner or introduce younger family members to tidy housekeeping in a playful way. This increases motivation and at the same time everyone pulls together.
BeTidy Pro can be activated via in-app purchase with a monthly ($3.99 per month), half-yearly ($20.95 per six-month) or yearly ($35.90 per year) subscription.
There is also the option of purchasing organization packages from the professional organizers with a one-time purchase.
Subscriptions and one-time purchases are charged to your credit card through your Apple account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription in your account settings after purchase.
BeTidy data privacy protection: https://betidy.io/en/data-privacy-app/
Apple terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00064306:ios.description:
**TélécBox - Votre télécommande universelle pour Box**
Transformez votre iPhone ou iPad en une télécommande universelle avec TélécBox. Profitez d'un contrôle total de votre Box sans aucune configuration.
- Fonctionnalités complètes : Toutes les options de votre télécommande physique sont disponibles.
- Détection automatique : Votre Box est reconnue instantanément sans aucun paramétrage requis.
Comment ça marche :
1. Connectez votre iPhone/iPad au même réseau Wi-Fi que votre Box.
2. Lancez l'application TélécBox, votre Box sera détectée automatiquement.
3. Contrôlez votre TV directement depuis votre appareil.
**Support :**
Pour toute question ou assistance, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter à l'adresse suivante : contact@nstx.io
Simplifiez votre expérience de divertissement avec TélécBox, la solution intuitive et efficace pour le contrôle de votre Box.
SUBSCRIPTION:
We offer auto-renewing subscription:
- Length: Monthly / Yearly
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to access the Premium features of the app for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your Apple account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039 for more information on how to proceed.
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your Apple Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy : https://nstx.io/TelecBox/telecBox_policy.html
Terms of Use : https://nstx.io/TelecBox/telecBox_terms.html

bluejetty:00026110:ios.description:
Welcome to Fairy Color, a magical coloring game where you'll journey through enchanting realms. Immerse yoursFairy in the world of Fantasy Elves, graceful Fairies, powerful Witches, and adorable Dwarves. Unleash your creativity as you bring to life Warcraft creatures, Cartoon Animals, Mushroom Houses, and more! Each finely-drawn scene offers a realistic and immersive experience, making your artistic journey feel like a genuine encounter with the fantastical. Relax, meditate, and embark on an enchanting adventure like no other! 
Our picture categories
Fantasy:
Enter a realm of magic! Immerse in mythical creatures and enchanting landscapes. Experience realism in fantastical scenes.
Fairy:
Graceful Elves & Fairies await! Unleash imagination with intricate designs. Create captivating Fairy-themed art.
Animal:
Colorful Cartoon Animals! Express wild creativity. Find tranquility in coloring majestic to adorable creatures.
House:
Whimsical homes & Mushroom Houses! Add vibrant colors, ignite creativity. Enjoy the calming art of coloring.
Place:
Explore Enchanted Places! Mesmerizing landscapes. Relax, share your art with fellow adventurers.
Start coloring today and unleash the artist within you, letting creativity flow in this coloring gameEmbrace the joy of expression and let your imagination soar!
--------------------
Subscription pricing and terms：
In Fairy Color we offer you the following three subscription options:
1. A weekly subscription costs $4.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per week.
2. A monthly subscription costs $9.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per month.
3. An annual subscription costs $69.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per year after a 3-day free trial period.
After buying the subscriptions, you will remove the non-optional banner and interstitial adverts from the game.
In addition, you'll get unlimited hints, and remove watermarks from all completed pictures.
We are working hard to bring you happy coloring experience. Just enjoy coloring by number.
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy please go to the following link:
Terms of Use:
https://day.colorstudio.top/termsofservice.html
Privacy Policy:
https://day.colorstudio.top/privacy.html

bluejetty:00121260:ios.summary:
Avec la nouvelle application Europe 1, entièrement repensée pour une expérience fluide, rapide et intuitive, plongez au cœur de l’actualité.
Dès l’ouverture, accédez à l’écoute en direct de la radio et retrouvez les figures emblématiques d
bluejetty:00121260:ios.description:
Avec la nouvelle application Europe 1, entièrement repensée pour une expérience fluide, rapide et intuitive, plongez au cœur de l’actualité.
Dès l’ouverture, accédez à l’écoute en direct de la radio et retrouvez les figures emblématiques d’Europe 1. 
Les podcasts d’Europe 1 sont également à l’honneur. En un clic, réécoutez toutes vos émissions, plongez dans des récits passionnants ou découvrez de nouveaux programmes exclusifs. 
SUIVEZ L’ACTUALITÉ EN TEMPS RÉEL ET L'INFO EN DIRECT
Découvrez toutes les infos de la rédaction, tous les journaux et reportages des journalistes d'Europe 1. 
• Info politique, société, économie, international, culture, sport, santé, faits-divers.... Consultez l’actualité en direct 24/7
• Activez les notifications pour recevoir les dernières actus en temps réel
ÉCOUTEZ LA RADIO EN DIRECT
• Écoutez Europe 1 ou regardez le direct vidéo
• Continuez à naviguer dans l'application tout en écoutant la radio. 
• Mettez en pause le direct, reprenez l’écoute plus tard ou depuis le début de l’émission
RETROUVEZ FACILEMENT VOS PODCASTS EUROPE 1
Ajoutez vos émissions et podcasts en favoris pour les retrouver en un clin d’œil et accéder plus vite aux derniers épisodes.
Info, politique, culture, humour, économie, récits, musique… Explorez la richesse des thématiques des podcasts Europe 1.
• Europe 1 Matin, Culture Média, Hondelatte Raconte, Pascal Praud et vous, Au Cœur de l’Histoire, On marche sur la tête… Sur la page dédiée à chaque émission, retrouvez la liste de tous les épisodes en replay et ne manquez aucune diffusion de vos émissions préférées.
• Europe 1 c’est aussi des webradios : Europe 1 Musique !, Europe 1 jazz, Europe 1 musique classique, Radio Hondelatte… en haute qualité audio
PERSONNALISEZ VOTRE NAVIGATION SUR L’APP EUROPE 1
Audio, Vidéo, Article, accédez aux dernières informations, émissions, podcasts en un clic 
• Une expérience, navigation fluidifiée : adapter, affiner votre recherche de contenus. 
• Player étendu en plein écran
• Enchainement automatique des épisodes
• Minuteur de mise en veille disponible pour le direct, les émissions et les podcasts
EUROPE 1 À VOTRE ÉCOUTE
Vous souhaitez intervenir à l'antenne, poser une question, faire un commentaire, obtenir un renseignement sur une information diffusée sur l'antenne d'Europe 1, nous signaler un problème technique ou autre : contactez-nous 
- Par téléphone au 01 80 20 39 21, du lundi au vendredi de 9h à 1h et le samedi et le dimanche de 22h à 1h.
- Par formulaire de contact : https://www.europe1.fr/contact
EUROPE 1, LA RADIO LIBRE
Conditions générales d’utilisation : https://www.europe1.fr/cgu
Charte de données personnelles : https://www.europe1.fr/charte-donnees-personnelles-et-cookies
Mentions légales : https://www.europe1.fr/mentions-legales

bluejetty:00146327:ios.description:
Transform your holiday into an unforgettable journey with the VroomVroomVroom App — the ultimate solution for taking the pain out of finding the right hire car for you — at a competitive price.
VroomVroomVroom has been at the forefront of providing easy-to-use car hire search since 2001 and we’ve earned the trust of millions along the way. Our secret? Working with only the most respected car hire providers, ensuring that every booking is the epitome of both efficiency and convenience, and having the best customer support team in the business.
Download the VroomVroomVroom App today - it’s absolutely free, with no hidden fees nor in-app charges. Designed to simplify your life, our app is compatible with both the iPad and iPhone, and lets you experience the ease of finding, comparing, and securing the perfect hire car for you in as little as two minutes. Booking a rental car couldn’t be easier.
Why should you choose the VroomVroomVroom App?
Advanced geolocation search:
Our state-of-the-art booking engine uses your location (or any specified address) to pinpoint the nearest car rental depots. You can access maps, estimated travel times, petrol stations near depots, and much more. This means less time searching, more time exploring. (This feature requires access to your device GPS).
Effortless user experience:
From auto-completing searches to quick sorting and comprehensive filters (think car type, preferred provider, price range, seating capacity, and even transmission type), our app is designed to prioritise what matters to you.
Innovative features:
To ensure a personalised and hassle-free booking experience, our app also boasts integrations with Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight Search, and a dedicated widget for monitoring prices.
Utes, trucks and vans:
If you’re looking for a rental ute, truck or van in Australia, the VroomVroomVroom App offers seamless searching and booking for commercial vehicles as well. (For rentals in Australia only.)
World-class support:
You can manage and view your bookings directly within the app, and should you need assistance, you can contact our customer service team through the app. We don’t mean to toot our own horn, but our customer support team is world class — rest assured you’re in the best hands in the business with VroomVroomVroom.
With the VroomVroomVroom App you’re not just booking a rental car, you’re embarking on a journey of ease and excellence, and it all starts with a tap on your screen. Download the App and steer your holiday towards perfection today!

bluejetty:00180058:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00180058:ios.description:
Timely alerts to always fly your American flag the right way!
With the Flag Day app, you will receive:
- Alerts for unscheduled half-staff days as soon as published by the US President
- Alerts for scheduled half & full staff days a day before
Note: The app does not cover US States notifications for half-staff days at this point. Only notifications coming from the White House.
See below the other app's features
WHAT USERS SAY ABOUT THE FLAG DAY APP:
-------------------------------------
"GREAT APP"
"If you fly the flag, this app is a god send! When the status changes, you get an alert to change the position. That way you do not wonder why the flag is at half-staff!"
"SIMPLE AND RELIABLE"
"It does more than you'd expect. I've learned a lot about why we observe the days we do."
"GREAT APP"
"I love this app! I have learned so much about the symbol of patriotism of the United States flag and I use it to display my flag properly. It is a great app and I highly recommend it."
APP OVERVIEW:
-----------------
Receive alerts to remind you to raise the flag for all American National Flag Days. Alerts are sent the day before the half-staff or full-staff day.
Use the flag day calendar to quickly glance over all the coming flag days. 
App displays the sunrise and sunset times at your location.
The application is constantly maintained up to date. New flag days declared by the US President are added to our server and synchronized with the application when you start it.
Flying the American flag per the flag code is important and a patriotic thing to do. To help you fly the US flag the proper way, the application references the flag code as well as a detailed step by step process on how to correctly fold the flag.
The Flag Day application was built by our company Bonsaisoft which is based in California, USA.
APP FEATURES:
----------------
- Notifications are sent a day before half-staff & full-staff days.
- Calendar with all coming flag days. Full staff days are in blue. Half staff days are in red.
- Each day has historical facts and videos to learn about the day in history. Once published, the Presidential Proclamation is added to the app. 
- Instructions on how to properly handle the flag based on the flag code 
- Instructions on how to fold the flag with step by step graphics and visual animation.
- Instructions on how to salute the flag
- Pledge of allegiance's text
PRICING
---------
The Flag Day app can be downloaded for free on the app store. To unlock it, a yearly or monthly subscription is required. 
- The yearly membership subscription is US$7.99/year after a 1 week free trial period.
- The monthly membership subscription is US$1.99/month after a 3 day free trial period.
LEGAL
---------
The price of the subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Our full terms and conditions and privacy policy are at:
Terms of Use: https://www.bonsaisoft.com/flag-day-terms 
Privacy Policy: https://www.bonsaisoft.com/flag-day-privacy

bluejetty:00017146:ios.summary: The SlowMotion is a powerful application that allows you to create stunning slow motion videos effortlessly. Whether you want to capture a memorable moment in slow motion or enhance the visual appeal of your footage, this app has got you co
bluejetty:00017146:ios.description:
The SlowMotion is a powerful application that allows you to create stunning slow motion videos effortlessly. Whether you want to capture a memorable moment in slow motion or enhance the visual appeal of your footage, this app has got you covered.
With its intuitive interface, you can easily import your videos and choose the exact moments you want to slow down. Simply move the points up or down to adjust the speed and create the desired slow motion effect. You also have the option to apply different speeds to different parts of the video, giving you complete creative control.
Take your slow motion to the next level with AI Smooth Motion. Powered by advanced frame interpolation, AI Smooth Motion analyzes your edited video and generates natural in-between frames so motion stays fluid even in heavy slow-down sections. The result is ultra-smooth playback with a minimum frame rate of 60 fps—ideal for dramatic sports clips, action shots, and cinematic moments that would otherwise look choppy. Apply it after you set your speed curve, preview the result, and keep editing with filters, music, and text on top of your smoothed footage.
In addition to its speed adjustment features, the Slow Motion Video Editor offers editing tools to enhance your videos further. You can add filters, add background music, and add text to personalize your creations.
Once you are satisfied with your slow motion masterpiece, you can save it in various formats and resolutions, making it compatible with different devices and platforms. You can also directly share your videos on social media platforms, allowing you to showcase your creativity and impress your friends and followers.
Whether you are a professional videographer or someone who enjoys capturing and editing videos for fun, the Slow Motion Video Editor is a must-have app for creating captivating slow motion videos. Its user-friendly interface, versatile editing features, AI-powered smooth motion, and seamless sharing options make it the perfect tool to bring your videos to life in slow motion.
Features:
+ Choose a video from Photo Library, Files or record a new video with the camera.
+ Trim/cut the selected video.
+ Adjust slow and fast motion speed with 2 modes: basic and advance.
+ AI Smooth Motion: AI frame interpolation for buttery-smooth slow motion
+ Add background music to the video
+ Apply video filter to make your video more lively and stylish
+ Add text to video
+ Adjust between video volume and music volume
+ Save your projects to edit them later.
Premium Subscription:
• Length of subscriptions: one week, one month & one year

You can also directly share your videos on social media platforms, allowing you to showcase your creativity and impress your friends and followers.

bluejetty:00047676:ios.name: InPost Mobile
bluejetty:00047676:ios.summary: The InPost Mobile app is a convenient way to receive, send and return parcels via a Parcel Locker®. In addition, the app allows you to track your shipments and make online purchases from various online shops with InPost Pay. Simple as ever!
bluejetty:00047676:ios.description:
The InPost Mobile app is a convenient way to receive, send and return parcels via a Parcel Locker®. In addition, the app allows you to track your shipments and make online purchases from various online shops with InPost Pay. Simple as ever!
Shop the shortcut way with InPost Pay.
Select the InPost Pay button in a participating online store and complete your purchase in the InPost app — no logging in, no forms, no email overload. You only register with InPost Pay once—and shop securely with a single click. From payment to delivery—fast and convenient. All your order details, including statuses and delivery notifications, are in one app. Discover a new dimension of online shopping!
Sending without a label
You can send your parcel conveniently with InPost Mobile – without printing a shipping label, 24/7, via any Parcel Locker®. All you have to do is open the locker remotely with one click, scan the QR code, or enter the shipping code on the screen of the Parcel Locker®!
Opening the locker remotely
One of the main features of the app is remote locker opening – no need to touch the Paczkomat® screen. Just tap “Open locker remotely” and it will open on its own!
Extending the collection deadline
App users can easily extend the pickup time for their Paczkomat® parcel by 24 hours. Twelve hours before the deadline, a “Extend” button will appear in the app – just tap it, pay, and you’re all set!
Returning packages quickly and conveniently
Tired of online shopping returns? Not with us. Every InPost Mobile user can conveniently return a parcel to partner stores! You do not need to print a shipping label, just fill in the return details and send the parcel from any Parcel Locker®.
Redirecting courier parcels without any problem
Not home for your InPost courier? Click “Redirect” in the app and choose a new delivery option: Parcel Locker®, PUDO point, or a neighbour’s address.
Placing a parcel in the Ease of Access Zone
The Ease of Access Zone is a solution that allows parcels to be delivered to lower lockers in the Parcel Locker®. This functionality is meant for people with disabilities and those short of stature. If you want the parcel to be placed in the Zone, select the "Activate" button in the details of the parcel.
Picking up shipments using the Multi-locker functionality
Multi-locker is an option that allows you to receive multiple parcels from a single locker in a Parcel Locker®. Packages that have been included in the Multi-locker are collected in the app in one message and highlighted in blue.
Parcel Lockers® are always close to you
You can easily find any Parcel Locker® or PUDO point in the app. All you need to do is click on the map and, if you have location services enabled, the application will show you the nearest InPost delivery points.
Always know where your package is
Using the app, you can keep track of all the shipments you are waiting for. Notifications will keep you up to date with changes in shipment status. Your shipments ordered in the last 30 days, will be visible in the app after logging in.
Paying cashless for cash on delivery shipments
You can pay for COD shipments with PayByLink transfers - a simple and convenient solution that gives you freedom and full control over your order.
You create the application TOGETHER with us!
We regularly update the product, responding to user suggestions. The InPost Mobile app is supposed to be first and foremost for you, so we always listen to what you have to say.

bluejetty:00169818:ios.summary: Panzer War is an action-packed tank warfare game that puts you in control of a vast array of historically accurate armored vehicles from World War I to the Cold War era. With over 200 tanks, self-propelled guns, and armored vehicles at your
bluejetty:00169818:ios.description:
Panzer War is an action-packed tank warfare game that puts you in control of a vast array of historically accurate armored vehicles from World War I to the Cold War era. With over 200 tanks, self-propelled guns, and armored vehicles at your command, experience the intensity of armored combat across a variety of battlefields and game modes.
Damage System
We feature a modular damage system that simulates shrapnel damage to vehicle components and crew members, affecting your tank's performance. For players seeking a more straightforward experience, we also offer an HP mode, where the damage mechanics are simplified, making the game more accessible.
Diverse Game Modes
Offline Game Modes
Skirmish: Engage in fast-paced battles where you can pit your tanks against AI in an open-ended combat environment.
N vs N Blitzkrieg: Experience the thrill of large-scale team battles where coordination and strategy are key to victory.
Capture Zone: Control strategic points on the map to gain the upper hand in battle.
Historical Mode: Relive iconic tank battles with historically accurate scenarios.
Online Multiplayer:
Skirmish: Test your skills against other players in competitive, fast-paced battles.
Capture Zone: Work with your team to secure control points in intense multiplayer matches.
Party Mode: Enjoy fun and chaotic matches with friends in a variety of custom game modes.
Instant Vehicle Access
There’s no need to grind through tech trees or farm in-game currency. All vehicles are available for immediate use, allowing you to jump straight into battle with any tank, self-propelled gun, or armored vehicle you desire. This freedom ensures that you can focus on enjoying the intense combat experience without any unnecessary progression barriers.
Mod Support
We offers robust mod support through its in-game installer, allowing players to easily browse, download, and install community-created content. Whether you're looking for new vehicles, or maps, the in-game mod installer makes it simple to expand and customize your Panzer War experience.

bluejetty:00032574:ios.description:
"Paradise" - Your Dream 3D Farm Awaits!
Welcome to "Paradise", with amazing graphics, real day-night cycles, and changing weather, "Paradise" gives you a farming adventure full of fun and surprises.
At dawn, the first rays of sunlight shine on the fields, making crops gently sway in the breeze and dew sparkle on the leaves. Step into the orchard, where trees are laden with enticing fruit, and feel the joy of harvesting each ripe piece by hand.
As time passes, the weather changes dynamically. When it rains, watch raindrops fall on the soil, nourishing the crops, and see a beautiful rainbow after the rain. At night, the farm is bathed in soft moonlight and twinkling stars, with fireflies dancing in the air, creating a romantic and serene atmosphere.
You can also take care of various adorable animals. Cows graze leisurely on the grass, while hens cluck and lay eggs in the coop. Each animal has its own personality and needs, and by interacting with them, you'll learn their preferences and provide better care.
You'll meet many native residents of the farm. Engage with them, fulfill their expectations and wishes, and they will become your most reliable partners in caring for the farm. Whether planting crops or tending to animals, smart NPC helpers will always share the workload, ensuring your farm thrives.
In this beautiful and diverse world, you'll experience endless fun and surprises. Come to "Paradise" and start living your dream life now!
## Key Features:
3D Graphics: Explore a colorful 3D world where your farm feels alive.
Natural Changes: Experience real day-night cycles and weather that affect your farm’s activities and growth.
Smart NPC Helpers: Whether you're online or offline, intelligent NPCs keep your farm running smoothly, taking care of crops, animals, and more.
Crop Growing: Plant and harvest many different crops. From corn to strawberries, your farm will always be in bloom.
Animal Care: Raise and take care of cute animals, like cows and chickens, each giving special benefits to your farm.
Build and Decorate: Customize your farm with decorations, buildings, and landmarks. Make it truly yours!
Trade and Community: Connect with friends, trade goods, complete orders, and help each other grow the best farms in the neighborhood.
Ready to build your dream farm?
Download "Paradise" today and start your farming adventure. The lush fields and friendly NPCs are waiting for you! Enjoy the happiness of farming in a game where a new day always begins. Welcome to "Paradise"!
## Contact Us:
We can't wait to hear from you! If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us at: Paradise@boooea.com
## Follow Us:
Discord: https://discord.gg/yKEpYW3Xhw
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ParadiseDreamWorld
What are you waiting for? Start your journey now!

bluejetty:00027197:ios.description:
SLIM DOWN IN 4 WEEKS. 
The first running app on the App Store designed specially for weight loss.
Make your running serve your goals!
COMPLEX APPROACH
The key to effective weight loss lies in the right combination of workouts and nutrition. With our app you’ll get a plan of running workouts and meal plans to achieve your weight loss goals.
TRAINING PLANS
Burn maximum of calories with interval plans, made of running, walking and sprint intervals.
- Get a plan up to your goals and your fitness level.
- Have workouts only 3 times per week and get fit fast.
- Choose from the variety of plans to lose weight, maintain results, keep fit and active.
- Free run feature allows to run and keep tracking your results without sticking to any training plan.
NUTRITION 
Follow a healthy, nutritionally-balanced meal plan and lose weight faster.
- Yummy recipes with step-by-step instructions.
- Learn how to make healthy and tasty choices for breakfast, lunch, dinner and between them.
- Use the water tracker to stay hydrated.
CONVENIENT EXPERIENCE
All you need is to do your best during a workout, the app will do the rest.
- Choose your personal trainer, from sweet and encouraging to tough and military-style.
- Enjoy detailed audio instructions for every training.
- Get voice encouragements and stats updates during your runs.
- Adjust the amount of audio feedback.
- Keep record of every workout and track your overall progress.

Learning German has never been so easy.
It is perfect for you whether you have a beginner, basic, intermediate or advanced level of German. With our online German course you will notice your German improving very quickly. Millions of students have already tried our courses. Would you like to join them?
Our online German courses:
German Course
In this course you will learn German from the ground up. Whatever your starting level, the course is designed to help you learn German from day one.
German Pronunciation Course
In this course you will learn to recognize German sounds. This course has 23 lessons and many exercises to practice and improve your pronunciation.
German Verb Conjugation Course
In this course you will practice the conjugation of German verbs in all their tenses. This is extra practice recommended for people who are already doing the German Course. It includes regular and irregular verbs.
Our learning method:
An easy, guided learning process designed for you: you will feel that you are learning more German every day. Every sentence, exercise, review and reading has been carefully selected for you.
Audio clips in German: A wide variety of accents with clear, crisp pronunciation, recorded by professional narrators.
Linked concepts: Each word is linked to its use or precise meaning. Tap a word in any sentence, exercise or reading to see its meaning or an explanation of its use.
Lesson structure: Concepts are introduced progressively throughout the course. Only concepts that have already been explained are used to create the content (sentences, exercises and readings).
Vocabulary: Learn the meaning, pronunciation and use of words with activities adapted to your progress.
Grammar exercises: Practice your grammar with exercises linked to explanations.
Vocabulary topics: Words are grouped into topic categories.
Spaced reviews: Review vocabulary and grammar at increasingly long intervals.
Search: Find whatever you are looking for, including vocabulary and grammar.
Readings: Learn and practice with conversations, news, emails and interviews, among others.
Diplomas: Earn a diploma that proves your knowledge at the end of each level.
Account types:
- Basic: With a Basic account the course is free, with some limitations.
- Premium: With a Premium account you have access to all course content and activities.
At Wlingua we work hard every day to offer you a quality German app that helps you at work, with your next exam, on holiday or when talking to people from around the world.
Download our app to learn German!

bluejetty:00028075:ios.description:
Howdy quizters! World History Quiz – Trivia Questions and Answers is a general history quiz with fun history trivia questions and some truly fun history facts. You sure don't know all the answers. Or do you? 
Test your knowledge with World History Quiz – Trivia Questions and Answers, and challenge your friends and family to a world history quiz contest! 
Playing a world history trivia quiz might get boring, but not with World History Quiz – Trivia Questions and Answers! With 150 general history questions and answers, you will read 150 super fun history facts you have never heard before. 
Do you know the answer to all the American history quiz questions? 
How about World War 2 quiz questions? 
You'll have to know the answers to history trivia questions from the period of ancient Egypt and the pyramids to Hiroshima, Nagasaki, Chornobyl, and the Cold War in order to get the certificate of a true historian.
Accept the challenge, take this general history test called World History Quiz – Trivia Questions and Answers, and find out how much you know about US history, World War 1 history, World War 2 history, and many other aspects of the world's past. Have fun! 
WORLD HISTORY QUIZ FEATURES
- WORLD HISTORY QUIZ IN 16 DIFFERENT LANGUAGES: Arabic, Bulgarian, Chinese, Croatian, English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Turkish, Thai, and Korean
- HINTS - if you get stuck on a certain question, a hint can be of help, or you can
- SKIP QUESTION, lose one life, and move to the next trivia question
- HEARTS are your lives; each incorrect answer is one heart less
- ASK A FRIEND for help if you run out of all hints
- CERTIFICATE - you get it once you answer all trivia quiz questions
Fun, quick quizzes in general are a nice way to have a good time and learn something new. With so many trivia questions and answers + fun facts for each one of them, this World History Quiz is a must-have among the apps. With the possibility to answer quick quiz questions in all the languages you know, this general history is more interesting than ever! So get the World History Quiz game and enjoy learning new stuff through quick trivia questions and answers!

bluejetty:00149378:ios.description:

• PowerPoint decks for meetings and presentations
• Message Agent X while it works to add details or change direction mid task

All the power of Motocross in your hands, warm up your engines and get ready for the most realistic, exciting two-wheeled experience ever.

bluejetty:00014334:ios.summary:
Easily manage your accounts on the go with Mobile Banking*. Track spending, pay bills, deposit checks, transfer funds, send money, and find nearby ATMs or branches.
Early Direct Deposit
 - Access your direct deposit funds sooner with Ear
bluejetty:00014334:ios.description:
Easily manage your accounts on the go with Mobile Banking*. Track spending, pay bills, deposit checks, transfer funds, send money, and find nearby ATMs or branches.
Early Direct Deposit
 - Access your direct deposit funds sooner with Early Direct Deposit for eligible checking accounts**.
Save
 - Turn on Round-Up to automatically save by rounding up your debit card purchases, with daily transfers of the difference to your savings account.
 - Use Money Manager, a free tool available within Mobile Banking that provides personalized insights to help you save, budget, and track expenses.
Send
 - Send and receive money with Zelle®, a fast and easy way to pay friends, family, and people you trust.
 - Transfer money to and from your accounts at other banks.
 - Pay bills by scheduling payments, setting up recurring payments, and managing payees.
Manage
 - View account activity, statements, and tax documents; transfer money, make loan payments, and more.
 - Deposit checks by taking a photo with your smartphone using Mobile Check Deposit.
 - Request a replacement card, verify your details, and place your order—all within Mobile Banking.
Customize Your Experience
 - Add nicknames and customize the order of your accounts.
 - Add a profile picture to help confirm you’re signing into the correct account.
 - Use Quick Balance by swiping down on the Jefferson Bank logo on the app login screen to view account balances and recent activity.
 - Use your smartwatch to check balances, view recent transactions, and lock your card.
Security
 - Enable biometrics to log in using fingerprint authentication or face unlock (Pixel devices).
 - Use multi-factor authentication for an added layer of security when logging in from new or unknown devices.
 - Receive push, text, or email alerts for balances, transactions, cards, and payments.
For an optimal experience, our app works best on devices with IOS 14 and up. If you are using an older version, you may not receive all new features. If you are having issues, navigate to our mobile-friendly website through your device browser.
Member FDIC. *Mobile Banking is free, but data and text rates from your mobile carrier may apply. Terms and conditions apply. Zelle® is intended for sending money to family, friends, and people you know. We recommend that you do not use Zelle® to send money to anyone you do not know. Zelle® and the Zelle® related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC, and are used herein under license.
**Early availability is not guaranteed and may vary between deposits and may depend on instructions sent by the payer or any limitations we set. Not all direct deposits qualify. Available for eligible accounts: MaxMoney, MyChoice, World, World Elite, and Preferred Interest. Enrollment is required. See our Early Direct Deposit Agreement for more details.

bluejetty:00044474:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00044474:ios.description:
The multiple sclerosis community, from diagnosis. Connect, get answers, make decisions.
Shift.ms is a digital community that supports people with MS (MSers) from diagnosis by connecting them with others who get it, empowering MSers to make proactive decisions inspired by the lived experience of others. 
We’re an independent charity and our app is free.
- 60,000+ members worldwide
- Connect with people who understand what you’re going through and build your support network 
- Learn how to adapt to your diagnosis and better manage your health
- Find answers to all your MS questions
- Get honest advice from the people who’ve been where you are
- Read, listen, watch the stories of other MSers 
Be part of the Shift.ms community, take control of your MS and get on with living life. 
Ever wondered what a social network for people with multiple sclerosis would look like? Shift.ms is it, with the added benefit of safeguards to ensure our free community is a positive space, dedicated to supporting people with, or who’ve been affected by, MS. 
"It's an app that carries proper authority, not a wild west. It's a trusted space where you can decide how much interaction you want. Whether you want to fully engage or just gather your thoughts, it's up to you." - Gemma, Shift.ms member
BY MSERS, FOR MSERS
- Shift.ms was started in 2009 by our CEO George Pepper, who was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis at age 22
- George co-founded Shift.ms to fill an urgent lack of support for younger people with MS
- Shift.ms remains the only UK MS charity that has the voice of people with MS at every level of the organisation 
STORIES
- Feel inspired by the lived experience of MSers
- Watch fresh video content dropping every week
- Participate in polls and see the opinions of other MSers
- Personalise your profile
- Notifications straight to your phone
- Direct messaging to other community members
RECEIVE SUPPORT. GIVE SUPPORT
- Ask the community anything on the live feed
- Treatment choices and side effects
- Symptom flare-ups
- Mental health concerns
- Practical support ie. income benefits, workplace rights, managing symptoms
- Lifestyle recommendations ie. stopping smoking, increasing exercise/movement
- Reply to conversation threads with your own advice and experience
TAKE CONTROL, FROM DIAGNOSIS
- Newly diagnosed
- Been living with MS for a while
- Experiencing new challenges
- Make proactive choices that benefit your health in the long term
- Get support to help manage the uncertainty ahead
CONNECT WITH A BUDDY
- Connect 1:1 with an experienced MSer through our Buddy Network
- Free service to help MSers adapt to diagnosis
- Find personalised support based on location, age, gender, MS type, treatment choices
- Emotional and wellbeing support
- Coaching to help make early proactive decisions
"Having a Buddy is like having a best friend that identifies with you. [My buddy] helped me at a time when I really needed the support and I feel like I'm a lot stronger now." - Sahdia, Shift.ms member 
FIND ANSWERS
- 24/7 access and support
- Ask questions; get honest answers
- “How bad were the treatment side effects?”
- “Top tips on managing fatigue?”
- “What is an MRI really like?”
WE’VE WORKED WITH…
- Thought leaders within the UK’s National Health Service: 
- UCLH NHS - National Hospital of Neurology
- Kings NHS
- Barts NHS
- Leeds Teaching Hospitals
Trusted organisations to improve the lives of MSers:
- Transforming MS for All
- MS Brain Health
- Neurology Academy
“Shift.ms has been a great source of support for my patients. The peer to peer support they offer has been invaluable to my patients when living with the challenges of MS.” Julie Taylor, Specialist MS Nurse
REGISTERED CHARITY NUMBER: 1117194 (England and Wales)
REGISTERED COMPANY: 06000961
REGISTERED ADDRESS:
Shift.ms, Platform, New Station Street, LS1 4JB, United Kingdom

bluejetty:00068307:ios.description:
Transform your videos with Auto Captions, the smart video editing app that makes captioning fast, easy, and stylish. 
Whether you're creating content for social media, educational videos, or professional presentations, Auto Captions automatically generates accurate subtitles for your videos and gives you full control over their look.

- Auto-Generated Captions: Save time and effort with automatic caption generation. Upload your video and let Auto Captions transcribe the audio to text, making your content accessible instantly. 
- Customizable Caption Styles: Personalize your captions with various fonts, colors, backgrounds, and text sizes. Choose the style that best fits the tone of your video and make your captions pop! 
- Text Editing: Easily adjust the timing, positioning, and font size of your captions. Fine-tune every detail so your captions appear exactly how you want them. 
- Multi-Language Support: Create captions in multiple languages for a global audience. Whether you're speaking to fans in different regions or adding multilingual subtitles, Auto Captions has you covered. 
- Real-time Preview: See your edits come to life in real-time with a built-in preview feature. Adjust and perfect your video until it’s just right. 
- Simple and Intuitive: Auto Captions is designed for both beginners and professionals. With an intuitive interface, anyone can create polished videos with captions in just a few steps. 
- No Watermarks: Edit and share your videos without watermarks. Your content stays clean and professional, with no distractions. 
Make your videos more engaging and accessible in minutes. With Auto Captions, you can easily add, edit, and customize captions to create videos that speak to everyone.
Download Auto Captions now and start editing like a pro!

bluejetty:00145409:ios.summary: Banglapapers is your all-in-one source for news updates. It includes News, Live TV, Photo, Radio & Videos of all major news sources in Bangladesh. It is a multidimensional app containing both Bangla & English News Contents. This native app
bluejetty:00145409:ios.description:
Banglapapers is your all-in-one source for news updates. It includes News, Live TV, Photo, Radio & Videos of all major news sources in Bangladesh. It is a multidimensional app containing both Bangla & English News Contents. This native app instantly connects you to the Top News of Bangladesh including Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet and all other major cities. The unique interface & the rich contents made Banglapapers the most popular among other similar apps.
This is NOT an app that displays web content in application, this is a true native application that retrieves news from feeds and give you true comfort of reading news in Bangla on your device. This great app gives you seamless reading experience and keeps you updated of the country whether you are in Bangladesh or abroad.
Newspapers included: prothom alo, BBC Bangla, bangladesh protidin, naya diganta, kaler kantho, jagonews24.com, samakal, deshe bideshe, natunbarta.com, the daily star, bdnews24.com, bangla tribune, manabjamin, ittefaq.
BNP or Awami League? Get all news of politics on BanglaPapers. Other popular categories are: Breaking news, Bangladesh, Business, Sports, International, Entertainment, Science & Tech, News Live, NTV, ATN News, Channel 24, Live Radio.
Keywords: bd news, bd english news, bangla newspaper, all bangla news, bd newspaper, bangla khobor, bd newspaper, Newspaper bangladesh

Surf the web safely with just a few taps. ExpressVPN is a premium VPN service built for ultra-fast connections and private browsing on public Wi-Fi and other shared networks - across all your devices.
BLAZING-FAST SERVERS
Stream, game, and browse with lightning-fast speeds and unlimited bandwidth. Perfect for streaming your favorite TV shows and movies, sporting events, and more.

PRIVACY-FIRST TECHNOLOGY
ExpressVPN runs on RAM-only servers that never write data to a hard drive. All data is wiped on every reboot.

24/7 CUSTOMER SUPPORT
